examples.chinese: 这位摄影师花了三年时间才捕捉到了那只罕见雪豹的完美瞬间。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi shèyǐngshī huāle sān nián shíjiān cái bǔzhuō dàole nà zhī hánjìan xuěbào de wánměi shùnjiān.
examples.english: It took this photographer three years to finally capture the perfect moment of that rare snow leopard.

examples.chinese: 母亲用她的爱和耐心哺育了三个孩子，让他们在充满温暖的家庭环境中成长。
examples.pinyin: Mǔqīn yòng tā de ài hé nàixīn bǔyù le sān ge háizi, ràng tāmen zài chōngmǎn wēnnuǎn de jiātíng huanjìng zhōng chéngzhǎng.
examples.english: The mother nurtured three children with her love and patience, allowing them to grow up in a warm family environment.

english: not feel ashamed to ask and learn from one's subordinates

examples.chinese: 他因为害怕面对这段失败的感情，最终选择了不辞而别，留下了一封简短的信。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi hàipà miànduì zhè duàn shībài de gǎnqíng, zuìzh終xuǎnzéle bùcíérbié, liúxiàle yī fēng jiǎnduǎn de xìn.
examples.english: Because he was afraid to confront this failed relationship, he ultimately chose to leave without saying good-bye, leaving only a brief note.

examples.chinese: 虽然项目已经延期了，但我们还是可以采取措施来补救之前的损失。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán xiàngmù yǐjīng yánqī le, dànshì wǒmen háishi kěyǐ cǎiqǔ cuòshī lái bǔjiù zhīqián de sǔnshī.
examples.english: Although the project has already been delayed, we can still take measures to remedy the previous losses.

examples.chinese: 这位神秘投资者的真实身份至今仍是不得而知，业界对此众说纷纭。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi shénmì tóuzī zhě de zhēnshí shēnfèn zhìjīn réngshì bùdéérzhī, yèjiè duì cǐ zhòng shuō fēnyún.
examples.english: The true identity of this mysterious investor remains unknown to this day, and the industry has various speculations about it.

examples.chinese: 由于公司的经营困难，老板不得已决定裁员以渡过难关。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú gōngsī de jīngyíng kùnnan, lǎobǎn búdéyǐ juéding cáiyuán yǐ dùguò nánguān.
examples.english: Due to the company's operational difficulties, the boss reluctantly decided to lay off employees to get through the crisis.

examples.chinese: 他虽然输了比赛，但还是有些不服气，认为裁判的判罚不够公平。
examples.pinyin: Tā suīrán shū le bǐsài, dàn háishi yǒuxiē bù fúqì, rènwéi càipàn de pànfá búgòu gōngpíng.
examples.english: Although he lost the match, he was still somewhat uncomfortable with the result, believing that the referee's decision was not fair enough.

english: to act without taking time to think (idiom)

examples.chinese: 他听到这个消息后，不假思索地就同意了这个危险的计划，事后才意识到自己有多鲁莽。
examples.pinyin: Tā tīngdào zhège xiāoxī hòu, bùjiǎ-sīsuǒ de jiù tóngyìle zhège wēixiǎn de jìhuà, shìhòu cái yìshíle zìjǐ yǒu duō lǔmǒng.
examples.english: After hearing the news, he agreed to the dangerous plan without a second thought, only realizing afterward how reckless he had been.

examples.chinese: 尽管我们多次沟通，他对公司的决定仍然一头雾水，这让我感到有些不解。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn wǒmen duō cì gōutōng, tā duì gōngsī de juédìng仍然 yītóu wù shuǐ, zhè ràng wǒ gǎndào yǒuxiē bùjiě.
examples.english: Despite our multiple communications, he remained confused about the company's decision, which left me somewhat baffled.

examples.chinese: 在那个不经意的瞬间，我突然意识到自己已经走了很远。
examples.pinyin: Zài nàge bùjīngyì de shùnjiān, wǒ túrán yìshí dào zìjǐ yǐjīng zǒule hěn yuǎn.
examples.english: In that unguarded moment, I suddenly realized that I had already come a long way.

examples.chinese: 由于全球经济不景气，许多中小企业不得不缩减员工和开支。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú quánqiú jīngjì bù jǐngqì, xǔduō zhōngxiǎo qǐyè búdébù suōsuǎn yuángōng hé kāizhī.
examples.english: Due to the depressive global economy, many small and medium-sized enterprises had to reduce their workforce and expenses.

examples.chinese: 经过几个月的战争，这个城市已经是满目疮痍，不堪一击。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò jǐ ge yuè de zhànzhēng, zhège chéngshì yǐjīng shì mǎnmù chuāngyíyú, bùkān yījī.
examples.english: After months of war, the city had become devastated and was unable to withstand even a single blow.

examples.chinese: 他对裁判的判罚一直不服，甚至在赛后接受采访时还在抱怨。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì cáipàn de pànfá yìzhí bù fú,甚至 zài sàihòu jiēshòu cǎifǎng shí háishi zài bàoyuàn.
examples.english: He has been dissatisfied with the referee's decision all along, and even complained about it during the post-match interview.

examples.chinese: 他在短短三个月内就学会了五种语言，这简直是不可思议的成就。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài duǎnduǎn sān ge yuè nèi jiù xuéhuì le wǔ zhǒng yǔyán, zhè jiǎnzhí shì bùkě-sīyì de chéngjiù.
examples.english: He learned five languages in just three months, which is simply an inconceivable achievement.

examples.chinese: 随着全球化的发展,文化之间的冲突不可避免地会出现。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe quánqiúhuà de fāzhǎn, wénhuà zhījiān de chōn突 bùkěbìmiǎn de huì chūxiàn.
examples.english: With the development of globalization, conflicts between cultures will inevitably occur.

examples.chinese: 尽管我们反复劝说，他还是不肯承认自己的错误。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn wǒmen fǎnfù quànshuō, tā háishi bù kěn chéngrèn zìjǐ de cuòwù.
examples.english: Despite our repeated persuasion, he still refused to admit his mistake.

examples.chinese: 他对批评置之不理，继续按照自己的想法去做。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì pípíng zhìzhī bùlǐ, jìxù ànzhào zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ qù zuò.
examples.english: He ignored the criticism and continued to do things according to his own ideas.

english: to settle a matter by leaving it unsettled

examples.chinese: 这件争议虽然闹得沸沸扬扬，最后还是以不了了之告终，双方都没有得到满意的结果。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn zhēngyì suīrán nàode fèifèi yáng yáng, zuìhòu háishi yǐ bùliǎo-liǎozhī gàozhōng, shuāngfāng dōu méiyǒu dé到 mǎnyì de jiéguǒ.
examples.english: Although this controversy had caused quite a stir, it ultimately ended up being left unsettled, and neither side got a satisfactory result.

examples.chinese: 只要掌握了正确的方法，学习任何语言都不难。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào zhǎng握le zhèngquè de fāngfǎ, xuéxí rènhé yǔyán dōu bù nán.
examples.english: As long as you master the correct method, learning any language is not difficult.

examples.chinese: 他对公司的薪酬制度一直心存不平，认为这样的分配方式严重损害了员工的积极性。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì gōngsī de xīnchóu zhìdù yīzhí xīn cún bùpíng, rènwéi zhèyàng de fēnpèi fāngshì yánzhòng sǔnhuài le yuángōng de jījíxìng.
examples.english: He has long harbored dissatisfaction with the company's compensation system, believing that such a distribution method seriously undermines employees' enthusiasm.

examples.chinese: 这家不起眼的小餐馆其实藏着城里最地道的美食。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā bùqǐyǎn de xiǎo cānguǎn qīshí cánzhe chéng lǐ zuì dìdào de měishí.
examples.english: This unremarkable little restaurant actually contains the most authentic cuisine in the city.

examples.chinese: 与其说他是个失败者，不如说他是个勇于尝试的探索者。
examples.pinyin: Yǔqī shuō tā shì ge shībàizhě, bùrú shuō tā shì ge yǒngyú chǎngshì de tànsuǒzhě.
examples.english: Rather than saying he is a failure, it would be more accurate to say he is an explorer who dares to try.

examples.chinese: 这次谈判的结果不同寻常，双方都做出了前所未有的让步。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì tánpàn de jiéguǒ bùtóngxúncháng, shuāngfāng dōu zuòchūle qiánsuǒwèiyǒu de ràngbù.
examples.english: The outcome of this negotiation was unusual, as both sides made unprecedented concessions.

examples.chinese: 这位艺术家多年来默默创作，他的许多杰作长期不为人知，直到最近才被美术馆发现。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi yìshùjiā duō nián lái mòmò chuàngzuò, tā de xǔduō jiézuò cháng qī bù wéi rén zhī, zhídào zuìjìn cái bèi měishùguǎn fāxiàn.
examples.english: This artist has been quietly creating for many years, and many of his masterpieces remained unknown to the public for a long time until they were recently discovered by an art museum.

examples.chinese: 为了实现这个梦想，他不惜放弃了高薪工作和舒适的生活。
examples.pinyin: Wèile shíxiàn zhège梦想，tā búxī fàngqì le gāoxīn gōngzuò hé shūshì de shēnghuó.
examples.english: In order to realize this dream, he was willing to give up his high-paying job and comfortable life.

examples.chinese: 这种学术不诚实的行为在大学里是不容许的，违者将面临严重的后果。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xuéshù bù chéngshí de xíngwéi zài dàxué lǐ shì búróng xǔ de, wéizhě jiāng miànlín yánzhòng de hòuguǒ.
examples.english: This kind of academic dishonesty is not tolerated at universities, and violators will face serious consequences.

examples.chinese: 这两位棋手的实力不相上下，每次比赛都能进行到最后一步才分出胜负。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng wèi qíshǒu de shílì bùxiāngshàngxià, měi cì bǐsài dōu néng jìnxíng dào zuìhòu yī bù cái fēn chū shèngnegòu.
examples.english: These two chess players are equally matched in skill, and every competition goes down to the final move before a winner is determined.

examples.chinese: 他对这个项目的热情一直高涨不已，即使遇到了重重困难也没有放弃。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì zhège xiàngmù de règìng yìzhí gāozhǎng bùyǐ, jíshǐ遇到le chóngchóng kùnnan yě méiyǒu fàngqì.
examples.english: His enthusiasm for this project has remained undiminished; despite encountering numerous difficulties, he has not given up.

examples.chinese: 在公共场合大声讨论个人隐私问题不宜，这样容易引起他人的反感。
examples.pinyin: Zài gōngkāi chǎnghé dàshēng tǎolùn gèrén yǐn私 wèntí bùyí, zhèyàng róngyì yǐnqǐ tārén de fǎnxǐng.
examples.english: It is unsuitable to loudly discuss personal privacy issues in public places, as this tends to provoke others' displeasure.

examples.chinese: 虽然专家提出了很多建议，但这位企业家对此却不以为然，坚持按照自己的想法去做。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán zhuānjiā tíchūle hěnduō jiànyì, dàn zhè wèi qǐyèjiā duì cǐ què búyǐwéirán, jiānchí ànzhào zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ qù zuò.
examples.english: Although the experts offered many suggestions, the entrepreneur remained unconvinced and insisted on proceeding with his own plan.

examples.chinese: 看到那些老照片，她不由自主地流下了眼泪，仿佛回到了青春年代。
examples.pinyin: Kàndào nàxiē lǎo zhàopiàn, tā bùyóu-zìzhǔ de liúxià le yǎnlèi, fǎngfú huídào le qīngchūn niándài.
examples.english: Upon seeing those old photographs, she couldn't help but shed tears, as if she had returned to her youth.

examples.chinese: 由于他多次违反公司规定，管理层决定不予续约。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú tā duō cì w違fǎn gōngsī guīdìng, guǎnlǐcéng juédìng bùyǔ xùyuē.
examples.english: Due to his repeated violations of company regulations, the management decided to withhold contract renewal.

examples.chinese: 看到他狼狈的样子，我不由得笑了出来。
examples.pinyin: Kàndào tā lángbèi de yàngzi, wǒ bùyóude xiàole chūlái.
examples.english: Seeing his disheveled appearance, I couldn't help but burst out laughing.

examples.chinese: 听到这个消息后，三个朋友不约而同地决定辞去工作，一起去创业。
examples.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxī hòu, sān ge péngyou bùyuēértóng de juéding cíqù gōngzuò, yīqǐ qù chuàngyè.
examples.english: After hearing this news, the three friends coincidentally decided to quit their jobs and start a business together.

examples.chinese: 我不知道他为什么突然辞职了，这个决定让所有人都感到震惊。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bùzhī dào tā wèishéme túrán cízhí le, zhège juédìng ràng suǒyǒu rén dōu gǎndào zhènnjīng.
examples.english: I don't know why he suddenly resigned; this decision shocked everyone.

examples.chinese: 在这个城市生活了十年，我不知不觉已经把这里当成了第二故乡。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège chéngshì shēnghuó le shí nián, wǒ bùzhī-bùjué yǐjīng bǎ zhèlǐ dāngchéngle dì'èr gùxiāng.
examples.english: After living in this city for ten years, I have unconsciously come to regard it as my second home.

examples.chinese: 公司规定不准员工在工作时间使用个人手机，违者将被罚款。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī guīdìng bùzhǔn yuángōng zài gōngzuò shíjiān shǐyòng gèrén shǒujī, wéizhě jiāng bèi罚kuǎn.
examples.english: The company's regulation does not allow employees to use personal phones during work hours; violators will be fined.

examples.chinese: 这家科技公司的全球布局战略显示了他们对未来市场的深刻理解。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā kējì gōngsī de quánqiú bùjú zhànlüè xiǎnshìle tāmen duì wèilái shìchǎng de shēnkè lǐjiě.
examples.english: The global strategic arrangement of this tech company demonstrates their profound understanding of future markets.

examples.chinese: 随着改革开放，中国逐步步入了一个全新的发展阶段。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe gǎigé kāifàng, Zhōngguó zhúbù bùrù le yī ge quánxīn de fāzhǎn jiēduàn.
examples.english: With the reform and opening-up, China gradually stepped into a brand new stage of development.

examples.chinese: 虽然这个项目很复杂，但只要我们严格按照既定的步骤进行，就能确保最终的成功。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán zhège xiàngmù hěn fùzá, dànzhǐyào wǒmen yánggé ànzhào jìdìng de bùzhòu jìnxíng, jiù néng quèbǎo zuìzhōng de chénggōng.
examples.english: Although this project is complex, as long as we strictly follow the predetermined process, we can ensure ultimate success.

examples.chinese: 这台机器的某个部件出现了故障，导致整个生产线停止运作。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái jīqì de mǒu ge bùjiàn chūxiàn le gùzhàng, dǎozhì zhěnge shēngchǎn xiàn tíngzhǐ yùnzuò.
examples.english: A certain part of this machine malfunctioned, causing the entire production line to stop operating.

examples.chinese: 随着经济全球化的加速，各国的改革步伐也随之加快，但发展中国家的进展仍然滞后。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe jīngjì quánqiúhuà de jiāsù, gèguó de gǎigé bùfá yě suízī jiākuài, dàn fāzhǎnzhōngguójiā de jìnzhǎn仍rán滞zhì hòu.
examples.english: As economic globalization accelerates, the pace of reform in various countries has also quickened, but the progress of developing countries still lags behind.

examples.chinese: 政府已经部署了新的防疫措施来应对疫情的进一步蔓延。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ yǐjīng bùshǔle xīn de fàngyì cuòshī lái yìngduì yìqìng de jìnyībù mànyán.
examples.english: The government has deployed new epidemic prevention measures to respond to the further spread of the pandemic.

examples.chinese: 在这个充满谜团的案件中，侦探们花了几个月的时间才猜谜似的逐渐拼凑出真相。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège chōngmǎn mítuán de ànjiàn zhōng, zhēntànzhě men huāle jǐ ge yuè de shíjiān cái cāi mí shìde zhújiàn pīnzòu chū zhēnxiàng.
examples.english: In this case full of mysteries, the detectives spent months gradually piecing together the truth by guessing and deducing clues.

examples.chinese: 科学家们基于现有的数据猜想，宇宙中可能存在我们尚未发现的暗物质。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā men jīyú xiànyǒu de shùjù cāixiǎng, yǔzhòu zhōng kěnéng cúnzài wǒmen shàngruò fāxiàn de ànwùzhì.
examples.english: Based on existing data, scientists speculate that there may exist dark matter in the universe that we have not yet discovered.

examples.chinese: 随着全球经济一体化的加速，财经领域的风险也变得越来越难以预测。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe quánqiú jīngjì yītǐhuà de jiāsù, cáijīng lǐngyù de fēngxiǎn yě biànde yuèláiyuè nányǐ yùcè.
examples.english: As global economic integration accelerates, risks in the finance and economics sector have become increasingly difficult to predict.

examples.chinese: 这家公司虽然规模不大，但凭借雄厚的财力成功收购了几家竞争对手。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī suīrán guīmó búdà, dàn píngjiè xiónghòu de cáilì chénggōng shōugòu le jǐ jiā jìngjìng duìshǒu.
examples.english: Although this company is relatively small in scale, it successfully acquired several competitors thanks to its strong financial resources.

examples.chinese: 公司财务部门需要定期向董事会汇报财务状况，确保资金使用的透明度。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī cáiwù bùmén xūyào dìngqī xiàng dǒngshìhuì huìbào cáiwù zhuàngkuàng, quèbǎo zījīn shǐyòng de tòumíngdù.
examples.english: The company's finance department needs to regularly report the financial situation to the board of directors to ensure transparency in fund usage.

examples.chinese: 他年纪轻轻就展现出了非凡的文学才华，这让许多资深评论家都为之惊叹。
examples.pinyin: Tā niánjì qīngqīng jiù zhǎnxiàn chūle fēifán de wénxué cáihuá, zhè ràng xǔduō zīshēn píngluànjiā dōu wéizhī jīngtàn.
examples.english: At such a young age, he displayed extraordinary literary talent, which amazed many seasoned critics.

examples.chinese: 政府需要平衡财政支出与税收收入之间的矛盾，以维持经济的可持续发展。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ xūyào pínghuà cáizhèng zhīchū yǔ shuìshōu shōurù zhījiān de máodùn, yǐ wéichí jīngjì de kěchíxù fāzhǎn.
examples.english: The government needs to balance the contradiction between fiscal expenditure and tax revenue in order to maintain sustainable economic development.

examples.chinese: 这位服装设计师凭借其精湛的裁剪技艺，为许多名人裁制过高定礼服。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi fúzhuāng shèjìshī píngjiè qī jīngzhàn de cáijiǎn jìyì, wèi xǔduō míingrén cáizhì guò gāodìng lǐfú.
examples.english: This fashion designer, relying on her superb cutting techniques, has tailored high-end formal wear for many celebrities.

examples.chinese: 在这场诉讼中，法院需要判定哪些财物属于夫妻共同财产，哪些属于个人所有。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè chǎng sùsòng zhōng, fǎyuàn xūyào pànding nǎxiē cáiwù shǔyú fūqī gòngtóng cáichǎn, nǎxiē shǔyú gèrén suǒyǒu.
examples.english: In this lawsuit, the court needs to determine which properties belong to the couple's joint assets and which belong to the individual.

examples.chinese: 法院最终裁定这家公司必须赔偿受害者数百万元的损失。
examples.pinyin: Fǎyuàn zuìzhōng cáidìng zhè jiā gōngsī bìxū péicháng shòuhàizhě shù bǎi wàn yuán de sunǔ.
examples.english: The court ultimately ruled that the company must compensate the victims for losses amounting to millions of yuan.

examples.chinese: 这家公司采取了一系列创新措施来应对市场的激烈竞争。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī cǎiqǔ le yī xìliè chuàngxīn cuòshī lái yìngduì shìchǎng de jīliè jìngjìng.
examples.english: This company adopted a series of innovative measures to cope with fierce market competition.

examples.chinese: 法院的裁决虽然引发了广泛争议，但最终还是得到了大多数人的认可。
examples.pinyin: Fǎyuàn de cáijué suīrán yǐnfāle guǎngfàn zhēngyì, dàn zuìzh終háishi dé到le dàduōshù rén de rènkě.
examples.english: Although the court's ruling sparked widespread controversy, it ultimately gained recognition from most people.

examples.chinese: 随着环保政策的日益严格，许多地区已经停止了非法采矿活动，转而投资更可持续的产业发展。
examples.pinyin: Suí着huánjǐng zhèngcè de rìyì yánggé, xǔduō dìqū yǐjīng tíngzhǐle fēifǎ cǎikuàng huódòng, zhuǎn'ér tóuzī gèng kěchíxù de chǎnyè fāzhǎn.
examples.english: As environmental policies become increasingly strict, many regions have stopped illegal mining activities and instead invested in more sustainable industrial development.

examples.chinese: 暴雨过后，一道绚丽的彩虹横跨天际，让人们暂时忘却了灾难带来的沮丧。
examples.pinyin: Bàoyǔ guòhòu, yī dào xuànlì de cǎihóng héngkuà tiānjì, ràng rénmen zàntīshí wàngjué le zāinàn dàilái de chéngsàng.
examples.english: After the storm, a brilliant rainbow stretched across the sky, momentarily making people forget the dejection brought by the disaster.

examples.chinese: 夕阳西下，天边的彩霞映照着整个湖面，美得令人窒息。
examples.pinyin: Xīyáng xīxià, tiānbiān de cǎixiá yìngzhào zhe zhěngge húmiàn, měi de lìng rén zhìxí.
examples.english: As the sun set in the west, the clouds tinged with sunset hues reflected across the entire lake surface, beautiful enough to take one's breath away.

examples.chinese: 这家高档餐厅的生蚝都是从沿海地区采集的最新鲜的产品。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gāoduàn cāntīng de shēngyóu dōu shì cóng yánhǎi dìqū cǎijí de zuì xīnxiān de chǎnpǐn.
examples.english: The oysters at this upscale restaurant are all the freshest products collected from coastal regions.

examples.chinese: 关于具体的实施细则，参见本文档的附录部分。
examples.pinyin: Guānyú jùtǐ de shíshī xìzé, cānjiàn běn wén档de fùlù bùfen.
examples.english: For details on the specific implementation procedures, refer to the appendix section of this document.

examples.chinese: 这位将军的参谋提出了一个大胆的战略方案，最终扭转了整个战局。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi jiāngjūn de cānmóu tíchūle yīgè dàdǎn de zhànlüè fāng'àn, zuìzh終huì niǔzhuǎnle zhěngge zhànjú.
examples.english: The general's staff officer proposed a bold strategic plan that ultimately turned the tide of the entire battle.

examples.chinese: 他年轻时为了逃避家族的商业纠纷，毅然决然地参军了，从此改变了人生轨迹。
examples.pinyin: Tā niánqīng shí wèile táohuì jiāzú de shāngyè ji纠fēn, yìrán juéránde cānJūn le, cóngcǐ gǎibiàn le rénshēng guǐjī.
examples.english: When he was young, in order to escape his family's business disputes, he resolutely joined the army, which completely changed the trajectory of his life.

examples.chinese: 一家人围坐在餐桌前，推杯换盏之间，家族的故事和秘密也逐渐浮出水面。
examples.pinyin: Yī jiārén wéizuò zài cānzhuō qián, tuībēi huàn zhāp zhī jiān, jiāzú de gùshì hé mìmì yě zhújiàn fúchū shuǐmiàn.
examples.english: Family members sat around the dining table, and as they toasted and clinked glasses, the family's stories and secrets gradually came to light.

examples.chinese: 在制定新政策时，政府部门参照了其他国家的成功经验，力求避免重复犯错。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhìdìng xīn zhèngcè shí, zhèngfǔ bùmén cānzhào le qítā guójiā de chénggōng jīngyàn, lìqiú bìmiǎn chóngfù fàncuò.
examples.english: When formulating new policies, the government departments consulted the successful experiences of other countries in an effort to avoid repeating mistakes.

examples.chinese: 尽管进行了多次清理，这座古城的街道上仍然残留着几百年前的石板路。
examples.pinyin: jǐnguǎn jìnxíngle duō cì qīnglǐ, zhè zuò gǔchéng de jiēdào shang réngrán cánliú zhe jǐ bǎi nián qián de shíbǎn lù.
examples.english: Despite multiple cleanings, the streets of this ancient city still retain stone pavements from several hundred years ago.

examples.chinese: 这座古庙虽然残缺不全，但仍然保留了许多珍贵的历史价值。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔ miào suīrán cánquē búquán, dàn仍然 bǎoliúle xǔduō zhēnguì de lìshǐ jiàzhí.
examples.english: Although this ancient temple is badly damaged and incomplete, it still retains considerable historical value.

examples.chinese: 战争残留的废墟见证了这座城市曾经的繁荣与衰落。
examples.pinyin: Zhànzhēng cánliú de fěixū jiànzhèngle zhè zuò chéngshì céngjīng de繁荣 yǔ衰落。
examples.english: The ruins left by war bear witness to the city's former prosperity and decline.

examples.chinese: 那个独裁者对反对派采取了残忍的镇压手段，引起了国际社会的广泛谴责。
examples.pinyin: Nàge dúcái zhě duì fǎnduì pài cǎiqǔle cánrěn de zhèngyā shǒuduàn, yǐnqǐle guójì shèhuì de guǎngfàn qiǎnzhé.
examples.english: The dictator took cruel suppression measures against the opposition, which sparked widespread international condemnation.

examples.chinese: 我为自己之前的言行感到惭愧，决定要更加谨慎地对待他人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ wèi zìjǐ zhīqián de yányán gǎndào cánkuì, juéding yào gèngjiā jǐnshèn de duìdài tārén.
examples.english: I feel ashamed of my previous words and actions, and I've decided to treat others more carefully.

examples.chinese: 这次失败给了他一个惨痛的教训，让他意识到自己有多么天真。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shībài gěile tā yīgè cǎntòng de jiàoxun, ràng tā yìshí dào zìjǐ yǒu duōme tiānzhēn.
examples.english: This failure taught him a bitter lesson, making him realize how naive he had been.

examples.chinese: 那场地震造成了惨重的经济损失，整个城市需要花费数年才能重建。
examples.pinyin: Nà chǎng dìzhèn zàochéngle cǎnzhòng de jīngjì sǔnshī, zhěnggè chéngshì xūyào huāfèi shù nián cáinéng chóngjiàn.
examples.english: That earthquake caused disastrous economic losses, and it will take the entire city years to rebuild.

examples.chinese: 她接到那通电话后，脸色变得惨白，整个人都开始颤抖起来。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiēdào nà tōng diànhuà hòu, liǎnsè biàn de cǎnbái, zhěnggè rén dōu kāishǐ chàndǒu qǐlái.
examples.english: After receiving that phone call, her face turned deathly pale, and her entire body began to tremble.

examples.chinese: 那只苍蝇在食物上嗡嗡叫，让人厌烦得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Nà zhī cāngying zài shíwù shang wēngwēng jiào, ràng rén yànfán de búdeliǎo.
examples.english: That housefly was buzzing around the food, which was absolutely irritating.

examples.chinese: 这座城市经历了百年沧桑，如今已成为国际大都市，令人感慨万千。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì jīnglìle báinián cāngsāng, rújīn yǐ chéngwéi guójì dà dūshì, lìngrén gǎnkài wàn qiān.
examples.english: This city has experienced a century of great changes and is now an international metropolis, which is truly awe-inspiring.

examples.chinese: 飞机失压时，乘务员立即检查了每个客舱的氧气面罩是否正常工作。

examples.chinese: 尽管经历了许多挫折，她依然用灿烂的笑容面对生活中的每一个挑战。
examples.pinyin: Jìnguǎn jīng历le xǔduō cuòzhé, tā yīrán yòng cànlàn de xiàoróng miànduì shēnghuó zhōng de měi yī ge tiǎozhàn.
examples.english: Despite having experienced many setbacks, she still faces every challenge in life with a brilliant smile.

examples.chinese: 那些贪污官员企图藏匿证据，但最终还是被反腐部门查获了。
examples.pinyin: Nàxiē tānwū guānyuán qǐtú cángnì zhèngjù, dàn zuìzh終shì bèi fǎnfǔ bùmén chāhuòle.
examples.english: Those corrupt officials attempted to cover up evidence, but it was eventually discovered by the anti-corruption department.

examples.chinese: 在这个繁华的都市里，许多非法分子藏身于地下黑市，逃避执法部门的追捕。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège繁华的 dōushì lǐ, xǔduō fēifǎ fènzǐ cángshēn yú dìxià hēishì, táohuì zhíhuì bùmén de zhuībǔ.
examples.english: In this bustling metropolis, many criminals hide themselves in underground black markets to evade law enforcement's pursuit.

examples.chinese: 他为了公司的前景操心了好几年，最后终于看到了成果。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèile gōngsī de qiánjǐng cāoxīn le hǎo jǐ nián, zuìhòu终于 kàndào le chénɡɡuǒ.
examples.english: He worried about the company's prospects for several years, and finally saw the results pay off.

examples.chinese: 这些年来，她为了家庭和事业操劳过度，身体已经出现了明显的衰弱迹象。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē niánlái, tā wèile jiātíng hé shìyè cāoláo guòdù, shēntǐ yǐjīng chūxiànle míngxiǎn de衰弱 jìxiàng.
examples.english: Over these years, she has overworked herself for the sake of family and career, and her health has already shown obvious signs of decline.

examples.chinese: 那些大型科技公司通过算法操控用户的信息流，影响了人们的判断力。
examples.pinyin: Nàxiē dàxíng kējì gōngsī tōngguò suànfǎ cāokòng yònghù de xìnxīliú, yǐngxiǎngle rénmen de pànduànlì.
examples.english: Those large tech companies manipulate users' information feeds through algorithms, which has affected people's judgment.

examples.chinese: 这条鱼塘的进水槽年久失修，导致水质不断恶化。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo yútáng de jìnshuǐ cáo niánjiǔ shīxiū, dǎozhì shuǐzhì búduàn ěhuà.
examples.english: The inlet trough of this fish pond has fallen into disrepair due to age, resulting in continuous deterioration of water quality.

examples.chinese: 这份改革草案经过了多次修改，才最终提交给了全国人大审议。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn gǎigé cǎoàn jīngguò le duō cì xiūgǎi, cái zuìzh终 tíjiāo gěi le quánguó rén dà shěnyì.
examples.english: This reform draft underwent multiple revisions before it was finally submitted to the National People's Congress for deliberation.

examples.chinese: 这个公园的草坪维护得很好，吸引了许多家庭在周末来野餐。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gōngyuán de cǎopíng wéihù de hěn hǎo, xīyǐnle xǔduō jiātíng zài zhōumò lái yějīcān.
examples.english: The lawn in this park is well-maintained, attracting many families to come for picnics on weekends.

examples.chinese: 从侧面来看，这个政策的实施反映了政府在经济改革中的决心。
examples.pinyin: Cóng cèmiàn lái kàn, zhège zhèngcè de shíshī fǎnyìngle zhèngfǔ zài jīngjì gǎigé zhōng de juéxīn.
examples.english: From a lateral perspective, the implementation of this policy reflects the government's determination in economic reform.

examples.chinese: 这家公司的新战略侧重于开发可持续能源技术，而不是追求短期利润。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī de xīn zhànlüè cèzhòng yú kāifā kěchíxù néngliàng jìshù, érbúshì zhuīqiú duǎnqī lìrùn.
examples.english: The company's new strategy places particular emphasis on developing sustainable energy technology rather than pursuing short-term profits.

examples.chinese: 根据最新的数据，经济学家们测算出今年的GDP增长率可能会达到5.2%。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù zuìxīn de shùjù, jīngjìxuéjiā men cèsuàn chū jīnnián de GDP zēngzhǎnglǜ kěnéng huì dádào 5.2%。

examples.chinese: 这次化学测验的难度超出了我们的预期，许多学生都没有及格。

examples.english: The difficulty of this chemistry test exceeded our expectations, and many students failed to pass.

examples.chinese: 随着互联网的发展，各种新型诈骗手段层出不穷，消费者必须提高警惕。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe hùliánwǎng de fāzhǎn, gèzhǒng xīnxíng zhàpiàn shǒuduàn céngchū-bùqióng, xiāofèizhě bìxū tígāo jǐngtì.
examples.english: With the development of the internet, various new types of fraud schemes emerge endlessly, and consumers must remain vigilant.

examples.chinese: 他不好意思地蹭了蹭鞋子，支吾着向老板承认了自己的错误。
examples.pinyin: Tā búhǎoyìsi de cèng le cèng xiézi, zhīwǔ zhe xiàng lǎobǎn chéngrèn le zìjǐ de cuòwù.
examples.english: He awkwardly rubbed his shoes against the ground and stammered an admission of his mistake to the boss.

examples.chinese: 这个项目涉及数百万的投资，我们不能容许任何差错。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù sh涉jí shù bǎi wàn de tóuzī, wǒmen búnéng rónghǔ rènhé chācuò.
examples.english: This project involves millions of dollars in investment, so we cannot tolerate any mistakes.

examples.chinese: 公司今年的收入比去年增加了五百万，但由于成本上升，实际利润的差额并不大。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jīnnián de shōurù bǐ qùnián zēngjiāle wǔbǎi wàn, dàn yóuyú chéngběn shàngshēng, shíjì lìrùn de chāé bìng búdà.
examples.english: The company's revenue increased by five million this year compared to last year, but due to rising costs, the difference in actual profit is not significant.

examples.chinese: 他不应该插手公司的内部事务，这样只会引发更多的矛盾。
examples.pinyin: Tā búyīnggāi chāshǒu gōngsī de nèibù shìwù, zhèyàng zhǐhuì yǐnfā gèngduō de máodùn.
examples.english: He shouldn't get involved in the company's internal affairs, as it will only cause more conflicts.

examples.chinese: 这本书的插图设计得非常精美，充分展现了作者对细节的执着追求。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū de chātú shèjì de fēicháng jīngměi, ch充分 zhǎnxiàn le zuòzhě duì xìjié de zhízhù zhuīqiú.
examples.english: The illustrations in this book are designed beautifully, fully showcasing the author's meticulous pursuit of detail.

examples.chinese: 他总是喜欢在别人讲话的时候插嘴，这种行为显得非常没有教养。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì xǐhuān zài biérén jiǎnghuà de shíhou chāzuǐ, zhè zhǒng xíngwéi xiǎnde fēicháng méiyǒu jiàoyǎng.
examples.english: He always likes to interrupt when others are speaking; this kind of behavior appears extremely impolite.

examples.chinese: 学习茶道不仅需要掌握冲泡技巧，更重要的是要领悟其中蕴含的哲学思想和修养境界。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxí chádào bújǐn xūyào zhǎng握 chōngpào jìqiǎo, gèng zhòngyào de shì yào lǐngwù qīzhōng yùnhánde zhéxué sīxiǎng hé xiūyǎng jìngjiè.
examples.english: Learning the Japanese tea ceremony requires not only mastering brewing techniques, but more importantly, understanding the philosophical thoughts and spiritual refinement embedded within it.

examples.chinese: 那家老茶馆儿虽然装修得很简陋，但老北京的味道却保留得最完整。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā lǎo cháguǎnr suīrán zhuāngxiū de hěn jiǎnlòu, dàn lǎo Běijīng de wèidào què bǎoliú de zuì wánzhěng.
examples.english: Although that old teashop has rather shabby renovations, it has preserved the most authentic flavor of old Beijing.

english: to investigate and handle (a criminal case)

examples.english: The police have thoroughly investigated and handled this bribery case, and the personnel involved will face legal punishment.

examples.chinese: 警察经过几周的调查，终于查明了这起神秘失窃案的真相。

examples.english: He searched for all financial reports from the past three years in the company's document system.

examples.chinese: 他敏锐地察觉到了对方话语中隐含的讽刺意味。

examples.chinese: 警察仔细察看了现场的每一个细节，试图找到关键的证据。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá zǎixì chákànle xiànchǎng de měi yī ge细节，shìtú zhǎodào guānjiàn de zhèngjù.
examples.english: The police carefully examined every detail of the scene, trying to find key evidence.

examples.chinese: 他听到这个消息时感到十分诧异，因为这完全出乎他的意料。
examples.pinyin: Tā tīngdào zhège xiāoxī shí gǎndào shífēn chàyì, yīnwèi zhè wánquán chūhū tā de yìliào.
examples.english: He was extremely flabbergasted when he heard this news, as it was completely beyond his expectation.

examples.chinese: 这种劣质产品掺了很多有害物质，严重危害消费者的健康。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng劣质 chǎnpǐn掺le hěnduō yǒuhài wùzhì, yánzhòng wēihài xiāofèizhě de jiànkāng.
examples.english: This inferior product was mixed with many harmful substances, seriously endangering consumers' health.

english: to take by the arm and assist

examples.chinese: 她搀着年迈的父亲走过拥挤的车站，生怕他在人群中走散。
examples.pinyin: Tā chānzhe niánmài de fùqin zǒuguò yōngjǐ de chēzhàn, shēngpà tā zài rénqún zhōng zǒusan.
examples.english: She took her elderly father by the arm and walked through the crowded station, afraid he might get lost in the crowd.

examples.chinese: 他一看到甜点就馋得流口水，完全无法抗拒美食的诱惑。
examples.pinyin: Tā yī kàndào tiándiǎn jiù chán de liúkǒushuǐ, wánquán wúfǎ kàngjù měishí de yòuhuò.
examples.english: The moment he sees desserts, he becomes so gluttonous that he drools, completely unable to resist the temptation of delicious food.

english: the staff of a Buddhist monk

examples.chinese: 老和尚手握禅杖，在寺院的林荫小道上缓缓行走，仿佛在思索着人生的奥秘。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo héshang shǒu wò chánzhàng, zài sìyuàn de línyīn xiǎodào shang huǎnhuǎn xíngzǒu, fǎngfú zài sīsuǒ zhe rénshēng de àomì.
examples.english: The elderly monk walked slowly along the shaded path in the temple, holding his staff, as if contemplating the mysteries of life.

examples.chinese: 他被繁琐的家务事缠得焦头烂额，根本无暇顾及工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā bèi fánsuǒ de jiāwù shì chán de jiāotóu làn'é, gēnběn wúxiá gùjí gōngzuò.
examples.english: He was so caught up in tedious household chores that he had no time to attend to his work.

examples.chinese: 这个地区产出的葡萄酒在国际市场上享有很高的声誉。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū chǎnchūde pútaojǐu zài guójì shìchǎng shang xiǎngyǒu hěn gāo de shēngyù.
examples.english: The wine produced in this region enjoys a high reputation in the international market.

examples.chinese: 这批茶叶的产地是云南，具有独特的地理优势和悠久的种植历史。
examples.pinyin: Zhè pī cháyè de chǎndì shì Yúnnán, jùyǒu dúté de dìlǐ yōushì hé y悠jiǔ de zhòngzhí lìshǐ.
examples.english: The source of this batch of tea is Yunnan, which has unique geographical advantages and a long history of cultivation.

examples.chinese: 这种矛盾的社会现象是长期历史发展的产物，不是一朝一夕能够解决的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng máodùn de shèhuì xiànxiàng shì cháng期 lìshǐ fāzhǎn de chǎnwù, búshì yī zhāo yī xī néng gòu jiějué de.
examples.english: This contradictory social phenomenon is a product of long-term historical development and cannot be resolved overnight.

examples.chinese: 随着技术创新和产业升级，该地区制造业的产值在过去五年里翻了三倍。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe jìshù chuàngxīn hé chǎnyè shēngjí, gāi dìqū zhìzàoyè de chǎnzhí zài guòqù wǔ nián lǐ fānle sān bèi.
examples.english: With technological innovation and industrial upgrading, the output value of the manufacturing sector in this region has tripled over the past five years.

examples.chinese: 工人们用铲子铲除了路面上的积雪，确保交通畅通。
examples.pinyin: Gōngrénmen yòng chǎnzi chǎnchúle lùmiàn shàng de jīxuě, quèbǎo jiāotōng chàngthōng.
examples.english: The workers used shovels to clear the accumulated snow on the road surface to ensure traffic flowed smoothly.

examples.chinese: 考古队员小心翼翼地用铲子挖掘遗迹，生怕破坏了那些珍贵的文物。
examples.pinyin: Kǎogǔ duìyuán xiǎoxīn yìyì de yòng chǎnzi wājué yíjī, shēngpà pòhuài le nàxiē zhēnguì de wénwù.
examples.english: The archaeologists carefully excavated the ruins with shovels, afraid of damaging those precious cultural relics.

examples.chinese: 这位经济学家在论坛上详细阐述了他关于收入分配改革的观点。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi jīngjìxuéjiā zài lùntán shang xiáng细 chǎnshù le tā guānyú shōurù fēnpèi gǎigé de guāndiǎn.
examples.english: The economist expounded in detail his views on income distribution reform at the forum.

examples.chinese: 听到这个噩耗的那一刻，她的声音开始颤抖，眼泪不禁流了下来。
examples.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège èhuò de nà yī kè, tā de shēngyīn kāishǐ chàndǒu, yǎnlèi bújìn liúle xiàlái.
examples.english: The moment she heard the tragic news, her voice began to shudder, and tears involuntarily streamed down her face.

examples.chinese: 那个恐怖组织的猖狂行为激怒了全世界的人民。
examples.pinyin: Nàge kǒngnì zǔzhī de chāngkuáng xíngwéi jīnùle quánshìjiè de rénmín.
examples.english: The savage actions of that terrorist organization angered people all over the world.

examples.chinese: 这部纪录片长达三小时，深入探讨了气候变化对生态系统的影响。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn chángdá sān xiǎoshí, shēnrù tàntǎo le qìhòu biànhuà duì shēngtài xìtǒng de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: This documentary, which runs for three hours, deeply explores the impact of climate change on ecosystems.

english: ever since a long time ago

examples.chinese: 长期以来，这个地区的教育资源分配不均一直是制约经济发展的主要因素。
examples.pinyin: Chángqīyǐlái, zhège dìqū de jiàoyù zīyuán fēnpèi búyún yīzhí shì zhìyuē jīngjì fāzhǎn de zhǔyào yīnsù.
examples.english: Ever since a long time ago, the unequal distribution of educational resources in this region has been the main factor constraining economic development.

english: to be effective over an extended period

examples.chinese: 这款新型抗生素具有长效性，患者只需每周注射一次就能维持疗效。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn xīnxíng kàngjìngsù jùyǒu chángxiào xìng, huànzhě zhǐ xū měi zhōu zhùshè yī cì jiù néng wéichí liáoxiào.
examples.english: This new type of antibiotic has long-lasting effectiveness, so patients only need to receive an injection once a week to maintain its therapeutic effect.

english: Long March (retreat of the Red Army 1934-1935)

examples.chinese: 红军长征的历史意义远远超出了当时人们的想象，它标志着中国革命进入了一个新的阶段。
examples.pinyin: Hóng jūn chángzhēng de lìshǐ yìyì yuǎnyuǎn chāochūle dāngshí rénmen de xiǎngxiàng, tā biāozhì zhe Zhōngguó gémìng jìnrù le yīgè xīn de jiēduàn.
examples.english: The historical significance of the Red Army's Long March far exceeded people's imagination at the time, marking that the Chinese revolution had entered a new phase.

examples.chinese: 近年来，中国的科技创新取得了长足的进步，许多高新技术已经走在了世界前列。
examples.pinyin: Jìnnián lái, Zhōngguó de kējì chuàngxīn qǔdéle chángzú de jìnbù, xǔduō gāoxīn jìshù yǐjīng zǒu zàile shìjiè qiánliè.
examples.english: In recent years, China's technological innovation has made remarkable progress, and many high-tech technologies have already advanced to the forefront of the world.

examples.chinese: 按照常理，一个人在失业后应该积极寻找新的工作机会，但他却选择了消极应对。
examples.pinyin: Ànzhào chánglǐ, yī ge rén zài shīyè hòu yīnggāi jījí xúnzhǎo xīn de gōngzuò jīhuì, dàn tā却 xuǎnzéle xiāojí yìngduì.
examples.english: By common sense, a person should actively seek new job opportunities after becoming unemployed, but he chose to respond passively instead.

examples.chinese: 这种坚持和毅力已经超越了常人的想象，难怪他能在竞争如此激烈的领域中脱颖而出。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng jiānchí hé yìlì yǐjīng chāoyuè le chángrén de xiǎngxiàng, nánguài tā néng zài jìngjìng rúcǐ jīliè de lǐngyù zhōng tuōyǐnghuà chūlái.
examples.english: This kind of perseverance and determination has already exceeded the imagination of ordinary people, no wonder he was able to stand out in such a fiercely competitive field.

examples.chinese: 在这个快速变化的时代，不确定性已经成为了一种常态，我们需要学会适应这种新的生活方式。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège kuàisù biànhuà de shídài, búquèdìngxìng yǐjīng chéngwéile yī zhǒng chángtài, wǒmen xūyào xuéhuì shìyìng zhè zhǒng xīn de shēnghuó fāngshì.
examples.english: In this rapidly changing era, uncertainty has become the new normal, and we need to learn to adapt to this new way of living.

examples.chinese: 这种药物必须在常温下保存，否则容易失效。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yàowù bìxū zài chángwēn xià bǎocún, yǎozé róngyì shīxiào.
examples.english: This type of medication must be stored at room temperature, otherwise it will easily lose its effectiveness.

examples.chinese: 这家公司因为长期亏损，无法偿还到期的债务，最终被迫申请破产保护。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī yīnwèi chángqī kuīsǔn, wúfǎ chánghuán dàoqī de zhàiwù, zuìzhōng bèi pò shēnqǐng pòchǎn bǎohù.
examples.english: Due to prolonged losses, this company was unable to repay its overdue debts and was ultimately forced to file for bankruptcy protection.

examples.chinese: 嫦娥奔月的传说在中华文化中代代相传，象征着人类对美好事物的永恒追求。
examples.pinyin: Chángé bènyuè de chuánshuō zài zhōnghuá wénhuà zhōng dàidài xiāngchuán, xiàngzh征 zhe rénlèi duì měihǎo shìwù de yǒnghéng zhuīqiú.
examples.english: The legend of Chang'e flying to the moon has been passed down through generations in Chinese culture, symbolizing humanity's eternal pursuit of beautiful things.

examples.chinese: 这款产品的厂家承诺提供终身保修服务，但消费者对其真实性仍然持怀疑态度。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn chǎnpǐn de chǎngjiā chéngnuò tígōng zh终身 bǎoxiu fúwù, dàn xiāofèizhě duì qī zhēnshíxìng仍然 chí huáiyí tàidù.
examples.english: The manufacturer of this product promises to provide lifetime warranty service, but consumers remain skeptical about its authenticity.

examples.chinese: 他敞开心扉，向朋友倾诉了多年来的烦恼和秘密。
examples.pinyin: Tā chǎngkāi xīnfēi, xiàng péngyou qīngshù le duōnián lái de fánnǎo hé mìmì.
examples.english: He opened his heart and confided his worries and secrets accumulated over many years to his friend.

examples.chinese: 两位企业领导人在论坛上畅谈了如何应对全球经济变化的策略。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng wèi qǐyè lǐngdǎo rén zài lùntán shang chàngtán le rúhé yīngduì quánqiú jīngjì biànhuà de cèlüè.
examples.english: The two business leaders discussed strategies on how to respond to global economic changes at the forum.

examples.chinese: 这部小说在出版后迅速成为畅销书，甚至被多个国家引进翻译。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù xiǎoshuō zài chūbǎn hòu xùnsù chéngwéi chàngxiāo shū,甚至 bèi duōgè guójiā yǐnjìn fānyì.
examples.english: This novel quickly became a bestseller after its publication and was even introduced and translated in multiple countries.

examples.chinese: 专家们倡议政府应该加大对绿色能源的投资力度，以应对日益严峻的气候变化问题。
examples.pinyin: Zhuānjiā men chàngyì zhèngfǔ yīnggāi jiādà duì lǜsè néngyuán de tóuzī lìdu, yǐ yìngduì rìyì yánnjùn de qìhòu biànhuà wèntí.
examples.english: Experts suggested that the government should increase investment in green energy to address the increasingly severe climate change problem.

examples.chinese: 这位学者因为在论文中抄袭了他人的研究成果而被学术界彻底否定。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi xuézhě yīnwèi zài lùnwén zhōng chāoxí le tārén de yánjiū chéngguǒ érbeǐ xuéshùjiè chèdǐ fǒudìng.
examples.english: This scholar was completely discredited by the academic community for plagiarizing others' research findings in his paper.

examples.chinese: 随着数字货币的普及，人们对纸质钞票的依赖程度逐渐降低。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe shùzì huòbì de pǔjí, rénmen duì zhǐzhì chāopiào de yīlài chéngdù zhújiàn jiàngdī.
examples.english: As digital currencies become more widespread, people's dependence on paper banknotes is gradually decreasing.

examples.chinese: 这家工厂的污染排放早就超标了，环保部门多次警告都没有改善。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng de wūrǎn pāifàng zǎo jiù chāobiāo le, huánbǎo bùmén duō cì jǐngào dōu méiyǒu gǎishàn.
examples.english: This factory's pollution emissions have long exceeded the limit, and despite multiple warnings from the environmental protection department, there has been no improvement.

examples.chinese: 在高速公路上超车时，必须确保视线清晰，并提前打转向灯以提醒后方车辆。
examples.pinyin: Zài gāosù gōnglù shang chāochē shí, bìxū quèbǎo shìxiàn qīngchè, bìng tǐqián dǎ zhuǎnxiàng dēng yǐ tíxǐng hòufāng chēliàng.
examples.english: When overtaking on the highway, you must ensure clear visibility and signal in advance to alert the vehicles behind you.

english: to be ahead of one's time

examples.chinese: 那位司机因为超速被警察罚款了，这次的教训应该能让他意识到遵守交通规则的重要性。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi sījī yīnwèi chāosù bèi jǐngchá fákuǎn le, zhè cì de jiàoxùn yīnggāi néng ràng tā yìshí dào zūnshǒu jiāotōng guīzé de zhòngyàoxìng.
examples.english: That driver was fined by the police for speeding; this lesson should make him realize the importance of obeying traffic rules.

examples.chinese: 这部历史纪录片深入探讨了中国古代各个朝代的政治制度演变过程。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù lìshǐ jìlùpiàn shēnrù tàntuǎo le Zhōngguó gǔdài gège cháodài de zhèngzhì zhìdù yǎnbiàn guòchéng.
examples.english: This historical documentary delves deeply into the evolution of political systems across various dynasties of ancient China.

examples.chinese: 他总是喜欢用讽刺的语气嘲弄那些与他意见不合的人，这让许多同事都感到不适。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì xǐhuān yòng fěngcì de yǔqì cháonòng nàxiē yǔ tā yìjiàn búhé de rén, zhè ràng xǔduō tóngshì dōu gǎndào búshì.
examples.english: He always likes to tease those who disagree with him in a sarcastic tone, which makes many colleagues feel uncomfortable.

examples.chinese: 他们嘲笑他的梦想，但他最终还是成功了，这让那些曾经嘲笑他的人感到羞愧。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen cháoxiào tā de mèngxiǎng, dàn tā zuìzh终 háishi chénggōng le, zhè ràng nàxiē céngjīng cháoxiào tā de rén gǎndào xiūyǔ.
examples.english: They jeered at his dreams, but he ultimately succeeded anyway, which made those who had once mocked him feel ashamed.

examples.chinese: 两个合作了多年的伙伴因为利益分配问题吵嘴，最后不得不解除合同。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng ge hézuò le duō nián de huǒbàn yīnwèi lìyì fēnpèi wèntí chǎo zuǐ, zuìhòu búdé búzhǐ jiěchú hétonɡ.
examples.english: Two partners who had collaborated for many years quarreled over the issue of profit distribution, and ultimately had to dissolve their contract.

examples.chinese: 在高速公路上，如果你长时间占用超车道而不让其他车辆通过，可能会被罚款。
examples.pinyin: Zài gāosù gōnglù shang, rúguǒ nǐ chángshíjiān zhànyòng chāochē chēdào érbúràng qítā chēliàng tōngguò, kěnéng huì bèi fákuǎn.
examples.english: On expressways, if you occupy the passing lane for a long time without letting other vehicles through, you may be fined.

examples.chinese: 那场严重的车祸导致了三人丧生，警方正在调查事故原因。
examples.pinyin: Nà chǎng yánzhòng de chēhuò dǎozhìle sān rén sàngshēng, jǐngfāng zhèngzài diàochá shìgù yuányīn.
examples.english: That serious car crash resulted in three deaths, and the police are investigating the cause of the accident.

examples.chinese: 这家工厂的车间虽然设备陈旧，但工人们凭借丰富的经验仍然能够保证产品质量。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng de chējiān suīrán shèbèi chénjiù, dàn gōngrénmen píngjiè fēngfù de jīngyàn仍然 néng gòu bǎozhèng chǎnpǐn zhìliàng.
examples.english: Although the workshop equipment in this factory is outdated, the workers can still guarantee product quality through their rich experience.

examples.chinese: 在高速公路上，驾驶员必须时刻关注车速，以防发生交通事故。
examples.pinyin: Zài gāosù gōnglù shang, jiàshǐyuán bìxū shíkè guānzhù chēsù, yǐ fáng fāshēng jiāotōng shìgù.
examples.english: On the highway, drivers must constantly monitor their vehicle speed to prevent traffic accidents.

examples.chinese: 这辆老卡车的车轮已经磨损得很厉害，急需更换新的轮胎。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng lǎo kǎchē de chēlún yǐjīng móshòu de hěn lìhai, jíxū gēnghuàn xīn de lúnt胎.
examples.english: The wheels of this old truck have worn down severely and urgently need new tires.

examples.chinese: 由于城市停车位紧张，许多开发商开始在地下建造多层停车库来缓解这一矛盾。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú chéngshì tíngchēwèi jǐnzhāng, xǔduō kāifāshāng kāishǐ zài dìxià jiànzào duōcéng tíngchēkù lái huǎnjiě zhè yī máodùn.
examples.english: Due to the shortage of parking spots in cities, many developers have begun constructing multi-level underground parking garages to alleviate this contradiction.

examples.chinese: 高铁的车厢设计得很舒适，乘客们可以在长途旅行中得到充分的休息。
examples.pinyin: Gāotiě de chēxiāng shèjì de hěn shūshì, chéngkè men kěyǐ zài chánggtǔ lǚxíng zhōng huòdào chōngfèn de xiūxi.
examples.english: The carriages of the high-speed train are designed very comfortably, allowing passengers to get adequate rest during long journeys.

examples.chinese: 这款新车型的设计理念完全颠覆了传统汽车工业的认知。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn xīn chēxíng de shèjì lǐniàn wánquán diānfù le chuántǒng qìchē gōngyè de rènzhī.
examples.english: This new car model's design philosophy has completely overturned the understanding of the traditional automobile industry.

examples.chinese: 这辆古董车的车轴已经生锈了，需要立即更换以确保安全行驶。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng gǔdǒng chē de chēzhóu yǐjīng shēngxiù le, xūyào lìjí gēnghuàn yǐ quèbǎo ānquán xíngshǐ.
examples.english: The axle of this vintage car has already rusted and needs to be replaced immediately to ensure safe driving.

examples.chinese: 他总是扯一些无关紧要的话题来转移话题。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì chě yīxiē wúguān jǐnyào de huàtí lái zhuǎnyí huàtí.
examples.english: He always brings up some irrelevant topics to divert the conversation.

examples.chinese: 他彻夜未眠地工作，只为了在截止日期前完成这个关键项目。
examples.pinyin: Tā chèyè wèi miánde gōngzuò, zhǐ wèile zài ji截zhǐ rìqī qián wánchéng zhège guānjiàn xiàngmù.
examples.english: He worked through the whole night without sleep just to complete this critical project before the deadline.

examples.chinese: 由于销售不佳，公司决定撤回在该地区的所有投资。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú xiāoshòu bújiā, gōngsī juéding chèhuí zài gāi dìqū de suǒyǒu tóuzī.
examples.english: Due to poor sales, the company decided to withdraw all its investments in that region.

examples.chinese: 由于销售业绩持续下滑，董事会决定撤换了这位市场总监。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú xiāoshòu yèjī chíxù xiàhuá, dǒngshìhuì juédìng chèhuànle zhè wèi shìchǎng zǒngjīnglǐ.
examples.english: Due to continuously declining sales performance, the board of directors decided to recall the marketing director.

examples.chinese: 他拎着沉甸甸的行李箱走出了机场，脸上带着疲惫的笑容。
examples.pinyin: Tā liánzhe chéndiàndiàn de xínglijīxiāng zǒuchūle jīchǎng, liǎnshang dàizhe píbèi de xiàoróng.
examples.english: He carried the heavy suitcase out of the airport with a tired smile on his face.

examples.chinese: 经过多年的文化沉淀，这座城市形成了独特的艺术气质。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò duō nián de wénhuà chéndiàn, zhè zuò chéngshì xíngchéngle dúté de yìshù qìzhì.
examples.english: After years of cultural accumulation and settling, this city has developed a unique artistic temperament.

examples.chinese: 他在书的世界里沉浸了好几个小时，完全忘记了时间的流逝。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài shū de shìjiè lǐ chénjìnle hǎo jǐ ge xiǎoshí, wánquán wàngjìle shíjiān de liúshì.
examples.english: He was immersed in the world of books for several hours, completely losing track of time.

examples.chinese: 这几天天气特别沉闷，乌云密布，让人感到压抑和疲惫。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān tiānqì tèbié chénmèn, wūyún mìbù, ràng rén gǎndào yālì hé píbèi.
examples.english: The weather has been particularly oppressive these past few days, with dense clouds making people feel depressed and exhausted.

examples.chinese: 他年轻时沉迷于古典文学，甚至放弃了学业，直到后来才意识到这样做的后果。
examples.pinyin: Tā niánqīng shí chénmí yú gǔdiǎn wénxué, shènzhì fàngqì le xuéyè, zhídào hòulái cái yìshí dào zhèyàng zuò de hòuguǒ.
examples.english: When he was young, he became engrossed in classical literature, even abandoning his studies, until later he finally realized the consequences of doing so.

examples.chinese: 他在办公室里沉思了很久，最终决定辞去这份工作，去追求自己真正热爱的事业。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài bàngōngshì lǐ chénsī le hěnjiǔ, zuìzh终 juéding cíqù zhè fèn gōngzuò, qù zhuīqiú zìjǐ zhēnzhèng règ'ài de shìyè.
examples.english: He contemplated in his office for a long time before finally deciding to quit this job and pursue the career he truly loved.

examples.chinese: 这位老教授虽然年迈，但讲课时的沉稳风度仍然让学生们深感敬佩。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎo jiàoshòu suīrán niánmài, dàn jiǎngkè shí de chénwěn fēngdù仍然 ràng xuéshengmen shēngǎn jìngpèi.
examples.english: Although the elderly professor was advanced in age, his steady and dignified manner while teaching still earned deep respect from his students.

examples.chinese: 在紧急情况下，医生需要保持沉着的头脑，才能做出正确的诊断。
examples.pinyin: Zài jǐnjí qíngkuàng xià, yīshēng xūyào bǎochí chénzhuó de tóunǎo, cáinéng zuòchū zhèngquè de zhěnduàn.
examples.english: In emergency situations, doctors need to maintain a steady mind in order to make accurate diagnoses.

examples.chinese: 虽然这栋建筑的外观显得有些陈旧，但它承载了几代人的历史记忆。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán zhè dòng jiànzhú de wàiguān xiǎnde yǒuxiē chénjiù, dàn tā chéngzàile jǐ dàirén de lìshǐ jìyì.
examples.english: Although the exterior of this building appears somewhat old-fashioned, it carries the historical memories of several generations.

examples.chinese: 博物馆的新展厅陈列了大量的古代陶瓷器，每一件都经过精心修复和研究。
examples.pinyin: Bówùguǎn de xīn zhǎntīng chénliè le dàliàng de gǔdài táocí qì, měi yī jiàn dōu jīngguò jīngxīn xiūfù hé yánjiū.
examples.english: The museum's new exhibition hall displays a large number of ancient ceramic artifacts, each of which has been carefully restored and studied.

examples.chinese: 律师在法庭上详细陈述了案件的全部事实，力图推翻检控方的指控。
examples.pinyin: Lǜshī zài fǎtíng shang xiáng细 chénshù le àn jiàn de quánbù shìshí, lìtú tuīfān jiǎnkòng fāng de zhǐkòng.
examples.english: The lawyer detailed all the facts of the case in court, attempting to overturn the prosecutor's accusations.

examples.chinese: 设计师巧妙地用深色的背景来衬托这件白色婚纱，使其显得更加优雅动人。
examples.pinyin: Shèjìshī qiǎomiào de yòng shēnsè de背景 lái chèntuō zhè jiàn báisè hūny纱, shǐ qī xiǎnde gèng jiājiǔ yōuyǎ dòngrén.
examples.english: The designer cleverly used a dark background to set off the white wedding dress, making it appear more elegant and moving.

examples.chinese: 趁着年轻的时候多出去旅行，等到老了就很难再有这样的机会了。
examples.pinyin: Chènzhe niánqīng de shíhou duō chūqù lǚxíng, děngdào lǎo le jiù hěn nán zài yǒu zhèyàng de jīhuì le.
examples.english: While you're young, travel as much as possible; once you're old, it will be much harder to have such opportunities again.

examples.chinese: 在经济危机期间，一些不良商人趁机哄抬物价，牟取暴利。
examples.pinyin: Zài jīngjì wēijī qījiān, yīxiē búliàng shāngrén chènjī hōngtái wùjià, móuqǔ bàolì.
examples.english: During the economic crisis, some unscrupulous merchants seized the opportunity to drive up prices and make excessive profits.

examples.chinese: 与其等到问题积重难返，不如趁早采取措施加以解决。
examples.pinyin: Yǔqī děngdào wèntí jīzhòng nánfǎn, búrú chènzǎo cǎiqǔ cuòshī jiāyǐ jiějué.
examples.english: Rather than waiting until problems become deeply rooted and difficult to remedy, it's better to take measures as soon as possible to resolve them.

examples.chinese: 趁着年轻有精力，我们应该多出去旅行，开阔视野。
examples.pinyin: Chènzhe niánqīng yǒu jīnglì, wǒmen yīnggāi duō chūqù lǚxíng, kāikuò shì野。
examples.english: While we're young and full of energy, we should travel more often to broaden our horizons.

examples.chinese: 在正式场合中，如何恰当地称呼对方是展现教养的重要方式。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhèngshì chǎngh合 zhōng, rúhé qiàdàng de chēnghu duìfang shì zhǎnxiàn jiàoyǎng de zhòngyào fāngshì.
examples.english: In formal occasions, how to address the other person appropriately is an important way to demonstrate one's refinement.

examples.chinese: 只有那些能够克服困难、坚持不懈的学生才有可能成才，最终在各自的领域有所建树。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu nàxiē néng gòu kèfúkùnnan, jiānchí búxié de xuésheng cái yǒu kěnéng chéng cái, zuìzhōng zài gèzì de lǐngyù yǒu suǒ jiànshù.
examples.english: Only those students who can overcome difficulties and persist relentlessly have the potential to make something of themselves and ultimately achieve accomplishments in their respective fields.

english: to settle down and get married (of a man)

examples.chinese: 他已经到了该成家立业的年纪，但仍然沉迷于事业的发展，暂时没有考虑结婚的计划。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng dàole gāi chéngjiā lìyè de niánjì, dànshì仍然 chénmí yú shìyè de fāzhǎn, zànshíjiān méiyǒu kǎolǜ jiéhūn de jìhuà.
examples.english: He has reached the age when he should settle down and establish a career, but he remains absorbed in his professional development and has not yet considered marriage plans.

examples.chinese: 他成年后就离开了家乡，到大城市去寻求自己的事业发展。
examples.pinyin: Tā chéng nián hòu jiù líkāi le jiāxiāng, dào dà chéngshì qù xúnqiú zìjǐ de shìyè fāzhǎn.
examples.english: After he grew into adulthood, he left his hometown and went to the big city to seek his own career development.

english: lit. by the thousands and tens of thousands (idiom)

examples.chinese: 每年有成千上万的游客涌入这座古城，希望能找到失落的文明遗迹。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián yǒu chéngqiān-shàngwàn de yóukè yǒngrù zhè zuò gǔchéng, xīwàng néng zhǎodào shīluò de wénmíng yíjī.
examples.english: Every year, tens of thousands of tourists flood into this ancient city, hoping to discover traces of lost civilizations.

examples.chinese: 周末时，游客们成群结队地涌入古镇，使得这个原本宁静的地方变得熙熙攘攘。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò shí, yóukèmen chéngqún-jiéduì de yǒngrù gǔzhèn, shǐde zhège yuánběn níngjìng de dìfang biànde xīxī-rǎngrǎng.
examples.english: On weekends, tourists flock to the ancient town in groups, turning this originally quiet place into a bustling crowd.

examples.chinese: 他成天埋头工作，都快忘记生活中还有其他有意义的事情了。
examples.pinyin: Tā chéngtiān máitóu gōngzuò, dōu kuài wàngjì shēnghuó zhōng háiyǒu qítā yǒuyìyì de shìqing le.
examples.english: He works with his head down all day long and has almost forgotten that there are other meaningful things in life.

examples.chinese: 如果员工的工作态度继续恶化，公司的声誉就会成问题。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ yuángōng de gōngzuò tàidù jìxù èhuà, gōngsī de shēngyù jiù huì chéng wèntí.
examples.english: If employees' work attitudes continue to deteriorate, the company's reputation will become a problem.

examples.chinese: 这个创业团队经过三年的磨练，终于成型了一套完整的商业模式。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chuàngyè tuánduì jīngguò sān nián de móliàn, zh终于 chéngxíng le yī tào wánzhěng de shāngyè móshì.
examples.english: After three years of refinement, the startup team finally developed a complete business model.

examples.chinese: 随着改革开放的深入，中国经济呈现出蓬勃发展的态势。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe gǎigé kāifàng de shēnrù, Zhōngguó jīngjì chéngxiàn chū péngbó fāzhǎn de tàishì.
examples.english: As reform and opening-up deepened, the Chinese economy assumed a vigorous development trend.

examples.chinese: 他用诚恳的语气向我道歉，我最终选择了原谅他。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng chéngkěn de yǔqì xiàng wǒ dàoqiàn, wǒ zuìzhōng xuǎnzé le yuánliàng tā.
examples.english: He apologized to me in a sincere tone, and I finally chose to forgive him.

examples.chinese: 他诚心诚意地向她道歉，希望能够修复这段破裂的友谊。
examples.pinyin: Tā chéngxīn-chéngyì de xiàng tā dàoqiànqiàn, xīwàng néng gòu xiūfù zhè duàn pòliè de yǒuyì.
examples.english: He apologized to her earnestly and sincerely, hoping to repair their broken friendship.

examples.chinese: 虽然他用了很多华丽的词汇，但我能感受到他的话里缺少诚意。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán tā yòngle hěnduō huálì de cíhuì, dàn wǒ néng gǎnshòu dào tā de huà lǐ quēshǎo chéngyì.
examples.english: Although he used a lot of flowery language, I could sense a lack of sincerity in his words.

examples.chinese: 他用诚挚的语气向多年未见的朋友表达了深深的歉意。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng chéngzhì de yǔqì xiàng duō nián wèi jiàn de péngyou biǎodáale shēnshēn de qiànyi.
examples.english: He expressed his deep apologies to his long-lost friend with a sincere tone.

examples.chinese: 这家建筑公司承包了整个城市基础设施的改造项目，预计需要三年才能完成。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā jiànzhù gōngsī chéngbāole zhěngge chéngshì jīchǔ shèshī de gǎizào xiàngmù, yùjì xūyào sān nián cái néng wánchéng.
examples.english: This construction company contracted the renovation project of the entire city's infrastructure, which is expected to take three years to complete.

examples.chinese: 这座古桥已经承载了几百年的历史，见证了无数代人的故事。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔ qiào yǐjīng chéngzài le jǐ bǎi nián de lìshǐ, jiànzhèng le wúshù dài rén de gùshì.
examples.english: This ancient bridge has borne centuries of history and witnessed the stories of countless generations.

examples.chinese: 这座古城的城墙虽然历经沧桑，但其建筑艺术仍然令人叹为观止。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔchéng de chéngqiáng suīrán lìjīng cāngsāng, dàn qī jiànzhù yìshù仍rán lìngrén tànwéiguānzhǐ.
examples.english: Although the city walls of this ancient city have experienced the vicissitudes of time, their architectural artistry still remains awe-inspiring.

english: to take advantage of sb's precarious position

examples.chinese: 那个商人趁着竞争对手资金困难，乘人之危地以极低的价格收购了他们的公司。
examples.pinyin: Nàge shāngrén chènzhe jìngjìng duìshǒu zījīn kùnnan, chéngrénzhīwēi de yǐ jídī de jiàgé shōugòule tāmen de gōngsī.
examples.english: That businessman took advantage of his competitor's financial difficulties and unethically acquired their company at an extremely low price.

examples.chinese: 在改革开放的年代，中国经济呈现出前所未有的繁荣盛景。
examples.pinyin: Zài gǎigé kāifàng de niándài, Zhōngguó jīngjì chéngxiàn chū qiánsuǒ wèiyǒu de繁荣盛景。
examples.english: During the era of reform and opening-up, China's economy presented an unprecedented prosperous scene.

examples.chinese: 那些腐败官员最终都被严厉惩处，这对整个社会起到了很大的警示作用。
examples.pinyin: Nàxiē fǔbài guānyuán zuìzhōng dōu bèi yánlì chéngchǔ, zhè duì zhěngge shèhuì qǐdàole hěnda jǐngshì zuòyòng.
examples.english: Those corrupt officials were ultimately severely punished, which had a significant deterrent effect on the entire society.

examples.chinese: 公司对那些违反职业道德的员工进行了严厉的惩罚，以维护企业的声誉。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī duì nàxiē wéifǎn zhíyè dàodé de yuángōng jìnxíngle yánlì de chéngfá, yǐ wéihù qǐyè de shēngyù.
examples.english: The company imposed strict penalties on employees who violated professional ethics in order to protect the company's reputation.

examples.chinese: 政府发言人召开记者会澄清了关于改革政策的种种误解。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ fāyán rén zhàokāi jìzhě huì chéngqīng le guānyú gǎigé zhèngcè de zhǒngzhǒng wùjiě.
examples.english: The government spokesperson held a press conference to clear up various misunderstandings about the reform policy.

examples.chinese: 这家咖啡馆的橙汁是用新鲜橙子现榨的，喝起来酸度和甜度的平衡恰到好处。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā kāfēiguǎn de chéngzhī shì yòng xīnxiān chéngzi xiànzhá de, hēqǐlai suāndu hé tiándu de pínghuà qià dào hǎochù.
examples.english: The orange juice at this café is freshly squeezed from fresh oranges, and when you drink it, the balance between acidity and sweetness is just right.

examples.chinese: 他总是喜欢在朋友面前逞能，最后反而出了丑。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì xǐhuān zài péngyou miànqián chěngnéng, zuìhòu fǎn'ér chūle chǒu.
examples.english: He always likes to show off his abilities in front of friends, but in the end he embarrassed himself instead.

examples.chinese: 他总是喜欢在朋友面前逞强，实际上内心充满了不安全感。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì xǐhuān zài péngyou miànqián chěng qiáng, shíjì shang nèixīn chōngmǎnle búānquán gǎn.
examples.english: He always likes to show off in front of friends, but in reality his heart is full of insecurity.

examples.chinese: 这台老秤虽然已经用了几十年，但精准度依然令人惊叹。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái lǎo chèng suīrán yǐjīng yòngle jǐ shí nián, dàn jīngzhǔn dù yīrán lìng rén jīngtàn.
examples.english: Although this old scale has been used for decades, its accuracy is still remarkable.

english: unable to get anything to eat

examples.chinese: 由于疫情封控，许多外来务工者被困在城里，一度吃不上家乡的饭菜。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú yìqíng fēngkòng, xǔduō wàilái wùgōng zhě bèi kùn zài chénglǐ, yīdù chībushàng jiāxiāng de fàncài.
examples.english: Due to pandemic lockdowns, many migrant workers were stranded in the city and for a while couldn't get their hometown food to eat.

examples.chinese: 他们年轻时整天吃喝玩乐，从不考虑未来的后果，直到事业失败才醒悟过来。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen niánqīng shí zhěngtiān chīhē-wánlè, cóngbuː kǎolǜ wèiláide hòuuǒ, zhídào shìyè shībài cái xǐngwù guòlái.
examples.english: When they were young, they spent all their time indulging in eating, drinking, and entertainment, never considering the consequences for the future, until their careers failed and they finally woke up.

examples.chinese: 他年轻时吃了很多苦，才有今天的成就，这段经历对他的人生观产生了深远的影响。
examples.pinyin: Tā niánqīng shí chīle hěnduō kǔ, cái yǒu jīntiān de chéngjiù, zhè duàn jīnglì duì tā de rénshēngguān chǎnshēngle shēnyuǎn de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: He bore great hardships when he was young, which enabled him to achieve what he has today; this experience had a profound impact on his outlook on life.

examples.chinese: 在这次商业谈判中，由于我们准备不充分，最后还是吃亏了。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè cì shāngyè tánpàn zhōng, yóuyú wǒmen zhǔnbèi búchōngfèn, zuìhòu háishi chīkuī le.
examples.english: In this business negotiation, because we were not well prepared, we ultimately got the worst of it.

examples.chinese: 长期的社交隔离可能导致老年人认知能力衰退，甚至引发痴呆症状。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī de shèjiāo gélì kěnéng dǎozhì lǎoniánrén rènzhī néng力 衰tuì, shènzhì yǐnfā chīdāi zhèngzhuàng.
examples.english: Prolonged social isolation may lead to cognitive decline in the elderly and even trigger symptoms of dementia.

examples.chinese: 他多年来痴迷于收集古董，几乎把所有的积蓄都花在了这个爱好上。
examples.pinyin: Tā duō nián lái chīmí yú shōují gǔdǒng, jīhū bǎ suǒyǒu de jīzhù dōu huā zài le zhège àihào shang.
examples.english: He has been infatuated with collecting antiques for years, spending almost all his savings on this hobby.

examples.chinese: 他多年痴心于书法艺术，最终成为了一位享誉国际的书法家。
examples.pinyin: Tā duō nián chīxīn yú shūfǎ yìshù, zuìzh終chéng wéi le yī wèi xiǎngyùyú guójì de shūfǎ jiā.
examples.english: After years of devoted dedication to calligraphy art, he eventually became a renowned calligrapher known internationally.

examples.chinese: 那个古老的池塘映照着周围的建筑，成为了这座古镇最具诗意的景观。
examples.pinyin: Nàge gǔlǎo de chítáng yìngzhào zhe zhōuwéi de jiànzhù, chéngwéi le zhè zuò gǔzhèn zuì jù shīyì de jǐngguān.
examples.english: The ancient pool reflected the surrounding buildings, becoming the most poetic scenery of this old town.

examples.chinese: 这个老字号在业界驰名已久，但年轻一代消费者对它的认知度反而在下降。
examples.pinyin: Zhège lǎozìhào zài yèjiè chímíng yǐjiǔ, dàn niánqīng yīdài xiāofèizhě duì tā de rènzhī dù f反而 zài xiàjiàng.
examples.english: This time-honored brand has been famous in the industry for a long time, but its recognition among younger consumers is actually declining.

examples.chinese: 尽管公司投入了大量资源，但新产品的上市计划迟迟未能推进，这让投资者感到担忧。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn gōngsī tóuruò le dàliàng zīyuán, dàn xīn chǎnpǐn de shàngshì jìhuà chíchí wèi néng tuījìn, zhè ràng tóuzīzhě gǎndào dānhuǒu.
examples.english: Although the company invested substantial resources, the launch plan for the new product has been repeatedly delayed, which made investors feel concerned.

examples.chinese: 他在签署合同前迟疑了片刻，最终还是决定放弃这个机会。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài qiānshǔ hétonɡ qián chíyí le piànkè, zuìzhōnɡ háishi juédinɡ fànɡqì zhège jīhuì.
examples.english: He hesitated for a moment before signing the contract, but ultimately decided to give up the opportunity.

examples.chinese: 如果你继续这样挥霍金钱，迟早会面临财务危机。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ jìixù zhèyàng huīhuò jīnqián, chízǎo huì miànlín cáiwù wēijī.
examples.english: If you keep squandering money like this, you'll sooner or later face a financial crisis.

examples.chinese: 这家公司长期持有这些股票，相信其未来的增长潜力。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī chángqī chíyǒu zhèxiē gǔpiào, xiāngxìn qī wèilái de zēngzhǎng qiánlì.
examples.english: This company has been holding these stocks long-term, believing in their future growth potential.

examples.chinese: 要想在这个行业中取得成功，必须有持久的热情和坚定的决心。
examples.pinyin: Yào xiǎng zài zhège hángyè zhōng qǔdé chénggōng, bìxū yǒu chíjiǔ de règíng hé坚定 de juéxin.
examples.english: To succeed in this industry, one must have lasting passion and unwavering determination.

examples.chinese: 要想在学术研究上取得成就，必须持之以恒地投入时间和精力，不能因为一时的挫折就放弃。
examples.pinyin: Yào xiǎng zài xuéshù yánjiū shang qǔ dé chéngjiù, bìxū chízhīyǐhéng de tóurù shíjiān hé jīnglì, búnéng yīnwèi yīshí de cuòzhé jiù fàngqì.
examples.english: To achieve success in academic research, one must pursue unremittingly by investing time and effort, and cannot give up because of temporary setbacks.

examples.chinese: 这个政策的尺度把握得很好，既保护了环境，又不会过度限制企业的发展。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhèngcè de chǐdù báwò de hěn hǎo, jì bǎohùle huanjìng, yòu búhuì guòdù xiànzhì qǐyè de fāzhǎn.
examples.english: The measure of this policy is well-balanced; it protects the environment while not excessively restricting business development.

examples.chinese: 那次失败对他来说是一种耻辱,他决心要通过更加努力的工作来洗刷这个耻辱。
examples.pinyin: Nà cì shībài duìyú tā lái shuō shì yī zhǒng chǐrǔ, tā juéxīn yào tōngguò gèngjiā nǔlì de gōngzuò lái xǐshuā zhège chǐrǔ.
examples.english: That failure was a disgrace for him, and he was determined to wash away this shame through even more diligent work.

examples.chinese: 那些自以为是的评论家耻笑他的理论,但最终的实验结果证明了他的正确性。
examples.pinyin: Nàxiē zìyǐwéishì de píngluùnjiā chǐxiào tā de lǐlùn, dàn zuìzh终de shíyàn jiéguǒ zhèngmíng le tā de zhèngquèxìng.
examples.english: Those arrogant critics sneered at his theory, but the final experimental results ultimately proved him correct.

examples.chinese: 由于出口下滑和国内消费不足，该国今年的财政赤字达到了历史新高。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú chūkǒu xiàhuá hé guónèi xiāofèi búzú, gāi guó jīnnián de càizhèng chìzì dádàole lìshǐ xīngāo.
examples.english: Due to declining exports and insufficient domestic consumption, the country's fiscal deficit this year has reached a historic high.

examples.chinese: 这只受伤的鹰即使折断了翅膀，也依然展现出了顽强的生命力。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī shòushāng de yīng jíshǐ zhéduàn le chìbǎng, yě yīrán zhǎnxiàn chū le wánqiáng de shēngmìng lì.
examples.english: Despite having its wings broken, this injured eagle still demonstrated a tenacious will to survive.

examples.chinese: 在最后的冲刺阶段，这家初创公司投入了大量资金来抢占市场份额。
examples.pinyin: Zài zuìhòu de chōngcì jiēduàn, zhè jiā chūshǐ gōngsī tóurù le dàliàng zījīn lái qiǎngzhàn shìchǎng fèn'é.
examples.english: In the final sprint phase, this startup company invested substantial capital to seize market share.

examples.chinese: 他每个周末都坚持去海边冲浪，即使天气恶劣也从不间断。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi ge zhōumò dōu jiānchí qù hǎibiān chōnglàng, jíshǐ tiānqì èliè yě cóngbù jiānduàn.
examples.english: He insists on going to the beach to surf every weekend, never stopping even in bad weather.

examples.chinese: 摄影师在暗房里仔细冲洗底片，确保每一个细节都能清晰呈现。
examples.pinyin: Shèyǐngshī zài ànfáng lǐ zǐxì chōngxǐ dǐpiàn, quèbǎo měi yī ge细节 dōu néng qīngxī chéngxiàn.
examples.english: The photographer carefully rinsed the film negatives in the darkroom to ensure every detail could be clearly presented.

examples.chinese: 那辆出租车突然转向，几乎与对面的卡车发生了冲撞，幸好双方司机都反应迅速。
examples.pinyin: Nà liàng chūzūchē túrán zhuǎnxiàng, jīhū yǔ duìmiàn de kǎchē fāshēngle le chōngzhuàng, xìnghǎo shuāngfāng sījī dōu fǎnyìng xùnsù.
examples.english: That taxi suddenly swerved and nearly collided with a truck coming from the opposite direction, but fortunately both drivers reacted quickly.

examples.chinese: 这个项目的预算充足，但我们仍然需要充分利用每一笔资金。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de yùsuàn chōngzú, dàn wǒmen仍然 xūyào chōngfèn lìyòng měi yī bǐ zījīn.
examples.english: Although this project has sufficient budget, we still need to make full use of every penny.

examples.chinese: 在这个项目中，他充当了桥梁的角色，促进了不同部门之间的沟通与合作。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège xiàngmù zhōng, tā chōngdāng le qiáoliáng de juésè, cùjìn le búyītóng bùmén zhījiān de gōutōng yǔ hézuò.
examples.english: In this project, he served as a bridge, promoting communication and collaboration between different departments.

examples.chinese: 这位企业家拥有充沛的精力和远见卓识，带领公司在激烈的市场竞争中脱颖而出。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi qǐyèjiājiā yōuyǒu chōngpèi de jīnghuà hé yuǎnjiàn zhuóshí, dàilǐng gōngsī zài jīliè de shìchǎng jìngjìng zhōng tuōyǐngér chūlái.
examples.english: This entrepreneur possesses abundant energy and remarkable foresight, leading the company to stand out amid fierce market competition.

examples.chinese: 这次海外交流经历充实了我对不同文化的理解，让我的人生阅历变得更加丰富。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì hǎiwài jiāoliú jīnglì chōngshíle wǒ duì búyīyàng wénhuà de lǐjiě, ràng wǒ de rénshēng yuèlì biàn de gèngjiā fēngfù.
examples.english: This overseas exchange experience substantiated my understanding of different cultures, making my life experience much more enriched.

examples.chinese: 由于收视率很高，电视台决定在黄金时段重播那部获奖纪录片。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú shōushìlǜ hěn gāo, diànshìtái juédìng zài huángjīn shíduàn chóngbō nàbù huòjiǎng jìlùpiàn.
examples.english: Because of the high ratings, the TV station decided to replay the award-winning documentary during prime time.

examples.chinese: 这两个时期的历史事件存在着许多重叠之处，很难清楚地区分开来。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge shíqī de lìshǐ shìjiàn cúnzàizhe xǔduō chóngdié zhī chù, hěn nán qīngchǔ de qūfēn kāilái.
examples.english: There are many overlapping aspects between the historical events of these two periods, making it difficult to distinguish them clearly.

examples.chinese: 经过多年的沉寂，这位资深演员终于重返舞台，为观众呈现了一部精彩的话剧。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò duō nián de chénnjì, zhè wèi zīshēn yǎnyuán终于 chóngfǎn wǔtái, wèi guānzhòng chéngxiàn le yī bù jīngcǎi de huàjù.
examples.english: After years of silence, this veteran actor finally returned to the stage, presenting the audience with an outstanding theatrical performance.

examples.chinese: 政府发言人在记者会上重申了对环保政策的承诺，尽管面临来自工业界的压力。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ fāyánrén zài jìzhěhuì shang chóngshēnle duì huánbǎo zhèngcè de chéngnuò, jìnguǎn miànlín lái zì gōngyèjiè de yālì.
examples.english: The government spokesperson reaffirmed the government's commitment to environmental protection at the press conference, despite pressure from the industrial sector.

examples.chinese: 经过几十年的沉寂，这位老艺术家终于在国际舞台上重现了昔日的风采。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò jǐ shí nián de chénnjì, zhè wèi lǎo yìshùjiā终于 zài guójì wǔtái shang chóngxiàn le xīrì de fēngcǎi.
examples.english: After decades of obscurity, this elderly artist finally reappeared on the international stage with his former glory.

examples.chinese: 这两份合同的条款几乎完全重合，说明双方的谈判目标已经达成了共识。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng fèn héntóng de tiáokuǎn jīhū wánquán chónghé, shuōmíng shuāngfāng de tánpàn mùbiāo yǐjīng dáchéngle gòngshí.
examples.english: The terms of these two contracts almost completely match, indicating that both parties have reached a consensus on their negotiation objectives.

examples.chinese: 他虽然出身贫寒，但始终坚守着崇高的理想信念，这种精神令人敬佩。
examples.pinyin: Tā suīrán chūnshēn pínhán, dàn shǐzhōng jiānshǒu zhe chónggāo de lǐxiǎng xìnniàn, zhè zhǒng jīngshén lìng rén jìngpèi.
examples.english: Although he came from humble beginnings, he always upheld lofty ideals and beliefs, a spirit that is truly admirable.

examples.chinese: 在当代社会，越来越多的年轻人崇尚环保和可持续发展的生活方式。
examples.pinyin: Zài dāngdài shèhuì, yuèláiyuè duō de niánqīngrén chóngshàng huánbǎo hé kěchíxù fāzhǎn de shēnghuó fāngshì.
examples.english: In contemporary society, an increasing number of young people advocate for and uphold environmentally friendly and sustainable lifestyles.

examples.chinese: 他那被宠坏的儿子最后因为挥霍无度而家财散尽。
examples.pinyin: Tā nà bèi chǒnghuài de érzi zuìhòu yīnwèi huīhuò wúdù ér jiācái sǎnjìn.
examples.english: His spoiled son eventually squandered the family fortune due to his extravagant spending.

examples.chinese: 这位老董事长对他的小儿子特别宠爱，以至于在公司里引起了不少非议。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎo dǒngshìzhǎng duì tā de xiǎo érzi tèbié chǒngài, yǐzhìyú zài gōngsī lǐ yǐnqǐle búshǎo fēiyì.
examples.english: This elderly chairman dotes excessively on his youngest son, which has caused considerable criticism within the company.

examples.chinese: 为了公平起见，我们决定抽签来决定谁先发言。
examples.pinyin: Wèile gōngpíng qǐjiàn, wǒmen juéding chōuqiān lái juéding shéi xiān fāyán.
examples.english: In the interest of fairness, we decided to draw lots to determine who would speak first.

examples.chinese: 他在办公室的抽屉里藏了一份机密文件，生怕被同事发现。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài bàngōngshì de chōuti lǐ cángle yī fèn jīmì wénjiàn, shēngpà bèi tóngshì fāxiàn.
examples.english: He hid a classified document in the drawer of his office desk, fearing that his colleagues would discover it.

examples.chinese: 这位艺术家用抽象的几何图形表达了内心复杂的情感世界。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi yìshùjiā yòng chōuxiàng de jǐhéxué túxíng biǎodále nèixīn fùzá de qíngǎn shìjiè.
examples.english: This artist expressed the complex emotional world of their inner self through abstract geometric shapes.

examples.chinese: 仇教授在大学里教了三十年的文学课程，他的学生遍布世界各地。
examples.pinyin: Qiú jiàoshòu zài dàxué lǐ jiāole sānshí nián de wénxué kèchéng, tā de xuésheng biàny布 shìjiè gèdì.
examples.english: Professor Qiu taught literature courses at the university for thirty years, and his students are scattered all over the world.

examples.chinese: 长期的仇恨往往会蒙蔽人的理性，使人做出后悔终身的决定。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī de chóuhèn wǎngwǎng huì méngbì rén de lǐxìng, shǐ rén zuòchū huǐhuǐ zh終shēng de juédìng.
examples.english: Long-standing hatred often blinds people's rationality, causing them to make decisions they regret for life.

examples.chinese: 他花了二十年时间追捕那个仇人，最终在一个偏远的山村里找到了他。
examples.pinyin: Tā huāle èrshí nián shíjiān zhuībǔ nàge chóurén, zuìzhōng zài yige piānoyuǎn de shāncūn lǐ zhǎodàole tā.
examples.english: He spent twenty years pursuing that foe, and finally found him in a remote mountain village.

examples.chinese: 这种传统工艺制作的糖浆特别稠，需要用特殊的工具才能涂抹均匀。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng chuántǒng gōngyì zhìzuò de tángjiāng tèbié chóu, xūyào yòng tèshū de gōngjù cái néng túmǒ yún匀。
examples.english: The syrup made by this traditional craft is particularly dense, requiring special tools to spread it evenly.

examples.chinese: 这片热带雨林的植被非常稠密，阳光几乎无法透过树叶照射到地面。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piàn règdài yǔlín de zhíbèi fēicháng chóumì, yángguāng jīhū wúfǎ tòuguò shùyè zhàoshè dào dìmiàn.
examples.english: The vegetation in this tropical rainforest is extremely dense, and sunlight can barely penetrate through the leaves to reach the ground.

examples.chinese: 听到公司要裁员的消息后，他整天愁眉苦脸，同事们都能看出他心里的忧虑。
examples.pinyin: Tīngdào gōngsī yào cáiyuán de xiāoxi hòu, tā zhěngtiān chóuméi-kǔliǎn, tóngshìmen dōu néng kànchū tā xīnli de yōulǜ.
examples.english: After hearing the news that the company would be laying off employees, he looked anxious all day long, and his colleagues could all see the worry in his heart.

examples.chinese: 他在赌桌上推了一把筹码，决定孤注一掷。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài dǔzhuō shang tuīle yībǎ chóumǎ, juédìng gūzhù yīzhì.
examples.english: He pushed a stack of chips across the gambling table, determined to go all in.

examples.chinese: 公司正在筹办一场大型的国际会议，需要协调各个部门的工作。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī zhèngzài chóubàn yī chǎng dàxíng de guójì huìyì, xūyào xiétiáo gège bùmén de gōngzuò.
examples.english: The company is arranging a large-scale international conference, which requires coordinating the work of various departments.

examples.chinese: 政府正在筹措资金用于基础设施建设，以应对经济下行的压力。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zhèngzài chóucuò zījīn yònyú jīchǔ shèshī jiànshè, yǐ yìngduì jīngjì xiàxíng de yālì.
examples.english: The government is raising funds for infrastructure construction to address the pressure of economic downturn.

examples.chinese: 公司正在筹划一个大规模的海外扩张项目，预计明年就能启动。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī zhèngzài chóuhuà yīgè dà guīmó de hǎiwài kuòzhāng xiàngmù, yùjì míngniān jiù néng qǐdòng.
examples.english: The company is currently planning a large-scale overseas expansion project, which is expected to launch next year.

examples.chinese: 在这场谈判中，掌握足够的筹码才能争取到更好的条件。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè chǎng tánpàn zhōng, zhǎngwò zúgòu de chóumǎ cái néng zhēngqǔ dào gèng hǎo de tiáojiàn.
examples.english: In this negotiation, only by holding sufficient leverage can one secure better terms.

examples.chinese: 公司正在筹备上市，需要完成一系列复杂的法律程序和财务审计。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī zhèngzài chóubèi shàngshì, xūyào wánchéng yī xìliè fùzá de fǎlǜ chéngxù hé cáiwù shěnjì.
examples.english: The company is preparing to go public and needs to complete a series of complex legal procedures and financial audits.

examples.chinese: 这个慈善机构花了三年时间才筹集到足够的资金来建设这家医院。
examples.pinyin: Zhège císhàn jīgòu huāle sān nián shíjiān cái chóují dào zúggòu de zījīn lái jiànshè zhè jiā yīyuàn.
examples.english: It took this charity organization three years to collect enough funds to build this hospital.

examples.chinese: 那些贪官污吏的丑恶行径终于被曝光了，引起了全社会的愤怒。
examples.pinyin: Nàxiē tānguān wūlì de chǒuè xíngjì终于 bèi bàoguāng le, yǐnqǐ le quán shèhuì de fènnù.
examples.english: The ugly deeds of those corrupt officials were finally exposed, arousing public anger throughout society.

examples.chinese: 这座建筑物的设计虽然丑陋，但却体现了那个时代独特的美学理念。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò jiànzhúwù de shèjì suīrán chǒulòu, dàn却 tǐxiàn le nàge shídài dúté de měixué lǐniàn.
examples.english: Although the design of this building is ugly, it reflects the unique aesthetic philosophy of that era.

examples.chinese: 这位高官因为贪污丑闻的曝光而被迫辞职，引发了社会各界的广泛讨论。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi gāoguān yīnwèi tānwū chǒuwén de báoguāng ér bèi pòshuài cízhí, yǐnfāle shèhuì gèjiè de guǎngfàn tǎolùn.
examples.english: The high-ranking official was forced to resign due to the exposure of a corruption scandal, which sparked widespread discussion across society.

examples.chinese: 他瞅了一眼我的论文，就指出了几个明显的逻辑漏洞。
examples.pinyin: Tā chǒule yī yǎn wǒ de lùnwén, jiù zhǐchūle jǐ ge míngxiǎn de luójí lòudòng.
examples.english: He took a glance at my paper and immediately pointed out several obvious logical flaws.

examples.chinese: 这家出版社最近出版了几部获得国际文学奖的作品，在业界的影响力不断提升。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā chūbǎnshè zuìjìn chūbǎnle jǐ bù huòdé guójì wénxué jiǎng de zuòpǐn, zài yèjiè de yǐngxiǎnglì búduàn tíshēng.
examples.english: This publisher recently published several award-winning literary works that have won international recognition, and its influence in the industry continues to grow.

english: to leave the factory (of finished goods)

examples.chinese: 这批产品需要经过严格的质量检测才能出厂，确保每一件都符合国际标准。
examples.pinyin: Zhè pī chǎnpǐn xūyào jīngguò yánggé de zhìliàng jiǎncè cái néng chūchǎng, quèbǎo měi yī jiàn dōu fúhéhé guójì biāozhǔn.
examples.english: This batch of products must undergo rigorous quality inspection before leaving the factory to ensure that each item meets international standards.

examples.chinese: 他在公众面前失言，生怕会出丑，结果反而引起了大家的嘲笑。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài gōngzhòng miànqián shīyán, shēngpà huì chūchǒu, jiéguǒ fǎn'ér yǐnqǐle dàjiā de cháoxiào.
examples.english: He misspoke in front of the public and was terrified of making a fool of himself, but ironically ended up drawing everyone's mockery instead.

english: to make one's first public performance (of an entertainer etc)

examples.chinese: 这位歌手出道不到两年就赢得了多项国际大奖，令业界感到惊叹。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi gēshǒu chūdào búdào liǎng nián jiù yíngdé le duō xiàng guójì dàjiǎng, lìng yèjiè gǎndào jīngtàn.
examples.english: This singer won multiple international awards in less than two years after making her debut, which astonished the industry.

examples.chinese: 我们需要重新审视这个项目的出发点，看看是否与现在的市场需求相符。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào chóngxīn shěnshì zhège xiàngmù de chūfādiǎn, kànkan shìfǒu yǔ xiànzài de shìchǎng xūqiú xiāngfú.
examples.english: We need to re-examine the original premise of this project to see if it aligns with current market demands.

examples.chinese: 他总是喜欢在公司会议上出风头，说一些没有实际意义的话来吸引上司的注意。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì xǐhuān zài gōngsī huìyì shang chū fēngtou, shuō yīxiē méiyǒu shíjì yìyì de huà lái xīyǐn shàngsi de zhùyì.
examples.english: He always likes to show off in company meetings, saying meaningless things to attract his boss's attention.

english: to leave a country or region

examples.chinese: 由于疫情的影响，许多人在出境旅游前都需要提供核酸检测证明。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú yìqíng de yǐngxiǎng, xǔduō rén zài chūjìng lǚyóu qián dōu xūyào tígōng hésuān jiǎncè zhèngmíng.
examples.english: Due to the impact of the pandemic, many people need to provide a nucleic acid test certificate before traveling abroad.

examples.chinese: 由于战略失误，这家曾经的行业龙头最终被迫出局了市场竞争。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú zhànlüè shīwù, zhè jiā céngjīng de hángyè lóngtóu zuìzh终 bèipò chūjú le shìchǎng jìngjìng.
examples.english: Due to strategic mistakes, this once industry-leading company was ultimately forced out of market competition.

examples.chinese: 律师需要出具法律意见书来证明合同的有效性。
examples.pinyin: Lǜshī xūyào chūjù fǎlǜ yìjiàn shū lái zhèngmíng hétonɡ de yǒuxiàoxìng.
examples.english: The lawyer needs to issue a legal opinion letter to prove the validity of the contract.

english: to speak like a printed book

examples.chinese: 这位著名作家出口成章，随便说几句话都能成为经典语录。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zhùmíng zuòjiā chūkǒu-chéngzhāng, suíbiàn shuō jǐ jù huà dōu néng chéngwéi jīngdiǎn yǔlù.
examples.english: This famous writer speaks like a printed book; whatever he says casually becomes a classic quote.

examples.chinese: 他为了金钱出卖了自己的朋友和原则，最终被所有人唾弃。
