examples.pinyin: Tā wèile jīnqián chūmài le zìjǐ de péngyou hé yuánzé, zuìzhōng bèi suǒyǒurén tuòqì.
examples.english: He sold out his friends and principles for money, and was ultimately despised by everyone.

examples.chinese: 这台机器最近总是出毛病，维修费都快赶上买新的了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái jīqì zuìjìn zǒngshì chū máobìng, wéixiū fèi dōu kuài gǎnshàng mǎi xīn de le.
examples.english: This machine has been constantly breaking down lately; the repair costs are almost catching up to buying a new one.

examples.chinese: 面试官故意出难题来考察应聘者的临场反应和解决问题的能力。
examples.pinyin: Miànshìguān gùyì chū nántí lái kǎochá yìngpìnzhě de línchǎng fǎnyìng hé jiějué wèntí de nénghuà.
examples.english: The interviewer intentionally raises tough questions to assess the candidates' on-the-spot reactions and problem-solving abilities.

examples.chinese: 这次谈判的结果出人意料，双方竟然在短短三天内就达成了协议。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì tánpàn de jiéguǒ chūrényìliào, shuāngfāng jìngrán zài duǎnduǎn sān tiān nèi jiù dáchéngle xiéyì.
examples.english: The outcome of this negotiation was unexpected; both parties surprisingly reached an agreement in just three days.

examples.chinese: 他在去年出任公司CEO后，立即启动了一系列大胆的改革措施。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài qùnián chūrèn gōngsī CEO hòu, lìjí qǐdòng le yī xìliè dàdǎn de gǎigé cuòshī.
examples.english: After taking up the post of CEO last year, he immediately launched a series of bold reform measures.

english: to leave the mountain (of a hermit)

examples.chinese: 这位隐居多年的书法家最近决定出山，将在国家博物馆举办他的首次个人展览。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi yǐnjū duō nián de shūfǎjiā zuìjìn juédìng chūshān, jiāng zài guójiā bówùguǎn jǔbàn tā de shǒu cì gèrén zhǎnlǎn.
examples.english: This calligrapher who has been in seclusion for many years has recently decided to come out of retirement and will hold his first solo exhibition at the National Museum.

examples.chinese: 他虽然出身贫寒,但通过自己的努力最终成为了一位杰出的科学家。
examples.pinyin: Tā suīrán chūshēn pínhán, dàn tōngguò zìjǐ de nǔlì zuìzhōng chéngwéile yī wèi jiéchū de kēxuéjiā.
examples.english: Despite his humble class origin, he eventually became a distinguished scientist through his own hard work.

examples.chinese: 警察要求驾驶员出示驾照和行驶证。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá yāoqiú jiàshǐyuán chūshì jiàzhào hé xíngshǐzhèng.
examples.english: The police officer requested that the driver show their driver's license and vehicle registration.

examples.chinese: 这件古董一直放在仓库里，直到最近才决定出手。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn gǔdòng yīzhí fàngzài cāngkù lǐ, zhídào zuìjìn cái juédìng chūshǒu.
examples.english: This antique had been stored in the warehouse until recently when they finally decided to dispose of it.

english: to get out of a predicament

examples.chinese: 经过多年的努力和坚持，他终于从困境中出了头，成为了业界的领军人物。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò duō nián de nǔlì hé jiānchí, tā zh终于 cóng kùnjìng zhōng chūle tóu, chéngwéile yèjiè de lǐngjūn rénwù.
examples.english: After years of hard work and perseverance, he finally got out of his predicament and became a leading figure in the industry.

examples.chinese: 考古学家在这个古墓中出土了大量珍贵的陶器和青铜器，为研究这个文明提供了宝贵的证据。
examples.pinyin: Kǎogǔ xuéjiā zài zhège gǔmù zhōng chūtǔ le dàliàng zhēnguì de táoqì hé qīngtóngqì, wèi yánjiū zhège wénmíng tígōngle báoguì de zhèngjù.
examples.english: Archaeologists unearthed a large quantity of precious pottery and bronze vessels in this ancient tomb, providing valuable evidence for studying this civilization.

examples.chinese: 把闲钱放在银行里也能出息，但收益率远不如投资股票。
examples.pinyin: Bǎ xiánqián fàngzài yínháng lǐ yě néng chūxi, dàn shōuyìlǜ yuǎn búrú tóuzī gǔpiào.
examples.english: Putting idle money in the bank can also yield interest, but the return rate is far inferior to investing in stocks.

examples.chinese: 这名患者因为严重的内脏出血，医生不得不进行紧急手术来挽救他的生命。
examples.pinyin: Zhè míng huànzhě yīnwèi yánzhòu de nèizàng chūxiě, yīshēng búdébu进行 jǐnjí shǒushù lái wǎnjiù tā de shēngmìng.
examples.english: Because this patient suffered from severe internal bleeding, the doctor had no choice but to perform emergency surgery to save his life.

examples.chinese: 这位著名演员在最新的电影中出演了一个复杂的角色，获得了影评家的一致好评。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zhùmíng yǎnyuán zài zuìxīn de diànyǐng zhōng chūyǎnle yīgè fùzá de juésè, huòdéle yǐngpǐng jiā de yīzhì hǎopíng.
examples.english: This renowned actor played a complex character in the latest film and received unanimous praise from critics.

english: to make a fool of oneself

examples.chinese: 他在国际会议上用蹩脚的英语发言，结果出了大洋相，让整个代表团都感到尴尬。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài guójì huìyì shang yòng biéjiǎo de yīngyǔ fāyán, jiéguǒ chūle dà yángxiàng, ràng zhěngge dàibiǎo tuán dōu gǎndào gānggà.
examples.english: He made a speech in broken English at the international conference, which resulted in a major embarrassment, making the entire delegation feel awkward.

examples.chinese: 尽管天气预报说会下雨，但我们还是决定周末出游，因为错过这次机会就得等到下个月了。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tiānqì yùbào shuō huì xiàyǔ, dàn wǒmen háishi juéding zhōumò chūyóu, yīnwèi cuòguò zhè cì jīhuì jiù děi děngdào xiàge yuè le.
examples.english: Although the weather forecast predicted rain, we still decided to go on a tour over the weekend, because missing this opportunity meant having to wait until next month.

examples.chinese: 在这个竞争激烈的行业里，只有那些真正出众的人才能脱颖而出。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège jìngjìng jīliè de hángyè lǐ, zhǐyǒu nàxiē zhēnzhèng chūzhòng de rén cái néng tuōyǐng ér chū.
examples.english: In this highly competitive industry, only those who truly stand out can emerge from the crowd.

examples.chinese: 在这个困难的局面中，只有李经理能够出主意，帮助公司度过危机。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège kùnnan de júmiàn zhōng, zhǐyǒu Lǐ jīnglǐ néng gòu chū zhǔyì, bāngzhù gōngsī dùguò wēijī.
examples.english: In this difficult situation, only Manager Li was able to come up with a solution to help the company overcome the crisis.

examples.chinese: 几家大企业联合出资建设这个基础设施项目，预计投入资金超过十亿元。
examples.pinyin: Jǐ jiā dà qǐyè liánhé chūzī jiànshè zhège jīchǔ shèshī xiàngmù, yùjì tóurù zījīn chāoguò shí yì yuán.
examples.english: Several major enterprises jointly funded the construction of this infrastructure project, with an estimated investment exceeding one billion yuan.

examples.chinese: 这部经典著作出自一位默默无闻的乡村教师之手，却对后世产生了深远的影响。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù jīngdiǎn zhùzuò chūzì yī wèi mòmòwúwén de xiāngcūn jiàoshī zhī shǒu, què duì hòushì chǎnshēngle shēnyuǎn de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: This classic work came from the hand of an obscure rural teacher, yet it had a profound impact on posterity.

examples.chinese: 我初次见到这位大师时，他那深邃的眼神给我留下了深刻的印象。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chūcì jiàndào zhè wèi dàshī shí, tā nà shēnyuàn de yǎnshén gěi wǒ liúxià le shēnkè de yìnxiàng.
examples.english: When I first met this master, his profound gaze left a deep impression on me.

examples.chinese: 这位知名导演因为与制片公司的分歧而愤然出走，随后成立了自己的独立电影工作室。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zhīmíng dǎoyǎnjiā yīnwèi yǔ zhìpiàn gōngsī de fēnqī érhuà fènnránchū zǒu, suíhòu chénglìle zìjǐ de dúlì diànyǐng gōngzuò shìjiān.
examples.english: This renowned film director angrily left after disagreements with the production company, and subsequently established his own independent film studio.

examples.chinese: 尽管经历了这么多挫折，他始终没有忘记自己创办这家公司的初衷。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn jīng历le zhème duō cuòzhé, tā shǐzhōng méiyǒu wàngjì zìjǐ chuàngbàn zhè jiā gōngsī de chūzhōng.
examples.english: Despite experiencing so many setbacks, he never forgot his original intention when founding this company.

examples.chinese: 除此之外，他还在多家跨国公司担任顾问，对国际贸易有深入的研究。
examples.pinyin: Chúcǐ zhīwài, tā háizài duō jiā kuàguó gōngsī dānrèn gùwèn, duì guójì màoyì yǒu shēnrù de yánjiū.
examples.english: Additionally, he also serves as a consultant at several multinational corporations and has conducted in-depth research on international trade.

examples.chinese: 要想提高工作效率，必须除去那些无谓的繁琐程序。
examples.pinyin: Yàoxiǎng tígāo gōngzuò xiàolǜ, bìxū chúqù nàxiē wúwèi de fánsuǒ chéngxù.
examples.english: To improve work efficiency, it is necessary to eliminate those unnecessary tedious procedures.

examples.chinese: 除了市场营销部门除外，其他所有部门都需要参加这次组织改革。
examples.pinyin: Chúle shìchǎng yíngxiāo bùmén chúwài, qítā suǒyǒu bùmén dōu xūyào cānjiā zhè cì zǔzhī gǎigé.
examples.english: With the exception of the marketing department, all other departments need to participate in this organizational reform.

examples.chinese: 医生开出的处方必须由持证药师审核，确保用药安全。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng kāichū de chǔfāng bìxū yóu chízhèng yàoshī shěnhé, quèbǎo yòngyào ānquán.
examples.english: The prescription issued by the doctor must be reviewed by a licensed pharmacist to ensure medication safety.

examples.chinese: 政府必须妥善处置这些危险废料，以防止环境污染。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ bìxū tuǒshàn chǔzhì zhèxiē wēixiǎn fèiliào, yǐ fángzhǐ huanjìng wūrǎn.
examples.english: The government must properly deal with these hazardous wastes to prevent environmental pollution.

examples.chinese: 国家需要储备足够的粮食和能源，以应对可能发生的经济危机。
examples.pinyin: Guójiā xūyào chǔbèi zúgòu de liángshi hé néngyuán, yǐ yìngduì kěnéng fāshēng de jīngjì wēijī.
examples.english: The nation needs to maintain adequate reserves of grain and energy to cope with potential economic crises.

examples.chinese: 许多年轻人意识到定期储蓄对于应对突发事件和实现长期目标的重要性。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō niánqīng rén yìshi dào dìngqī chǔxù duìyú yìngduì túfā shìjiàn hé shíxiàn chángqī mùbiāo de zhòngyàoxìng.
examples.english: Many young people are aware of the importance of regular savings in dealing with unexpected events and achieving long-term goals.

examples.chinese: 这部纪录片中那些普通人的故事深深触动了我的心灵，让我重新思考人生的意义。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn zhōng nàxiē pǔtōng rén de gùshì shēnshēn chùdòngle wǒ de xīnlíng, ràng wǒ chóngxīn sīkǎo rénshēng de yìyì.
examples.english: The stories of ordinary people in this documentary deeply touched my heart and made me reconsider the meaning of life.

examples.chinese: 他不小心触犯了公司的保密协议，因此面临严重的法律后果。
examples.pinyin: Tā búxiǎoxin chùfànle gōngsī de bǎomì xiéyì, yīncǐ miànlín yánzhòng de fǎlǜ hòuguǒ.
examples.english: He inadvertently violated the company's confidentiality agreement and consequently faced serious legal consequences.

examples.chinese: 盲人通过灵敏的触觉来感知周围的世界，这种能力往往超出我们的想象。
examples.pinyin: Máng rén tōngguò língmǐn de chùjué lái gǎnzhī zhōubiān de shìjiè, zhè zhǒng nénghuà wǎngwǎng chāochū wǒmen de xiǎngxiàng.
examples.english: Blind people perceive the world around them through their keen sense of touch, an ability that often exceeds our imagination.

examples.chinese: 这个艺术装置允许观众直接触摸展品，以获得更深层次的感官体验。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yìshù zhuāngzhì yǔn许 guānzhòng zhíjiē chùmō zhǎnpǐn，yǐ huòdé gèng shēncéng cì de gǎnguān tǐyàn。
examples.english: This art installation allows visitors to directly touch the exhibits in order to gain a deeper sensory experience.

examples.chinese: 看到工厂排放的黑烟和被污染的河水，我感到触目惊心，不禁为子孙后代的未来担忧。
examples.pinyin: Kàndào gōngchǎng pāifàng de hēiyān hé bèi wūrǎn de héshui, wǒ gǎndào chùmù-jīngxīn, búnjìn wèi zǐsūn hòudài de wèilái dānnyōu.
examples.english: Seeing the black smoke discharged from the factory and the polluted river water, I found it shocking and alarming, and couldn't help but worry about the future for our descendants.

examples.chinese: 他揣着一份重要文件匆匆离开了办公室。
examples.pinyin: Tā chuāizhe yī fèn zhòngyào wénjiàn qiāngcōng líkāile le bàngōngshì.
examples.english: He hurriedly left the office with an important document tucked into his pocket.

examples.chinese: 虽然他没有明说，但从他的言辞中我能揣测出他对这个决定感到失望。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán tā méiyǒu mínggshuō, dàn cóng tā de yáncí zhōng wǒ néng chuǎicè chū tā duì zhège juéding gǎndào shīwàng.
examples.english: Although he didn't say it explicitly, I can infer from his words that he feels disappointed about this decision.

examples.chinese: 要想写出好的文学评论，必须仔细揣摩作者的创作意图和写作手法。
examples.pinyin: Yào xiǎng xiě chū hǎo de wénxué píngluàn, bìxū zǐxì chuǎimó zuòzhě de chuàngzuò yìtú hé xiězuò shǒufǎ.
examples.english: To write good literary criticism, one must carefully analyze the author's creative intentions and writing techniques.

examples.chinese: 那个醉汉踹开了酒吧的门，冲了进去。
examples.pinyin: Nàge zuì hàn chuài kāi le jiǔ ba de mén, chōng le jìnqu.
examples.english: The drunk man kicked open the door of the bar and rushed in.

examples.chinese: 在这个繁华的城市中心，行人川流不息，各种语言混杂在一起，形成了独特的都市风景。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège繁华的 chéngshì zhōngxīn, xínggrén chuānliú-bùxī, gèzhǒng yǔyán hùnzá zài yìqǐ, xíngchéngle dútè de dūshì fēngjǐng.
examples.english: In the center of this bustling city, pedestrians flow without stopping, and various languages mix together, forming a unique urban landscape.

examples.chinese: 针线穿过布料时，我能感受到那种细微的阻力。
examples.pinyin: zhēnxiàn chuānguò búliào shí, wǒ néng gǎnshòu dào nàzhǒng xìwēi de zǔlì.
examples.english: When the thread passes through the fabric, I can feel that subtle resistance.

english: lit. to make sb wear tight shoes (idiom)

examples.chinese: 那个经理因为员工没有拍马屁，就经常给他穿小鞋，最后导致他被迫辞职。
examples.pinyin: Nàge jīnglǐ yīnwèi yuángōng méiyǒu pāi mǎtì, jiù jīngcháng gěi tā chuān xiǎoxié, zuìhòu dǎozhì tā bèi pòpò císhí.
examples.english: The manager frequently made things difficult for the employee because he didn't flatter him, which ultimately forced him to resign.

examples.chinese: 这部科幻小说讲述了主人公穿越时空回到过去,试图改变历史的故事。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù kēhuàn xiǎoshuō jiǎngshù le zhǔrénggōng chuānyuè shíkōng huídào guòqù, shìtú gǎibiàn lìshǐ de gùshì.
examples.english: This science fiction novel tells the story of the protagonist traveling through time and space back to the past, attempting to change history.

examples.chinese: 她穿着一身得体的旗袍，在宴会上显得格外优雅动人。
examples.pinyin: Tā chuānzhuó yī shēn déntǐ de qípáo, zài yànhuì shang xiǎnde géwài yōuyǎ dòngrén.
examples.english: She was dressed in a well-fitting qipao that made her look exceptionally elegant and charming at the banquet.

examples.chinese: 这项传统手艺的传承面临着严峻的挑战，因为年轻一代越来越少有人愿意投入时间去学习。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng chuántǒng shǒuyi de chuánchéng miànlín zhe yánnjùn de tiǎozhàn, yīnwèi niánqīng yī dài yuèláiyuè shǎo yǒurén yuànyì tóuruò shíjiān qù xuéxí.
examples.english: The passing down of this traditional craft faces severe challenges, as fewer and fewer young people are willing to invest time in learning it.

examples.chinese: 这位企业家的创业故事已经成为了一段商界的传奇，激励了无数年轻人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi qǐyèjiā de chuàngyè gùshì yǐjīng chéngwéi le yī duàn shāngjìe de chuánqí, jīlì le wúshù niánqīng rén.
examples.english: This entrepreneur's startup story has become a legend in the business world, inspiring countless young people.

examples.chinese: 这种病毒的传染性很强，医疗部门已经采取了严格的防控措施来阻止疾病的传染。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng bìngdú de chuánrǎnxìng hěn qiáng, yīliáo bùmén yǐjīng cǎiqǔle yánggé de fángkòng cuòshī lái zǔzhǐ jíbìng de chuánrǎn.
examples.english: This type of virus is highly contagious, and the medical departments have already implemented strict control measures to prevent the transmission of the disease.

examples.chinese: 这次疫情的传播速度之快令专家们意识到，我们必须加强对传染病的防控措施。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì yìqíng de chuánbō sùdù zhī kuài lìng zhuānjiā men yìshi dào, wǒmen bìxū jiāqiáng duì chuánrǎnbìng de fángkòng cuòshī.
examples.english: The rapid spread of this epidemic made experts realize that we must strengthen prevention and control measures against infectious diseases.

examples.chinese: 这位武术大师将毕生的绝技传人给了他最有天赋的弟子。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi wǔshù dàshī jiāng bìshēng de juéjì chuánrén gěile tā zuì yǒu tiānfù de dìzi.
examples.english: This martial arts master passed on his lifetime of exceptional skills to his most talented disciple.

examples.chinese: 这位资深的艺术家花了多年时间向年轻一代传授传统工艺的精妙之处。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zīshēn de yìshùjiā huāle duō nián shíjiān xiàng niánqīng yī dài chuánshòu chuántǒng gōngyì de jīngmiào zhī chù.
examples.english: This seasoned artist spent years imparting the subtleties of traditional craftsmanship to the younger generation.

examples.chinese: 虽然网上有很多传闻说这位明星即将退出娱乐圈，但他的经纪公司一直没有正式回应。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán wǎngshàng yǒu hěnduō chuánwén shuō zhè wèi míngxīng jíjiāng tuìchū yúlè quān, dàn tā de jīngjì gōngsī yīzhí méiyǒu zhèngshì huíyìng.
examples.english: Although there are many rumors online that this celebrity is about to withdraw from the entertainment industry, his agency has never officially responded.

examples.chinese: 随着全球贸易的发展，现代船舶的安全管理和环保标准变得越来越重要。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe quánqiú màoyì de fāzhǎn, xiàndài chuánbó de ānquán guǎnlǐ hé huánbǎo biāozhǔn biàn de yuèláiyuè zhòngyào.
examples.english: With the development of global trade, the safety management and environmental standards of modern shipping have become increasingly important.

examples.chinese: 那位老船夫用力挥动船桨，船在浪花中稳稳地向前推进。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎo chuánfu yònglì huī dòng chuánjiǎng, chuán zài lànghuā zhōng wěnwěn de xiàng qián tuījìn.
examples.english: The old boatman swung the oar forcefully, and the boat steadily moved forward through the waves.

examples.chinese: 经过长时间的激烈争辩后，他坐在椅子上喘着粗气，试图平复自己的情绪。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò cháng shíjiān de jīliè zhēnglùn hòu, tā zuòzài yǐzi shang chuǎnzhe cūqì, shìtú píngfù zìjǐ de qíngxù.
examples.english: After a lengthy and intense debate, he sat in a chair gasping for breath, trying to calm his emotions.

examples.chinese: 经过长途跋涉，登山者们终于到达山顶，个个都在喘息，却舍不得错过眼前壮阔的风景。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò chángtu途bá shè, dēngshānzhě men zh终yú dàodá shānding, gègè dōu zài chuǎnxī, què shěbudeliào cuòguò yǎnqián zhuàngkuò de fēngjǐng.
examples.english: After a long and arduous journey, the climbers finally reached the summit, all of them gasping for breath, yet reluctant to miss the magnificent scenery before their eyes.

examples.chinese: 周末我经常串门去找朋友聊天，有时候他们也会不请自来地串门到我家。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ jīngcháng chuàn mén qù zhǎo péngyou liáotiān, yǒushíhou tāmen yě huì búqǐng zìlái de chuàn mén dào wǒ jiā.
examples.english: On weekends, I often call on my friends for a chat, and sometimes they also show up unannounced at my place.

examples.chinese: 经历了那次失败后，他花了很久才从心理创伤中恢复过来。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglìle nà cì shībài hòu, tā huāle hěn jiǔ cái cóng xīnlǐ chuāngshāng zhōng huīfù guòlái.
examples.english: After experiencing that failure, it took him a long time to recover from the psychological wound.

examples.chinese: 由于疫情期间患者众多，医院的床位紧张，许多病人不得不排队等候。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú yìqíng qījiān huànzhě zhònɡduō, yīyuàn de chuángwèi jǐnzhānɡ, xǔduō bìnɡrén búdébuō páiduì děnɡhòu.
examples.english: Due to the large number of patients during the epidemic, hospital beds became tight, and many patients had to wait in queue.

examples.chinese: 这位企业家凭借创新的理念和坚持不懈的努力，创造了一个商业帝国。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi qǐyèjiā píngjiè chuàngxīn de lǐniàn hé jiānchíbù xiède nǔlì, chuàngzào le yīgè shāngyè dìguó.
examples.english: This entrepreneur created a business empire through innovative ideas and relentless effort.

examples.chinese: 这家科技公司的创始人凭借独特的商业眼光，将一个小型初创企业发展成了行业领头羊。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā kējì gōngsī de chuàngshǐrén píngjiè dúte de shāngyè yǎnguang, jiāng yīgè xiǎoxíng chūshǐ qǐyè fāzhǎn chéngle hángyè lǐngtóu yáng.
examples.english: The founder of this tech company, leveraging his unique business acumen, developed a small startup into an industry leader.

examples.chinese: 他们精心策划的这个项目最后还是吹了，投资者都撤资了。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen jīngxīn cèhuà de zhège xiàngmù zuìhòu háishi chuīle, tóuzīzhě dōu chèzī le.
examples.english: The project they carefully planned ultimately fell through, and all the investors withdrew their funding.

examples.chinese: 他总是喜欢在朋友面前吹牛，说自己的生意多么成功，结果最后还是破产了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì xǐhuān zài péngyou miànqián chuī niú, shuō zìjǐ de shēngyì duōme chénggōng, jiéguǒ zuìhòu háishi pòchǎn le.
examples.english: He always likes to talk big in front of his friends, boasting about how successful his business is, but in the end he went bankrupt anyway.

examples.chinese: 那些媒体总是吹捧这位明星，却对他的缺点视而不见。
examples.pinyin: Nàxiē méitǐ zǒngshì chuīpěng zhè wèi míngxīng, què duì tā de quēndiǎn shìérbùjiàn.
examples.english: Those media outlets always flatter this celebrity, yet turn a blind eye to his shortcomings.

examples.chinese: 这幅古画中，垂柳的枝条在风中轻轻摇曳，给人一种宁静致远的意境。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fú gǔhuà zhōng, chuíliǔ de zhītiáo zài fēng zhōng qīngqīng yáoyè, gěi rén yī zhǒng níngjìng zhìyuǎn de yìjìng.
examples.english: In this ancient painting, the drooping willow branches sway gently in the wind, evoking a sense of serene and distant beauty.

examples.chinese: 在连续失败了几个重要项目后，他垂头丧气地坐在办公室里，甚至不愿意和同事交流。
examples.pinyin: Zài liánxù shībài le jǐ ge zhòngyào xiàngmù hòu, tā chuítóu-sàngqì de zuò zài bàngōngshì lǐ, shènzhì búyuànyì hé tóngshì jiāoliú.
examples.english: After failing several important projects in succession, he sat in his office looking dispiritedly dejected, and was even unwilling to communicate with colleagues.

examples.chinese: 他生气得用拳头捶了一下桌子，吓得所有人都安静了下来。
examples.pinyin: Tā shēngqì de yòng quánhou chuíle yīxià zhuōzi, xiàde suǒyǒu rén dōu ānjìng le xiàlái.
examples.english: He was so angry that he pounded the table with his fist, which frightened everyone into silence.

examples.chinese: 这位工匠用锤子敲打金属的技艺已经炉火纯青,每一下都精准无比。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi gōngjiàng yòng chuízi qiāodǎ jīn属 de jìshù yǐjīng lúhuǒ chúnqīng, měi yī xià dōu jīngzhǔn wúbǐ.
examples.english: This craftsman has mastered the technique of striking metal with a hammer to perfection, with every blow being precise and flawless.

examples.chinese: 这部电影的成功纯粹是因为演员精湛的演技和导演独特的视角。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de chénggōng chúncuì shì yīnwèi yǎnyuàn jīngzhàn de yǎnjì hé dǎoyǎn dúchuán de shìjiǎo.
examples.english: The success of this film is purely due to the actors' superb performance and the director's unique perspective.

examples.chinese: 在这个充满诱惑的时代，保持一颗纯洁的心灵变得愈加困难。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège chōngmǎn yòuhuò de shídài, bǎochíle yī kē chúnjié de xīnlíng biàn de yùjiā kùnnan.
examples.english: In this age full of temptations, it becomes increasingly difficult to maintain a pure heart.

examples.chinese: 这位老农民虽然文化水平不高，但他纯朴的品质和对土地的热爱让所有人都为之敬佩。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎo nóngmín suīrán wénhuà shuǐpíng búgāo, dàn tā chúnpǔ de pǐnzhì hé duì tǔdì de règài ràng suǒyǒu rén dōu wéi zhī jìngpèi.
examples.english: Although this old farmer had limited education, his simple and honest character and passion for the land earned everyone's respect.

examples.chinese: 这位老艺术家的表演风格醇厚深沉，每一个动作都蕴含着几十年的舞台经验。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎo yìshùjiā de biǎoyǎn fēngge chúnhòu shēnchén, měi yī ge dòngzuò dōu yùnhányùzhe jǐ shí nián de wǔtái jīngyàn.
examples.english: This elderly artist's performance style is mellow and profound, with every movement embodying decades of stage experience.

examples.chinese: 他那个决定实在太蠢了，完全没有考虑到后果。
examples.pinyin: Tā nàge juédìng shízài tài chǔn le, wánquán méiyǒu kǎolǜ dào hòuguǒ.
examples.english: That decision of his was really stupid; he didn't consider the consequences at all.

examples.chinese: 他用手指戳了戳那份文件，表示对这个决定的质疑。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng shǒuzhǐ chuōle chuō nà fèn wénjiàn, biǎoshì duì zhège juéding de zhìyí.
examples.english: He jabbed at the document with his finger, expressing his doubt about the decision.

examples.chinese: 这件瓷器是明代的孤品，在拍卖会上以天价成交，引起了收藏界的广泛关注。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn cíqì shì míngdài de gūpǐn, zài pāimàihuì shang yǐ tiānjià chéngjāo, yǐnqǐle shōucángj界 de guǎngfàn guānzhù.
examples.english: This piece of porcelain is a unique item from the Ming Dynasty that sold at an astronomical price at an auction, attracting widespread attention in the collecting world.

examples.chinese: 在公司陷入困境之后，几位高管相继辞去了他们的职位。
examples.pinyin: Zài gōngsī xiànrù kùnjìng zhīhòu, jǐ wèi gāoguǎn xiāngjì cíqù le tāmen de zhíwèi.
examples.english: After the company fell into difficulties, several executives successively resigned from their positions.

examples.chinese: 由于与公司的发展方向产生了重大分歧，他最终决定向董事会提交了辞呈。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú yǔ gōngsī de fāzhǎn fāngxiàng chǎnshēngle zhòngdà fēnqì, tā zuìzh終jué dìng xiàngxiàng dǒngshìhuì tíjiāole le cíchéng.
examples.english: Due to major disagreements with the company's development direction, he ultimately decided to submit his resignation to the board of directors.

examples.chinese: 在公司经历了多年的办公室政治之后，他最终决定辞去总经理的职位，去追求自己真正热爱的事业。
examples.pinyin: Zài gōngsī jīnglì le duō nián de bàngōngshì zhèngzhì zhīhòu, tā zuìzh终 juédinig辞去 zǒngjīnglǐ de zhíwèi, qù zhuīqiú zìjǐ zhēnzhèng rèài de shìyè.
examples.english: After experiencing years of office politics at the company, he finally decided to resign from his position as general manager to pursue the career he truly loved.

examples.chinese: 由于业绩不达标，公司最终决定辞退这位经理，尽管他在公司工作了十多年。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú yèjī bù dábiāo, gōngsī zuìzhōng juédinng辞tuì zhè wèi jīnglǐ, jìnguǎn tā zài gōngsī gōngzuò le shí duō nián.
examples.english: Due to failure to meet performance targets, the company ultimately decided to dismiss the manager, despite his more than ten years of service at the company.

examples.chinese: 这位企业家通过慈善基金会为贫困地区的教育事业做出了巨大贡献。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi qǐyèjiā tōngguò císhàn jījīnhuì wèi pinkùn dìqū de jiàoyù shìyè zuòchūle jùdà gònngxiàn.
examples.english: This entrepreneur made tremendous contributions to education in impoverished areas through his charitable foundation.

examples.chinese: 那位老教授用慈祥的目光看着年轻的学生们，仿佛在用无言的智慧引领他们探索学术的奥秘。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎo jiàoshòu yòng cíxiáng de mùguāng kànzhe niánqīng de xuéshengmen, fǎngfú zài yòng wúyán de zhìhuì yǐnlǐng tāmen tànsuǒ xuéshù de àomì.
examples.english: The elderly professor looked at the young students with a kindly gaze, as if silently guiding them to explore the mysteries of academia.

examples.chinese: 那些老磁带里存储的音乐承载了整整一代人的青春回忆。
examples.pinyin: Nàxiē lǎo cídài lǐ cúnchǔ de yīnyuè chéngzàile zhěngzhěng yī dàirén de qīngchun huíyì.
examples.english: The music stored in those old magnetic tapes carried the youthful memories of an entire generation.

examples.chinese: 这家饭店已经淘汰了传统的磁卡门禁系统，改用了更安全的人脸识别技术。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā fàn店 yǐjīng t淘汰 le chuántǒng de cíkǎ ménnjìn xìtǒng, gǎiyòng le gèng ānquán de rénliǎn shíbié jìshù.
examples.english: This restaurant has already phased out the traditional magnetic card access control system and switched to more secure facial recognition technology.

examples.chinese: 由于磁盘空间不足，系统的运行速度明显下降了。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú cípán kōngjiān búzú, xìtǒng de yùnxíng sùdù míngxiǎn xiàjiànghuà le.
examples.english: Because the disk space is insufficient, the system's running speed has noticeably decreased.

examples.chinese: 在这场激烈的辩论中，双方的观点此起彼伏，一时难以分出胜负。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè chǎng jīliè de biànlùn zhōng, shuāngfāng de guāndiǎn cǐqǐ-bǐfú, yīshí nányǐ fēnchū shèngnegòu.
examples.english: In this fierce debate, the arguments from both sides arose one after another, making it difficult to determine a winner for the moment.

examples.chinese: 会议在周五举行，次日公司就宣布了这项重大决策的实施细则。
examples.pinyin: Huìyì zài zhōuwǔ jǔxíng, cìrì gōngsī jiù xuānbù le zhè xiàng zhòngdà juécè de shíshī xìzé.
examples.english: The meeting was held on Friday, and the next day the company announced the implementation details of this major policy decision.

examples.chinese: 她多年来一直伺候着年迈的父母，从未有过怨言。
examples.pinyin: Tā duō nián lái yīzhí cìhou zhe niánmài de fùmǔ, cóngwèi yǒuguò yuànyán.
examples.english: She has been serving her elderly parents for many years without ever complaining.

examples.chinese: 那个施工现场的噪音太刺耳了，让人根本无法专注工作。
examples.pinyin: Nàge shīgōng xiànchǎng de zàoyīn tài cìěr le, ràng rén gēnběn wúfǎ zhuānzhù gōngzuò.
examples.english: The noise from that construction site is too ear-piercing, making it impossible for people to focus on their work.

examples.chinese: 那次失败对他的打击是刺骨的，以至于他花了好几年才从阴影中走出来。
examples.pinyin: Nà cì shībài duì tā de dǎjī shì cìgǔ de, yǐzhìyú tā huāle hǎo jǐ nián cái cóng yīnyǐng zhōng zǒu chūlái.
examples.english: The blow from that failure was piercing to him, so much so that it took him several years to emerge from the shadow.

examples.chinese: 这位工匠用传统的刺绣手法将古代诗词的意境精妙地表现在了丝绸上。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi gōngjiàng yòng chuántǒng de cìxiù shǒufǎ jiāng gǔdài shīcí de yìjìng jīngmiào de biǎoxiàn zàile sīchóu shang.
examples.english: This craftsman skillfully expressed the essence of ancient poetry onto silk using traditional embroidery techniques.

examples.chinese: 皇帝赐予了这位将军一块玉佩，以表彰他的卓越功勋。
examples.pinyin: Huángdì cìyǔ le zhè wèi jiāngjūn yī kuài yùpèi, yǐ biǎozhāng tā de zhuóyuè gōngxūn.
examples.english: The emperor bestowed a jade pendant upon the general to commend his outstanding merit.

examples.chinese: 您在这个领域有丰富的经验，能否赐教一下我们应该如何应对这些复杂的市场变化？
examples.pinyin: Nín zài zhège lǐngyù yǒu fēngfù de jīngyàn, néngfǒu cìjiào yīxià wǒmen yīnggāi rúhé yìngduì zhèxiē fùzá de shìchǎng biànhuà?
examples.english: You have extensive experience in this field; could you kindly enlighten us on how we should respond to these complex market changes?

examples.chinese: 他匆匆浏览了一遍报告，就仓促地做出了决定，事后才意识到自己的草率。
examples.pinyin: Tā cōngcōng liúlǎnle yī biàn bàogào, jiù cāngcù de zuòchūle juéding, shìhòu cái yìshílìdào zìjǐ de cǎoshà.
examples.english: He hurriedly skimmed through the report and made a hasty decision, only realizing afterwards how rash he had been.

examples.chinese: 由于时间紧张，他匆忙地签署了合同，事后才意识到其中存在的法律漏洞。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú shíjiān jǐnzhāng, tā cōngmáng de qiānshǔ le hétonɡ, shìhòu cái yìshi dào qīzhōng cúnzài de fǎlǜ lòudòng.
examples.english: Due to time constraints, he hastily signed the contract, only realizing afterward the legal loopholes it contained.

examples.chinese: 这道菜的关键在于火候和葱的选择，选用新鲜的小葱能大大提升整体的风味。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài de guānjiàn zàiyú huǒhou hé cōng de xuǎnzé, xuǎnyòng xīnxiān de xiǎo cōng néng dàdà tíshēng zhěngtǐ de fēngwèi.
examples.english: The key to this dish lies in the heat control and the choice of scallions; using fresh young scallions can greatly enhance the overall flavor.

examples.chinese: 经历了这次失败后，他决定从今以后要更加谨慎地对待每一个决定。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglìle zhè cì shībài hòu, tā juédìng cóngjīnyǐhòu yào gèngjiā jǐnshèn de duìdài měi yī ge juédìng.
examples.english: After experiencing this failure, he decided that from now on he would approach every decision more carefully.

examples.chinese: 他从来不承认自己的错误，总是把责任推给别人。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóngláibù chéngrèn zìjǐ de cuòwù, zǒngshì bǎ zérèntuī gěi biérén.
examples.english: He never admits his own mistakes and always shifts the responsibility to others.

examples.chinese: 在这次危机中，他从容地做出了决策，赢得了董事会的信任。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè cì wēijī zhōng, tā cóngróng de zuòchūle juécè, yíngdele dǒngshìhuì de xìnrèn.
examples.english: In this crisis, he made decisions calmly and won the trust of the board of directors.

examples.chinese: 面对这场突如其来的危机，她依然从容不迫地制定了一系列应对措施，赢得了全公司的信任。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì zhè chǎng túrúqīlái de wēijī, tā yīrán cóngróng-bùpò de zhìdìngle yī xìliè yìngduì cuòshī, yíngdele quán gōngsī de xìnrèn.
examples.english: Faced with this sudden crisis, she remained calm and composed as she formulated a series of countermeasures, earning the trust of the entire company.

examples.chinese: 这个项目失败了，我们必须从头开始重新规划整个战略。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù shībài le, wǒmen bìxū cóngtóu kāishǐ chóngxīn guīhuà zhěngge zhànlüè.
examples.english: The project failed, so we must start anew and re-plan the entire strategy from scratch.

examples.chinese: 在这个竞争激烈的行业里，他从未放弃过自己的梦想，最终成为了业界的佼佼者。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège jìngzhēng jīliè de hángyè lǐ, tā cóngwèi fàngqì guò zìjǐ de梦想, zuìzh终 chéngwéile yèjiè de jiǎojiǎozhě.
examples.english: In this highly competitive industry, he never gave up on his dreams and eventually became a leader in the field.

examples.chinese: 许多人在从业初期都会遇到各种挑战和困难。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō rén zài cóngyè chūqī dōu huì遇dào gèzhǒng tiǎozhàn hé kùnnan.
examples.english: Many people encounter various challenges and difficulties in the early stages of practicing their profession.

examples.chinese: 他作为一个敬业的编辑，从早到晚都埋头于堆积如山的稿件中，很少有时间陪伴家人。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuòwéi yī gè jìngyè de biānjí, cóngzǎodàowǎn dōu máitóu yú duījī rúshān de gǎojiàn zhōng, hěnshǎo yǒu shíjiān péibàn jiārén.
examples.english: As a dedicated editor, he buries himself in piles of manuscripts from dawn to dusk, rarely having time to accompany his family.

examples.chinese: 探险队在亚马逊的丛林中迷失了方向，花了三天才找到回营地的路。
examples.pinyin: Tànxiǎnduì zài Yàmazūn de cónglín zhōng míshīle fāngxiàng, huāle sāntiān cái zhǎodào huí yíngdì de lù.
examples.english: The expedition team lost their way in the Amazon jungle and took three days to find the way back to the camp.

examples.chinese: 几个朋友凑钱买了一套房子，现在一起分担房贷。
examples.pinyin: Jǐ ge péngyou còu qián mǎi le yī tào fángzi, xiànzài yīqǐ fēntān fángdài.
examples.english: A few friends pooled their money together to buy an apartment, and now they share the mortgage payments together.

examples.chinese: 这次会议的安排有点仓促，我们只能凑合着用现有的资源来完成项目。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì de ānpái yǒudiǎn cāngcù, wǒmen zhǐnéng còuhe zhe yòng xiànyǒu de zīyuán lái wánchéng xiàngmù.
examples.english: The arrangement for this meeting was a bit rushed, so we could only make do with the existing resources to complete the project.

examples.chinese: 凑巧的是，我在机场遇见了失散多年的老朋友，我们都为这次意外的重逢感到惊喜。
examples.pinyin: Còuqiǎo de shì, wǒ zài jīchǎng遇见le shīsàn duō nián de lǎo péngyou, wǒmen dōu wèi zhè cì yìwài de chóngféng gǎndào jīngxǐ.
examples.english: As luck would have it, I ran into an old friend I hadn't seen in years at the airport, and we were both delighted by this unexpected reunion.

examples.chinese: 他那种粗暴的管理方式引起了员工们的强烈不满。
examples.pinyin: Tā nàzhǒng cūbào de guǎnlǐ fāngshì yǐnqǐle yuángōngmen de qiángliè búmǎn.
examples.english: His rough management style caused strong dissatisfaction among the employees.

examples.chinese: 这份报告的数据分析过于粗糙，根本无法支撑你的论证。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào de shùjù fēnxī guòyú cūcāo, gēnběn wúfǎ zhīchēng nǐ de lùnzhèng.
examples.english: The data analysis in this report is too crude to support your argument.

examples.chinese: 他那粗鲁的言辞深深伤害了她的感受，使得两人之间的矛盾愈加激化。
examples.pinyin: Tā nà cūlu de yáncí shēnshēn shānghài le tā de gǎnshòu, shǐdé liǎngrén zhījiān de máodùn yùjiā jīhuà.
examples.english: His coarse remarks deeply hurt her feelings, causing the conflict between them to escalate further.

examples.chinese: 这份报告只是对市场现状的粗略分析，还需要进一步的深入调查才能得出准确的结论。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào zhǐshì duì shìchǎng xiànzhuàng de cūlüè fēnxī, háishi xūyào jìnyībù de shēnrù diàochá cái néng déchū zhǔnquè de jiēlùn.
examples.english: This report is only a rough analysis of the current market situation; further in-depth investigation is still needed to draw accurate conclusions.

examples.chinese: 他因为粗心大意而错过了这次重要的面试机会，现在后悔莫及。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi cūxīn-dàyì ér cuòguò le zhè cì zhònyào de miànshì jīhuì, xiànzài hòuhuǐ mòjí.
examples.english: He missed this important interview opportunity due to negligence, and now he deeply regrets it.

examples.chinese: 正是这次意外的相遇促成了他们之后长达二十年的合作关系。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngshì zhè cì yìwài de xiāngyù cùchéngle tāmen zhīhòu chángdá èrshí nián de hézuò guānxi.
examples.english: It was precisely this unexpected encounter that facilitated their subsequent twenty-year collaborative relationship.

examples.chinese: 当这位著名演员出现在机场时，大批粉丝簇拥向前，争相要求签名和合影。
examples.pinyin: Dāng zhè wèi zhùmíng yǎnyuán chūxiàn zài jīchǎng shí, dàpī fěnsī cùyōng xiàng qián, zhēngxiāng yāoqiú qiānmíng hé héyǐng.
examples.english: When this famous actor appeared at the airport, a large crowd of fans swarmed forward, eagerly asking for autographs and photos.

examples.chinese: 那个逃犯在警察的追捕下仓皇窜入了山林，企图逃脱法网。
examples.pinyin: Nàge táof犯 zài jǐngchá de zhuībǔ xià cānghuáng cuàn rù le shānlín, qǐtú táof脱 fǎwǎng.
examples.english: The fugitive frantically fled into the mountains and forests under police pursuit, attempting to escape the law.

examples.chinese: 经理一再催促我们加快项目进度，否则就无法按时交付给客户。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ yīzài cuīcù wǒmen jiāokuài xiàngmù jìnchéng, fǒuzé jiù wúfǎ ànshí jiāofù gěi kèhù.
examples.english: The manager repeatedly urged us to speed up the project progress, otherwise we wouldn't be able to deliver it to the client on time.

examples.chinese: 经理不断催促团队加快项目进度，否则就无法按时交付给客户。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ búduàn cuīcù tuánduì jiākuài xiàngmù jìndu, fǒuzé jiù wúfǎ ànshí jiāofù gěi kèhù.
examples.english: The manager keeps urging the team to speed up the project progress, otherwise they won't be able to deliver it to the client on time.

examples.chinese: 心理医生用催眠疗法帮助患者克服了多年的创伤阴影。
examples.pinyin: Xīnlǐ yīshēng yòng cuīmián liáofǎ bāngzhù huànzhě kèfúle duō nián de chuāngshāng yīnyǐng.
examples.english: The psychologist helped the patient overcome years of trauma shadows through hypnotherapy.

examples.chinese: 这次轰炸摧毁了敌方的大部分军事设施，从而改变了整个战争的局面。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì hōngzhà cuīhuǐ le díduō de dà bùfen jūnshì shèshī, cóngér gǎibiàn le zhěngge zhànzhēng de júmiàn.
examples.english: This bombing destroyed most of the enemy's military facilities, thereby changing the entire course of the war.

examples.chinese: 在经历了一系列挫折后，他那看似坚强的外表下隐藏着一颗脆弱的心。
examples.pinyin: Zài jīnglì le yī xìliè cuòzhé hòu, tā nà kànsì jiānqiáng de wàibiǎo xià yǐncáng zhe yī kē cuìruò de xīn.
examples.english: After experiencing a series of setbacks, beneath his seemingly strong exterior lay a fragile heart.

examples.chinese: 站在山顶远眺，眼前是一片翠绿的森林，云雾缭绕其间，美得令人窒息。
examples.pinyin: Zhàn zài shānding yuǎntiào, yǎnqián shì yī piàn cuìlǜ de sēnlín, yúnwù liáorào qī jiān, měi de lìng rén zhìxí.
examples.english: Standing on the mountaintop and gazing into the distance, the landscape before our eyes is a stretch of lush green forest with mist swirling through it, breathtakingly beautiful.

examples.chinese: 由于长期出国工作，他决定把大部分家具存放在仓库里，只保留了几件必需品。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú cháng期 chūguó gōngzuò, tā juéding bǎ dàbùfen jiājù cúnfàng zài cāngkù lǐ, zhǐ bǎoliúle jǐ jiàn bìxū pǐn.
examples.english: Because of his long-term work abroad, he decided to leave most of his furniture in a storage unit, keeping only a few necessary items.

examples.chinese: 他存心要找你的麻烦，你最好离他远一点。
examples.pinyin: Tā cúnxīn yào zhǎo nǐ de máfan, nǐ zuìhǎo lí tā yuǎn yīdiǎn.
examples.english: He deliberately wants to cause you trouble, so you'd better stay away from him.

examples.chinese: 我找了半天才在抽屉里翻出那本旧存折，里面记录了我二十年前的储蓄记录。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhǎole bàn tiān cái zài chōutì lǐ fānchū nà běn jiù cúnzhé, lǐmiàn jìlùle wǒ èrshí nián qián de chǔxù jìlù.
examples.english: I rummaged through the drawer for a while before finally finding that old passbook, which contained my savings records from twenty years ago.

english: to rub or roll between the hands or fingers

examples.chinese: 他紧张地搓着双手，等待面试结果的公布。
examples.pinyin: Tā jǐnzhāng de cuōzhe shuāngshǒu, děngdài miànshì jiéguǒ de gōngbù.
examples.english: He nervously rubbed his hands together while waiting for the interview results to be announced.

examples.chinese: 两国领导人就贸易协议的具体条款进行了深入的磋商，希望能够找到双方都满意的解决方案。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng guó lǐngdǎorén jiù màoyì xiéyì de jùtǐ tiáokuǎn jìnxíng le shēnrù de cuōshāng, xīwàng néng gòu zhǎodào shuāngfāng dōu mǎnyì de jiějué fāng'àn.
examples.english: The leaders of the two countries conducted in-depth consultations on the specific terms of the trade agreement, hoping to find a mutually satisfactory solution.

examples.chinese: 在创业的过程中，我们难免会遭遇挫折，但关键是如何从失败中吸取教训，继续前进。
examples.pinyin: Zài chuàngyè de guòchéng zhōng, wǒmen nányǐ huì zāoyù cuòzhé, dàn guānjiàn shì rúhé cóng shībài zhōng xīqǔ jiàoxùn, jìxù qiánjìn.
examples.english: In the process of starting a business, it is inevitable that we will encounter setbacks, but the key is how to learn lessons from failure and keep moving forward.

english: no time to deal with it (idiom)

examples.chinese: 突如其来的经济危机让许多企业措手不及，纷纷陷入困境。
examples.pinyin: Túrúqīlái de jīngjì wēijī ràng xǔduō qǐyè cuòshǒu-bùjí, fēnfēn xiànrù kùnjìng.
examples.english: The sudden economic crisis caught many enterprises off guard, and they fell into difficulties one after another.

examples.chinese: 许多人对成功的理解存在错觉，认为只要努力就一定能成功，却忽视了机遇和时代背景的重要性。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō rén duì chénggōng de lǐjiě cúnzài cuòjué, rènwéi zhǐyào nǔlì jiù yídìng néng chénggōng, què lüèshìle jīyù hé shídài bèijǐng de zhòngyàoxìng.
examples.english: Many people have a misconception about success, believing that as long as one works hard, success is guaranteed, while overlooking the importance of opportunity and historical context.

examples.chinese: 由于管理层的战略错位，这家公司逐渐失去了市场竞争力。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú guǎnlǐcéng de zhàn lüè cuòwèi, zhè jiā gōngsī zhújiàn shīqùle shìchǎng jìngjìng lìliàng.
examples.english: Due to the misalignment of the management's strategy, this company gradually lost its market competitiveness.

examples.chinese: 这起案件的情节错综复杂，涉及多个部门和利益相关者，检察机关花了三年时间才理清思路。
examples.pinyin: Zhè qǐ ànjiàn de qíng节 cuòzōng-fùzá, sh涉jí duō ge bùmén hé lìyì xiāngguānzhě, jiǎnchájī huā le sān nián shíjiān cái lǐ qīng sīlù.
examples.english: The plot of this case is tangled and complicated, involving multiple departments and stakeholders, and it took the procuratorate three years to sort out the details.

examples.chinese: 这份报告里出现了不少错别字，看来编辑的审核工作还需要加强。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào lǐ chūxiànle búshǎo cuòbiézì, kànlái biānjí de shěnhé gōngzuò háishi xūyào jiāqiáng.
examples.english: This report contains quite a few incorrectly written characters, which suggests the editor's proofreading work needs to be improved.

examples.chinese: 明天我将搭乘高铁前往上海出差，预计下午三点到达。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ jiāng dāchéng gāotiě qiánwǎng Shànghǎi chūchāi, yùjì xiàwǔ sān diǎn dàodá.
examples.english: Tomorrow I will travel by high-speed train to Shanghai for a business trip, expecting to arrive around 3 PM.

examples.chinese: 为了应对气候变化，各国正在搭建一个全球合作框架，共同制定更严格的减排标准。
examples.pinyin: Wèile yìngduì qìhòu biànhuà, gèguó zhèngzài dājiàn yīgè quánqiú hézuò kuàngjià, gòngtóng zhìdìng gèng yánggé de jiǎnpái biāozhǔn.
examples.english: To address climate change, countries are building a global cooperation framework to jointly establish stricter emission reduction standards.

examples.chinese: 这个项目虽然完成了，但在质量管理方面还没有达标，需要进一步改进。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù suīrán wánchéngle, dàn zài zhìliàng guǎnlǐ fāngmiàn háishi méiyǒu dábiāo, xūyào jìnyībù gǎijìn.
examples.english: Although this project has been completed, it has not yet reached the standard in terms of quality management and needs further improvement.

examples.chinese: 被告律师在法庭上针对控方的指控进行了有力的答辩，成功推翻了几项关键证据。
examples.pinyin: Bèi gào lǜ shī zài fǎ tíng shang zhēnduì kòng fāng de zhǐ kòng jìn xíng le yǒu lì de dábiàn, chéng gōng tuī fān le jǐ xiàng guān jiàn zhèng jù.
examples.english: The defendant's lawyer made a forceful rebuttal in court against the prosecution's accusations, successfully overturning several key pieces of evidence.

examples.chinese: 他总是在关键时刻打岔，让我无法专心完成工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì zài guānjiàn shíkè dǎ chà, ràng wǒ wúfǎ zhuānxīn wánchéng gōngzuò.
examples.english: He always interrupts at critical moments, preventing me from concentrating on completing my work.

examples.chinese: 历史上许多革命运动的目标都是打倒压迫人民的专制统治。
examples.pinyin: Lìshǐ shang xǔduō gémìng yùndòng de mùbiāo dōu shì dǎdào yāyà rénmín de zhuānzhì tǒngzhì.
examples.english: Throughout history, the goal of many revolutionary movements has been to overthrow despotic rule that oppressed the people.

examples.chinese: 在冗长的会议中，老王不禁打起了盹儿，直到被同事的肘部轻轻一戳才惊醒。
examples.pinyin: Zài rǒngcháng de huìyì zhōng, lǎo Wáng búnjìn dǎ qǐ le dǔnr, zhídào bèi tóngshì de zhǒubù qīngqīng yī chuō cái jīngxǐng.
examples.english: During the tedious meeting, Old Wang couldn't help but doze off until he was jolted awake by a gentle nudge from his colleague's elbow.

examples.chinese: 我不想打搅你的工作，但这件事确实需要立即讨论。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ búxiǎng dǎjiǎo nǐ de gōngzuò, dàn zhè jiàn shì quèshí xūyào lìjí tǎolùn.
examples.english: I don't want to disturb your work, but this matter really needs to be discussed immediately.

examples.chinese: 那艘沉船在海底躺了三十年，直到最近才被打捞上来进行考古研究。
examples.pinyin: Nà sōu chénchuán zài hǎidǐ tǎngle sānshí nián, zhídào zuìjìn cái bèi dǎlāo shànglái jìnxíng kǎogǔ yánjiū.
examples.english: That sunken ship lay at the bottom of the sea for thirty years until it was recently salvaged for archaeological research.

examples.chinese: 他用狐疑的眼神打量着这位陌生的访客，似乎在判断对方的真实意图。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng húyí de yǎnshén dǎliàng zhe zhè wèi mòshēng de fǎngkè, sìhū zài pànduàn duìfang de zhēnshí yìtú.
examples.english: He sized up the stranger with a suspicious gaze, seemingly trying to judge the visitor's true intentions.

examples.chinese: 在现代社会，很少有人再去打猎谋生，这种古老的生存方式已经逐渐被历史遗忘。
examples.pinyin: Zài xiàndài shèhuì, hěnshǎo yǒurén zài qù dǎliè móushēng, zhè zhǒng gǔlǎo de shēngcún fāngshì yǐjīng逐渐 bèi lìshǐ yíwàng.
examples.english: In modern society, very few people go hunting to make a living anymore; this ancient way of survival has gradually been forgotten by history.

examples.chinese: 这部电影经过多年的打磨，终于呈现出了导演心目中完美的艺术效果。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng jīngguò duō nián de dǎmó, zh终于 chéngxiàn chūle dǎoyǎn xīnmù zhōng wánměi de yìshù xiàooyìng.
examples.english: After years of refinement, this film finally presented the perfect artistic effect that the director envisioned.

examples.chinese: 经过多年的谈判，两国终于打通了贸易壁垒，实现了经济一体化。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò duō nián de tǎnpàn, liǎng guó zh终于 dǎ tōngle màoyì bìl垒, shíxiàn le jīngjì yītǐhuà.
examples.english: After years of negotiations, the two countries finally opened up trade barriers and achieved economic integration.

examples.chinese: 历史上许多帝国因为争夺领土而不断打仗，最终都走向了衰落。
examples.pinyin: Lìshǐ shang xǔduō dìguó yīnwèi zhēngduó lǐngtǔ érbuduàn dǎzhàng, zuìzh终 dōu zǒuxiàng le衰luò.
examples.english: Throughout history, many empires constantly fought battles over territorial disputes, and ultimately all declined.

english: to greet sb by word or action

examples.chinese: 在国际会议上，各国代表都会互相打招呼，交换名片，以便建立长期的合作关系。
examples.pinyin: Zài guójì huìyì shang, gèguó dàibiǎo dōu huì hùxiāng dǎ zhāohu, jiāohuàn míngpiàn, yǐbiàn jiànlì chángqī de hézuò guānxi.
examples.english: At international conferences, representatives from various countries greet each other and exchange business cards in order to establish long-term cooperative relationships.

examples.chinese: 这个项目经理总是大包大揽，结果导致团队成员的积极性严重受挫。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù jīnglǐ zǒngshì dàbāodàlǎn, jiéguǒ dǎozhì tuánduì chéngyuán de jījījīxìng yánzhòng shòucuò.
examples.english: This project manager always takes complete charge of everything, which as a result severely dampened the team members' enthusiasm.

examples.chinese: 这个项目花了大笔资金，但最终还是以失败告终。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù huāle dàbǐ zījīn, dàn zuìzh終háishi yǐ shībài gàozhōng.
examples.english: This project consumed a large sum of money, but ultimately ended in failure.

examples.chinese: 这位大臣因为贪污腐败被皇帝罢免了官职。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi dàchén yīnwèi tānwū fǔbài bèi huángdì bámiǎnle guānzhí.
examples.english: This courtier was dismissed from office by the emperor due to corruption and bribery.

examples.chinese: 当听到公司突然破产的消息时，董事长大吃一惊，甚至无法相信这是真实发生的事情。
examples.pinyin: Dāng tīngdào gōngsī túrán pòchǎn de xiāoxi shí, dǒngshìzhǎng dàchī-yījīng, shènzhì wúfǎ xiāngxìn zhè shì zhēnshí fāshēng de shìqing.
examples.english: When hearing the news that the company suddenly went bankrupt, the chairman was greatly shocked and even couldn't believe that this was actually happening.

examples.chinese: 她那大大咧咧的性格虽然让人觉得有些不拘小节，但也正是这份坦率赢得了大家的好感。
examples.pinyin: Tā nà dàda-liēliē de xìnggé suīrán ràng rén juéde yǒuxiē bújù xiǎojié, dàn yě zhèngshì zhè fèn tǎnlǜ yíngde le dàjiā de hǎogǎn.
examples.english: Her carefree personality, although making people feel she doesn't pay attention to details, is precisely this candor that has won everyone's favor.

examples.chinese: 经过几个小时的地震后，人们从废墟中爬出来，跪在大地上感谢自己还活着。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò jǐ ge xiǎoshíde de dìzhèn hòu, rénmen cóng fèixū zhōng páchūlái, guì zài dàdì shang gǎnxiè zìjǐ háishi huózhe.
examples.english: After several hours of earthquakes, people crawled out from the ruins and knelt on the earth, grateful that they were still alive.

examples.chinese: 这支大队在执行任务时遭遇了前所未有的困难,但他们仍然坚持完成了目标。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī dàduì zài zhíxíng rènwù shí zāoyù le qiánsuǒwèiyǒu de kùnnan, dàn tāmen仍然 jiānchí wánchéng le mùbiāo.
examples.english: This military group encountered unprecedented difficulties while executing their mission, but they still persisted and completed their objective.

examples.chinese: 公司今年的利润大幅度增长，超出了所有投资者的预期。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jīnnián de lìrùn dàfúdù zēngzhǎng, chāochūle suǒyǒu tóuzīzhě de yùqī.
examples.english: The company's profits this year have increased by a wide margin, exceeding all investors' expectations.

examples.chinese: 在这个大家庭里，每个人都有责任去维持家族的传统和价值观。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège dàjiātíng lǐ, měi ge rén dōu yǒu zérèn qù wéichí jiāzú de chuántǒng hé jiàzhíguan.
examples.english: In this extended family, everyone has the responsibility to maintain the family's traditions and values.

examples.chinese: 疫情期间，防疫工作人员走遍了城市的大街小巷，确保每个角落都得到了妥善的消毒处理。
examples.pinyin: Yìqíng qījiān, fángyì gōngzuò rényuán zǒubiàn le chéngshì de dàjiē xiǎoxiàng, quèbǎo měi ge jiǎoluò dōu dé到le tuǒshàn de xiāodú chǔlǐ.
examples.english: During the epidemic, epidemic prevention workers traversed every street and alley of the city to ensure that every corner received proper disinfection treatment.

english: to make a fuss about nothing (idiom)

examples.chinese: 你不用对这点小事大惊小怪，这在我们公司里再正常不过了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyòng duì zhè diǎn xiǎoshì dàjīng-xiǎoguài, zhè zài wǒmen gōngsī lǐ zài zhèngcháng búguò le.
examples.english: There's no need to make a fuss about such a trivial matter; this is completely normal in our company.

examples.chinese: 作为领导者，你必须着眼于大局，而不是被眼前的小利益所迷惑。
examples.pinyin: Zuòwéi lǐngdǎozhě, nǐ bìxū zháoyǎnyú dàjú, érbúshì bèi yǎnqián de xiǎo lìyì suǒ míhuò.
examples.english: As a leader, you must focus on the overall situation rather than be blinded by immediate small interests.

examples.chinese: 这个大款虽然家财万贯，但他对慈善事业的投入让人们改变了对富人的看法。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dàkuǎn suīrán jiācái wàn guàn, dàn tā duì císhàn shìyè de tóuruò ràng rénmen gǎibiàn le duì fùrén de kànfǎ.
examples.english: Although this wealthy person has enormous wealth, his investment in charitable causes has changed people's perception of the rich.

examples.chinese: 由于气候变化，非洲大面积的草原正在逐渐沙漠化，这对当地的野生动物造成了严重威胁。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú qìhòu biànhuà, Fēizhōu dàmiànjī de cǎoyuán zhèngzài zhújiàn shāmòhuà, zhè duì dāngdì de yěshēng dòngwù zàochéngle yánzhòng wēixié.
examples.english: Due to climate change, large areas of African grassland are gradually turning into desert, which poses serious threats to local wildlife.

examples.chinese: 这位大名鼎鼎的建筑师设计的摩天大楼已经成为了城市的标志性建筑。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi dàmíng-dǐngdǐng de jiànzhúshī shèjì de mótiānndàlóu yǐjīng chéngwéile chéngshì de biāozhìxìng jiànzhú.
examples.english: The skyscraper designed by this renowned architect has already become an iconic building of the city.

examples.chinese: 那个新来的经理大模大样地走进会议室，好像整个公司都是他的。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xīnlái de jīnglǐ dàmú-dàyàng de zǒujìn huìyìshì, háoxiàng zhěngge gōngsī dōu shì tā de.
examples.english: The newly arrived manager strutted into the conference room in an ostentatious manner, as if the entire company belonged to him.

examples.chinese: 由于气候变化，越来越多的农民开始投资建设大棚，以确保蔬菜产量的稳定性。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú qìhòu biànhuà, yuèláiyuèduō de nóngmín kāishǐ tóuzī jiànshè dàpéng, yǐ quèbǎo shūcài chǎnliàng de wěndìngxìng.
examples.english: Due to climate change, an increasing number of farmers have begun investing in building greenhouses to ensure the stability of vegetable production.

examples.chinese: 站在山顶上，我们眼前展现出一大片金黄色的麦田，随风摇曳，蔚为壮观。
examples.pinyin: Zhàn zài shānding shang, wǒmen yǎnqián zhǎnxiàn chū yī dàpiàn jīnhuáng sè de màitián, suíyuàn yáoyè, wèiwéi zhuàguān.
examples.english: Standing on the mountaintop, a vast expanse of golden wheat fields stretched out before our eyes, swaying in the wind, presenting a magnificent sight.

examples.chinese: 这位企业家虽然身家过亿，但待人接物非常大气，从不摆架子。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi qǐyèjiā suīrán shēnjiā guòyì, dàn dàirén jiēwù fēicháng dàqì, cóngbù bǎi jià zi.
examples.english: Although this entrepreneur is worth hundreds of millions, he is very generous and magnanimous in his dealings with others and never puts on airs.

examples.chinese: 这座历史悠久的大厦见证了这个城市过去几十年的沧桑变化。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò lìshǐ yōujiǔ de dàshà jiànzhèngle zhège chéngshì guòqù jǐ shí nián de cāngsāng biànhuà.
examples.english: This historic building has witnessed the dramatic changes of this city over the past few decades.

examples.chinese: 企业需要通过分析大数据来了解消费者的行为模式，从而制定更有效的市场策略。
examples.pinyin: Qǐyè xūyào tōngguò fēnxī dàshùjù lái liǎojiě xiāofèizhě de xíngwéi móshì, cóngér zhìdìng gèng yǒuxiàoliàng de shìchǎng cèlüè.
examples.english: Enterprises need to analyze big data to understand consumer behavior patterns, thereby formulating more effective market strategies.

examples.chinese: 那些不法商人大肆贩运假冒伪劣产品，严重损害了消费者的权益。
examples.pinyin: Nàxiē búfǎ shāngrén dàsì fànnyùn jiǎmào wěiliè chǎnpǐn, yánzhòng sǔnhài le xiāofèizhě de quányì.
examples.english: Those unscrupulous merchants wantonly trafficked in counterfeit and inferior products, seriously damaging consumers' rights and interests.

examples.chinese: 这个项目大体上已经完成了，只需要做一些微调和优化。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù dàtǐ shang yǐjīng wánchéngle, zhǐ xūyào zuò yīxiē wēidiào hé yōuhuà.
examples.english: This project is generally completed; it only needs some fine-tuning and optimization.

examples.chinese: 这个项目大体上已经完成了，只是还有一些细节需要调整。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù dàtǐshàng yǐjīng wánchéngle, zhǐshì háiyǒu yīxiē xì節需要tiáozhěng.
examples.english: Overall, this project has been completed, but there are still some details that need to be adjusted.

examples.chinese: 这几家餐厅的菜色虽然名字不同，但吃起来大同小异，都是典型的商业化味道。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ jiā cānting de càisè suīrán míngzi búdòng, dàn chīqǐlái dàtóng-xiǎoyì, dōu shì diǎnxíng de shāngyèhuà wèidào.
examples.english: Although these few restaurants have different dish names, they taste virtually the same, all with typical commercialized flavors.

examples.chinese: 娱乐圈里那些大腕儿往往能通过一部戏就改变自己的人生轨迹。
examples.pinyin: Yúlèquān lǐ nàxiē dàwànr wǎngwǎng néng tōngguò yībù xì jiù gǎibiàn zìjǐ de rénshēng guǐjī.
examples.english: The big names in the entertainment industry can often change the trajectory of their lives through a single film.

examples.chinese: 这次总统大选的结果出乎很多政治分析家的意料，反映了选民对现状的深刻不满。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì zǒngtǒng dàxuǎn de jiéguǒ chūhū hěnduō zhèngzhì fēnxī jiāhuà de yìliào, fǎnyìngle xuǎnmín duì xiànzhuàng de shēnkè búmǎn.
examples.english: The outcome of this presidential general election surprised many political analysts, reflecting voters' deep dissatisfaction with the status quo.

examples.chinese: 秋天时，成群的大雁从北方飞往南方，它们整齐的队形令人印象深刻。
examples.pinyin: Qiūtiān shí, chéngqún de dàyàn cóng běifāng fēi wǎng nánfāng, tāmen zhěngqī de duìxíng lìngrén yìnxiàng shēnkè.
examples.english: In autumn, flocks of wild geese fly from the north to the south, and their orderly formation leaves a deep impression on people.

examples.chinese: 虽然报告内容繁琐，但主要的大意是公司今年的利润增长了百分之三十。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán bàogào nèiróng繁琐，dàn zhǔyào de dàyi shì gōngsī jīnnián de lìrùn zēngzhǎngle bǎifēnzhī sānshí.
examples.english: Although the report content was tedious, the main gist was that the company's profits increased by thirty percent this year.

english: with great prospects for the future (idiom)

examples.chinese: 随着科技的发展，新能源领域大有可为，许多创业者都想在这个行业中有所作为。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe kējì de fāzhǎn, xīn néngliàng lǐngyù dàyǒu kěwéi, xǔduō chuàngyè zhě dōu xiǎng zài zhège hángyè zhōng yǒusuǒ zuòwéi.
examples.english: With the advancement of technology, the new energy sector has great prospects for the future, and many entrepreneurs want to make their mark in this industry.

examples.chinese: 随着电动汽车市场的扩大，电池原材料成为了大宗商品交易中最受关注的品种。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe diàndòng qìchē shìchǎng de kuòdà, diànchí yuáncái liào chéngwéile dàzōng shāngpǐn jiāoyì zhōng zuì shòu guānzhù de pǐnzhǒng.
examples.english: As the electric vehicle market expands, battery raw materials have become the most closely watched variety in bulk commodity trading.

examples.chinese: 警察成功逮捕了那些在银行抢劫的歹徒，他们已经作案多次了。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá chénggōng逮pǔ le nàxiē zài yínháng qiǎngjiè de dǎitú, tāmen yǐjīng zuòàn duō cì le.
examples.english: The police successfully arrested the evildoers who committed the bank robbery; they had committed crimes multiple times.

examples.chinese: 警察终于逮住了那个逃犯，他已经在逃亡了三个月。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá zhōngyú dǎizhù le nàge taófàn, tā yǐjīng zài taówàng le sān ge yuè.
examples.english: The police finally caught the fugitive, who had been on the run for three months.

examples.chinese: 由于公司业务扩展到国际市场，我们聘请了一位经验丰富的代理人来处理海外的法律事务。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú gōngsī yèwù kuòzhǎn dào guójì shìchǎng, wǒmen pìnqǐngle yī wèi jīngyàn fēngfù de dàilǐrén lái chǔlǐ hǎiwài de fǎlǜ shìwù.
examples.english: Because the company's business has expanded to international markets, we hired an experienced agent to handle overseas legal affairs.

examples.chinese: 这位著名演员成为了该品牌的官方代言人，他的加入大大提升了公司的市场形象。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zhùmíng yǎnyuán chéngwéile gāi pǐnpái de guānfāng dàiyánrén, tā de jiāruì dàdà tíshēngle gōngsī de shìchǎng xíngxiàng.
examples.english: This famous actor became the official spokesperson for the brand, and his involvement significantly enhanced the company's market image.

examples.chinese: 这位经验丰富的教练带队赢得了全国冠军，他的领导能力得到了业界的广泛认可。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi jīngyàn fēngfù de jiàoliàn dàiduì yíngdéle quánguó guàngjūn, tā de lǐngdǎo néngglì dé到le yèjiè de guǎngfàn rènkě.
examples.english: This experienced coach led the team to win the national championship, and his leadership ability gained widespread recognition from the industry.

examples.chinese: 在这个陌生的城市里，幸好有当地朋友为我们带路，否则我们早就迷路了。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège mòshēng de chéngshì lǐ, xìnghǎo yǒu dāngdì péngyou wèi wǒmen dàilù, fǒuzé wǒmen zǎojiù mìlù le.
examples.english: Fortunately, we had a local friend to lead the way in this unfamiliar city, otherwise we would have gotten lost long ago.

examples.chinese: 在这次改革中，我们的CEO带头接受了薪资削减，这个举动赢得了全体员工的尊重。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè cì gǎigé zhōng, wǒmen de CEO dàitóu jiēshòu le薪资 xuējiǎn, zhège jǔdòng yíngdéle quántǐ yuángōng de zūnjìng.
examples.english: In this reform, our CEO took the lead in accepting a salary cut, a move that won the respect of all employees.

examples.chinese: 这个项目一直待在概念阶段，直到新的投资者加入才得以推进。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù yìzhí dài zài gàiniàn jiēduàn, zhídào xīn de tóuzī zhě jiārù cái déyǐ tuījìn.
examples.english: This project remained in the conceptual stage until new investors joined and it could move forward.

english: to slacken off in one's work

examples.chinese: 由于管理层的不公正决定，许多员工开始怠工，导致整个项目的进度严重受阻。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú guǎnlǐcéng de búgōngzhèng juédìng, xǔduō yuángōng kāishǐ dàigōng, dǎozhì zhěnggè xiàngmù de jìnchéng yánzhòng shòuzǔ.
examples.english: Due to unjust decisions by the management, many employees began to slacken off in their work, which severely hindered the progress of the entire project.

examples.chinese: 他因为工作繁忙而怠慢了老朋友，现在感到很后悔。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi gōngzuò繁忙 érhuò dàimàn le lǎo péngyou, xiànzài gǎndào hěn hòuhuǐ.
examples.english: He neglected his old friends due to being busy with work, and now he feels very regretful.

examples.chinese: 警方在经过数月的调查后，终于逮捕了这名涉嫌贪污的官员。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngfāng zài jīngguò shù yuè de diàochá hòu, zhōngyú dàibǔ le zhè míng shèyí tānwū de guānyuán.
examples.english: After months of investigation, the police finally arrested the official suspected of corruption.

examples.chinese: 作为项目经理，他担负着整个团队的责任，不能有半点懈怠。
examples.pinyin: Zuòwéi xiàngmù jīnglǐ, tā dānfù zhe zhěngge tuánduì de zérènwù, búnéng yǒu bàndiǎn xièhuǎ.
examples.english: As a project manager, he undertakes the responsibility for the entire team and cannot afford any negligence.

examples.chinese: 作为公司的领导者，他必须担当起带领团队度过难关的责任。
examples.pinyin: Zuòwéi gōngsī de lǐngdǎozhě, tā bìxū dāndāng qǐ dàilǐng tuánduì dùguò nánguān de zérènwù.
examples.english: As the leader of the company, he must take upon himself the responsibility of guiding the team through difficulties.

examples.chinese: 作为公司的管理层，他必须担负起带领团队度过经济危机的责任。
examples.pinyin: Zuòwéi gōngsī de guǎnlǐcéng, tā bìxū dānfù qǐ dàilǐng tuánduì dùguò jīngjì wēijī de zérènwu.
examples.english: As a member of the company's management, he must bear the responsibility of leading the team through the economic crisis.

examples.chinese: 这个贸易协议不能是单边的，必须建立在互利互惠的基础之上。
examples.pinyin: Zhège màoyì xiéyì búnéng shì dānbiān de, bìxū jiànlì zài hùlì hùhuì de jīchǔ zhī shang.
examples.english: This trade agreement cannot be unilateral; it must be established on the basis of mutual benefit and reciprocity.

examples.chinese: 他的论证显得有些单薄，无法说服评委们接受他的研究方案。
examples.pinyin: Tā de lùnzhèng xiǎnde yǒuxiē dānbó, wúfǎ shuōfúk pǐngwěi men jiēshòu tā de yánjiū fāng'àn.
examples.english: His argument appeared rather weak and failed to convince the judges to accept his research proposal.

examples.chinese: 这个贸易协议不能单方面撤销，否则会引发国际纠纷。
examples.pinyin: Zhège màoyì xiéyì búnéng dānfāngmiàn chèxiāo, fǒuzé huì yǐnfā guójì jiūfēn.
examples.english: This trade agreement cannot be unilaterally withdrawn, otherwise it will trigger international disputes.

examples.chinese: 在大城市里，越来越多的年轻人选择长期单身，这反映了现代社会价值观的深刻变化。
examples.pinyin: Zài dà chéngshì lǐ, yuèláiyuè duō de niánqīng rén xuǎnzé chángqī dānshēn, zhè fǎnyìngle xiàndài shèhuì jiàzhíguān de shēnkè biànhuà.
examples.english: In big cities, an increasing number of young people choose to remain single for the long term, which reflects profound changes in modern society's values.

examples.chinese: 这个项目因为资金问题耽搁了半年，最后还是没有按时完成。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù yīnwèi zījīn wèntí dāngele bàn nián, zuìhòu háishi méiyǒu ànshí wánchéng.
examples.english: This project was delayed for half a year due to funding issues, and ultimately was not completed on schedule.

examples.chinese: 由于交通堵塞，他迟到了，这次的耽误让他错过了重要的商务会议。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú jiāotōng dǔsè, tā chídào le, zhè cì de dānwu ràng tā cuòguò le zhòngyào de shāngwù huìyì.
examples.english: Due to traffic congestion, he was delayed, and this delay caused him to miss an important business meeting.

examples.chinese: 他虽然出身贫寒，但凭着过人的胆子和决心，最终成为了业界的领袖人物。
examples.pinyin: Tā suīrán chūshēn pínhán, dàn píngzhe guòrén de dǎnzi hé juéxīn, zuìzhōng chéngwéile yèjiè de lǐngxiù rénwù.
examples.english: Although he came from humble beginnings, through his exceptional courage and determination, he eventually became a leading figure in the industry.

examples.chinese: 但愿这次谈判能够圆满成功，为两国的长期合作奠定坚实的基础。
examples.pinyin: Dànyuàn zhè cì tǎnpàn nénggoù yuánmǎn chénggōng, wèi liǎng guó de cháng期 hézuò diàndìng jiānshí de jīchǔ.
examples.english: I sincerely wish that this round of negotiations will be a complete success and lay a solid foundation for long-term cooperation between the two countries.

english: carrying pole and the loads on it

examples.chinese: 这些年来，他肩上的担子越来越重，但他从未想过要放弃自己的责任。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē niánlái, tā jiānshang de dànzi yuèláiyuè zhòng, dàn tā cóngwèi xiǎngguò yào fàngqì zìjǐ de zérèn.
examples.english: Over the years, the burden on his shoulders has become heavier and heavier, but he has never thought about abandoning his responsibilities.

examples.chinese: 今年是伟大文学家的诞辰一百周年，全国各地都举办了纪念活动。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián shì wěidà wénxuéjiā de dànchén yībǎi zhōunián, quánguó gè dì dōu jǔbàn le jìniàn huódòng.
examples.english: This year marks the centennial of the great writer's birth, and commemorative activities have been held throughout the country.

examples.chinese: 随着全球化进程的加快，传统文化的独特性正在逐渐淡化。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe quánqiúhuà jìnchéng de jiākuài, chuántǒng wénhuà de dúshùxìng zhèngzài zhújiàn dànhuà.
examples.english: As the pace of globalization accelerates, the uniqueness of traditional culture is gradually fading away.

examples.chinese: 虽然冬季是旅游的淡季，但许多游客反而更喜欢这个时候去旅游，因为酒店价格便宜，人也少。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán dōngjì shì lǚyóu de dànjì, dàn xǔduō yóukè fǎnér gèng xǐhuān zhège shíhou qù lǚyóu, yīnwèi jiǔdiàn jiàgé piányi, rén yě shǎo.
examples.english: Although winter is the off-season for tourism, many tourists actually prefer to travel during this time because hotel prices are cheaper and there are fewer crowds.

examples.chinese: 长期缺乏蛋白质会导致肌肉萎缩和免疫功能下降，这是营养不良最常见的表现。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī quēfá dànbáizhì huì dǎozhì jīròu wěisuō hé miǎnyì gōngnéng xiàjiàng, zhè shì yíngyǎng búliáng zuì chángjiàn de biǎoxiàn.
examples.english: Prolonged protein deficiency can lead to muscle atrophy and decreased immune function, which are the most common manifestations of malnutrition.

examples.chinese: 听到这个消息后，董事长当即决定召开紧急会议，讨论公司的应对策略。
examples.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxī hòu, dǒngshìzhǎng dāngjí juéding zhàokāi jǐnjí huìyì, tǎolùn gōngsī de yìngduì cèlüè.
examples.english: Upon hearing the news, the chairman immediately decided to call an emergency meeting to discuss the company's response strategy.

examples.chinese: 当今社会的快速发展使得许多传统价值观面临前所未有的挑战。
examples.pinyin: Dāngjīn shèhuì de kuàisù fāzhǎn shǐde xǔduō chuántǒng jiàzhíguān miànlín qiánsuǒwèiyǒu de tiǎozhàn.
examples.english: The rapid development of contemporary society has caused many traditional values to face unprecedented challenges.

examples.chinese: 他当面承诺会帮助我们，背后却做了完全相反的事情。
examples.pinyin: Tā dāngmiàn chéngnuò huì bāngzhù wǒmen, bèihòu却 zuòle wánquán xiāngfǎn de shìqing.
examples.english: He promised directly to help us, but behind our backs he did something completely opposite.

examples.chinese: 这次重要会议当日召开，与会代表就经济改革问题进行了深入讨论。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì zhòngyào huìyì dāngrì zhàokāi, yǔhuì dàibiǎo jiù jīngjì gǎigé wèntí jìnxíng le shēnrù tǎolùn.
examples.english: The important meeting was held on that day, and the attending representatives engaged in an in-depth discussion about economic reform issues.

examples.chinese: 法院要求双方当事人提供充分的证据来支持各自的主张。
examples.pinyin: Fǎyuàn yāoqiú shuāngfāng dāngshìrén tígōng ch充fèn de zhèngjù lái zhīchí gèzì de zhǔzhāng.
examples.english: The court required both parties involved to provide sufficient evidence to support their respective claims.

examples.chinese: 在经济下行压力加大的形势下，稳就业已经成为政府工作的当务之急。
examples.pinyin: Zài jīngjì xiàxíng yālì jiādà de xíngshì xià, wěn jiùyè yǐjīng chéngwéi zhèngfǔ gōngzuò de dāngwùzhījí.
examples.english: With mounting economic downward pressure, stabilizing employment has become the top priority for government work.

examples.chinese: 面对这个突如其来的危机,领导层当下必须做出果断的决定,否则后果将不堪设想。
examples.pinyin: miànduì zhège túrúqīlái de wēijī, lǐngdǎocéng dāngxià bìxū zuòchū guǒduàn de juédìng, fǒuze hòuguǒ jiāng búkānshèxiǎng.
examples.english: Faced with this sudden crisis, the leadership must make a decisive decision immediately, otherwise the consequences will be unimaginable.

examples.chinese: 在这个竞争激烈的市场中，你要当心那些看似诱人的投资机会，很多都是骗局。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège jìngjìng jīliè de shìchǎng zhōng, nǐ yào dāngxīn nàxiē kànsì yòurén de tóuzī jīhuì, hěnduō dōu shì piànjú.
examples.english: In this fiercely competitive market, you need to be careful of those seemingly attractive investment opportunities—many of them are scams.

examples.chinese: 他当着所有同事的面宣布了这个重要决定，这让大家都感到很意外。
examples.pinyin: Tā dāngzhe suǒyǒu tóngshì de miàn xuānbù le zhège zhòngyào juédìng, zhè ràng dàjiā dōu gǎndào hěn yìwài.
examples.english: He announced this important decision in front of all his colleagues, which surprised everyone.

examples.chinese: 经过多年的坚持和创新，他成为了这个领域的专家，获得国际大奖当之无愧。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò duō nián de jiānchí hé chuàngxīn, tā chéngwéile zhège lǐngyù de zhuānjiā, huòdé guójì dà jiǎng dāngzhī-wúkuì.
examples.english: After years of persistence and innovation, he became an expert in this field, and winning the international award was fully deserved.

examples.chinese: 他在董事会上当众承认了自己的错误，这需要很大的勇气。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài dǒngshìhuì shàng dāngzhòng chéngrènle zìjǐ de cuòwù, zhè xūyào hěn dà de yǒngqì.
examples.english: He publicly admitted his mistake at the board meeting, which took great courage.

examples.chinese: 那场演唱会结束后，观众当晚就在社交媒体上热烈讨论起歌手的精彩表现。
examples.pinyin: Nà chǎng yǎnchànghuì jiéshù hòu, guānzhòng dàngwǎn jiù zài shèjiāo méitǐ shang rèliè tǎolùn qǐ gēeshǒu de jīngcǎi biǎoxiàn.
examples.english: After that concert ended, the audience that very evening immediately engaged in heated discussions on social media about the singer's outstanding performance.

examples.chinese: 他说的话听起来像玩笑，但我觉得不能不当真，因为他从来不会无缘无故地这样说。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō de huà tīng qǐlai xiàng wány笑, dàn wǒ juéde búnéng búdàngzhēn, yīnwèi tā cóngláibú huì wúyuányúngù de zhèyàng shuō.
examples.english: What he said sounds like a joke, but I don't think we can take it lightly, because he would never say something like this without reason.

examples.chinese: 微风吹过湖面，阳光在水面上荡漾，映照出金色的光芒。
examples.pinyin: Wēifēng chuīguò húmiàn, yángguāng zài shuǐmiàn shang dàngyàng, yìngzhào chū jīnsè de guāngmáng.
examples.english: As the breeze swept across the lake surface, sunlight rippled on the water, reflecting golden rays of light.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅虽然价格便宜，但从装修、服务到菜品的档次来看，完全可以和五星级酒店相媲美。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng suīrán jiàgé piányi, dàn cóng zhuāngxiū, fúwù dào càipǐn de dàngcì lái kàn, wánquán kěyǐ hé wǔ xīngjí jiǔdiàn xiāng píbǐ.
examples.english: Although this restaurant has affordable prices, in terms of the grade of its décor, service, and dishes, it can completely rival five-star hotels.

examples.chinese: 随着科技的进步，许多国家都在研发更先进的导弹防御系统来应对日益复杂的安全威胁。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe kējì de jìnbù, xǔduō guójiā dōu zài yánfā gèng xiāngjìn de dǎodàn fángyù xìtǒng lái yìngduì rìyì fùzá de ānquán wēixié.
examples.english: With the advancement of technology, many countries are developing more advanced missile defense systems to address increasingly complex security threats.

examples.chinese: 这款GPS导航系统能够实时更新路况信息，帮助驾驶员规避拥堵。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn GPS dǎoháng xìtǒng nénggoù shíshí gēngxīn lùkuàng xìnxī, bāngzhù jiàshǐyuán guīhuī yōngdǔ.
examples.english: This GPS navigation system can update traffic information in real time, helping drivers avoid congestion.

examples.chinese: 这次丑闻成为了引发政治危机的导火索，最终导致了几位高官的辞职。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì chǒuwen chéngwéile yǐnfā zhèngzhì wēijī de dǎohuǒsuǒ, zuìzh终 dǎozhì le jǐ wèi gāoguān de cizhí.
examples.english: This scandal became the fuse that ignited a political crisis, ultimately leading to the resignation of several high-ranking officials.

examples.chinese: 我的博士导师在学术界享有很高的声誉，他的研究成果对整个领域产生了深远的影响。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de báoshì dǎoshī zài xuéshùjiè xiǎngyǒu hěn gāo de shēngyù, tā de yánjiū chéngguǒ duì zhěngge lǐngyù chǎnshēngle shēnyuǎn de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: My doctoral advisor enjoys a high reputation in academic circles, and his research achievements have had a profound impact on the entire field.

examples.chinese: 这项政策的核心导向是促进经济可持续发展，而不是盲目追求GDP增长。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè de héxin dǎoxiàng shì cùjìn jīngjì kěchíxù fāzhǎn, érbúshì mángmù zhuīqiú GDP zēngzhǎng.
examples.english: The core orientation of this policy is to promote sustainable economic development, rather than blindly pursuing GDP growth.

examples.chinese: 这片群岛屿之间的航道曾经是古代海上贸易的重要枢纽。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piàn qún dǎoyǔ zhī jiān de hángdào céngjīng shì gǔdài hǎishang màoyì de zhòngyào shūniǔ.
examples.english: The waterways between these islands were once an important hub of ancient maritime trade.

examples.chinese: 那个调皮的孩子总是在课堂上捣乱，严重影响了其他同学的学习效率。
examples.pinyin: Nàge tiáopiqi de háizi zǒngshì zài kètáng shang dǎoluàn, yánzhòng yǐngxiǎngle qítā tóngxué de xuéxí xiàolǜ.
examples.english: That mischievous child is always causing disruptions in class, seriously affecting other students' learning efficiency.

examples.chinese: 那些黄牛党倒卖演唱会门票，从中获利数百万，最终被警方查处。
examples.pinyin: Nàxiē huángniú dǎng dǎomài yǎnchànghuì ménpiào, cóngzhōng huòlì shù bǎi wàn, zuìzh终 bèi jǐngfāng chájù.
examples.english: Those scalpers resold concert tickets for profit, making millions in the process, but were eventually caught by the police.

examples.chinese: 他这次真是倒霉，好不容易争取到的项目合同却因为一个小细节被对方撤销了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhè cì zhēnshi dǎoméi, hǎo bu róngyì zhēngqǔ dào de xiàngmù hétonɡ què yīnwèi yī ɡe xiǎo xìjié bèi duìfāng chèxiāo le.
examples.english: He was truly unlucky this time; the project contract he had worked so hard to secure was withdrawn by the other party because of a minor detail.

examples.chinese: 那场地震导致了许多老旧建筑倒塌，幸运的是大部分居民已经提前撤离了。
examples.pinyin: Nà chǎng dìzhèn dǎozhìle xǔduō lǎojiù jiànzhù dǎotā, xìngyùnde shì dàbùfen jūmín yǐjīng tíqián chèlíle.
examples.english: That earthquake caused many old buildings to collapse, fortunately most residents had evacuated in advance.

examples.chinese: 经过多年的财务困难和管理不善，这家曾经辉煌的企业最终还是倒下了。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò duō nián de cáiwù kùnnan hé guǎnlǐ búshàn, zhè jiā céngqing huīhuáng de qǐyè zuìzhōng háishi dǎoxià le.
examples.english: After years of financial difficulties and poor management, this once-glorious company eventually collapsed.

examples.chinese: 他花了多年时间追求名利，到头来才意识到这些都不如家人重要。
examples.pinyin: Tā huāle duō nián shíjiān zhuīqiú mínglì, dàotóulái cái yìshi dào zhèixiē dōu búrú jiārén zhòngyào.
examples.english: After spending years pursuing fame and fortune, he finally realized that none of it was as important as his family.

english: to get to the intended location

examples.chinese: 这次项目的执行方案还没有到位，我们需要在下周之前完成所有的准备工作。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì xiàngmù de zhíxíng fāng'àn háishi méiyǒu dàowèi, wǒmen xūyào zài xiàzhōu zhīqián wánchéng suǒyǒu de zhǔnbèi gōngzuò.
examples.english: The implementation plan for this project is not yet in place, and we need to complete all the preparatory work before next week.

examples.chinese: 火箭发射前，工作人员开始倒数，每个人都屏住呼吸等待那激动人心的一刻。
examples.pinyin: Huǒjiàn fāshè qián, gōngzuò rényuán kāishǐ dàoshǔ, měi ge rén dōu píngzhù hūxī děngdài nà jīdòng rénxīn de yī kè.
examples.english: Before the rocket launch, the staff began counting down, and everyone held their breath waiting for that thrilling moment.

examples.chinese: 这个文物贩子因盗取国家级文物而被判处终身监禁。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wénwù fānzi yīn dàoqǔ guójiā jí wénwù érshì bèi pànchǔ zh終身 jiānjìn.
examples.english: The artifact smuggler was sentenced to life imprisonment for stealing state-level cultural relics.

examples.chinese: 警方破获了一起涉及多个城市的盗窃珠宝案，抓捕了五名犯罪嫌疑人。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngfāng pòhuòle le yī qǐ shèjī duō ge chéngshì de dàoqiè zhūbǎo àn, zhuābǔle wǔ míng fànzuì xiányi rén.
examples.english: The police cracked a jewelry theft case involving multiple cities and arrested five criminal suspects.

examples.chinese: 全国各地的人民纷纷来到纪念馆悼念那位为国献身的英雄。
examples.pinyin: Quánguó gèdì de rénmín纷纷 lái dào jìniànguǎn dàoniàn nàwèi wèi guó xiànshēn de yīngxióng.
examples.english: People from all over the country came to the memorial hall to grieve for the hero who sacrificed himself for the nation.

examples.chinese: 这部话剧的成功离不开精良的舞台设计和逼真的道具，每一件道具都经过了精心挑选和制作。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù huàjù de chénggōng líbukāi jīngliáng de wǔtái shèjì hé bīzhēn de dàojù, měi yī jiàn dàojù dōu jīngguòle jīngxīn tiāoxuǎn hé zhìzuò.
examples.english: The success of this theatrical play is inseparable from its refined stage design and realistic props, with each prop carefully selected and crafted.

examples.chinese: 农民们用稻草覆盖田地，既能保持土壤湿度，又能在冬季为植物提供保护。
examples.pinyin: Nóngmín men yòng dàocǎo fùgài tiándì, jì néng bǎochí tǔrǎng shīdù, yòu néng zài dōngjì wèi zhíwù tígōng bǎohù.
examples.english: The farmers use rice straw to cover the fields, which both maintains soil moisture and provides protection for plants during winter.

english: the gains do not make up for the losses (idiom)

examples.chinese: 为了赶上这班飞机而放弃那个重要的商务会议，实在是得不偿失。
examples.pinyin: Wèile gǎnshàng zhè bān fēijī ér fàngqì nàge zhòngyào de shāngwù huìyì, shízài shì débùchángshī.
examples.english: Sacrificing that important business meeting just to catch this flight is really not worth the loss.

examples.chinese: 领导对这次危机的处理得当，避免了公司进一步的损失。
examples.pinyin: Lǐngdǎo duì zhè cì wēijī de chǔlǐ dédàng, bìmiǎnle gōngsī jìnyībù de sǔnshī.
examples.english: The leader's handling of this crisis was appropriate, preventing further losses to the company.

examples.chinese: 这个项目能够顺利完成，主要得力于团队成员的密切配合和领导的正确指导。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù néng gòu shùnlì wánchéng, zhǔyào dé lì yú tuánduì chéngyuán de mìqiè pèihé hé lǐngdǎo de zhèngquè zhǐdǎo.
examples.english: The successful completion of this project is mainly due to the close cooperation of team members and the correct guidance of the leadership.

examples.chinese: 在这场商业谈判中，双方都在仔细衡量各自的得失，试图找到一个双赢的方案。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè chǎng shāngyè tánpàn zhōng, shuāngfāng dōu zài zǐxì héngliàng gèzì de déshī, shìtú zhǎodào yī ge shuāngyíng de fāng'àn.
examples.english: In this business negotiation, both parties are carefully weighing their respective gains and losses, trying to find a win-win solution.

examples.chinese: 这次收购谈判进行了三个月，最后终于得手了，公司的市场份额大幅增长。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shōugòu tánpàn jìnxíngle sān ge yuè, zuìhòu zh终于 dé shǒu le, gōngsī de shìchǎng fèn'é dà fú zēngzhǎng.
examples.english: After three months of acquisition negotiations, the deal finally went through smoothly, and the company's market share increased significantly.

examples.chinese: 她在国际会议上的发言既得体又有说服力，赢得了与会代表的一致好评。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài guójì huìyì shang de fāyán j既 détǐ yòu yǒu shuōfúlì, yíngdéle yǔhuìdài biǎo de yīzhì hǎopíng.
examples.english: Her speech at the international conference was both appropriate and persuasive, earning unanimous praise from the representatives.

examples.chinese: 这个地区得天独厚的地理位置和丰富的自然资源，使其成为了经济发展的新引擎。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū détiān-dúhòu de dìlǐ wèizhì hé fēngfù de zìránzīyuán, shǐqī chénglewéile jīngjì fāzhǎn de xīn yǐnq擎。
examples.english: This region's blessed geographical location and abundant natural resources have made it a new engine for economic development.

examples.chinese: 这家公司的快速发展得益于创始人的远见卓识和团队的不懈努力。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī de kuàisù fāzhǎn déyìyú chuàngshǐrén de yuǎnjiàn zhuózhī hé tuánduì de búxié nǔlì.
examples.english: The rapid development of this company benefited from the founder's visionary insight and the team's tireless efforts.

examples.chinese: 他因为赢得了比赛冠军而得意扬扬，甚至在媒体面前也毫不谦虚地炫耀自己的成就。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi yíngdéle bǐsài guànjūn érde déyì-yángyáng, shènzhì zài méitǐ miànqián yě háobù謙xū de xuànyào zìjǐ de chéngjìu.
examples.english: He was joyfully satisfied after winning the championship, and even boasted shamelessly about his achievements in front of the media.

examples.chinese: 我是通过新闻报道才得知这个项目已经被叫停的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shì tōngguò xīnwén bàodào cái dézhī zhège xiàngmù yǐjīng bèi jiàotíng de.
examples.english: I only found out through news reports that this project had already been halted.

examples.chinese: 我之前的言论可能得罪了一些人，为此我感到很遗憾。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhīqián de yánlùn kěnéng dézuì le yīxiē rén, wèi cǐ wǒ gǎndào hěn yíhàn.
examples.english: My previous remarks may have offended some people, and I feel regretful about that.

examples.chinese: 德国的哲学传统对整个欧洲思想体系产生了深远的影响。
examples.pinyin: Déguó de zhéxué chuántǒng duì zhěngge Ōuzhōu sīxiǎng tǐxì chǎnshēngle shēnyuǎn de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: The philosophical tradition of Germany has had a profound influence on the entire European system of thought.

examples.chinese: 每到元宵节，城市的大街小巷都会挂满各式各样的灯笼，营造出浓厚的传统节日氛围。
examples.pinyin: Měi dào yuánxiāo jié, chéngshì de dàjiē xiǎoxiàng dōu huì guàmǎn gèshì gèyàng de dēnglong, yíngzào chū nóng厚 de chuántǒng jiérì fēnwéi.
examples.english: Every Lantern Festival, streets and alleys throughout the city are decorated with lanterns of all kinds, creating a strong traditional holiday atmosphere.

examples.chinese: 这个老旧的灯泡虽然还能亮，但效率太低了，我们应该换成LED灯泡来节能。
examples.pinyin: Zhège lǎojiù de dēngpào suīrán háishi néng liàng, dàn xiàolǜ tài dī le, wǒmen yīnggāi huàn chéng LED dēngpào lái jiéenéng.
examples.english: Although this old light bulb can still light up, its efficiency is too low. We should replace it with LED light bulbs to save energy.

examples.chinese: 由于恶劣天气，许多乘客被迫延迟登机，航空公司为此向他们提供了免费的餐饮和住宿。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú ěliè tiānqì, xǔduō chéngkè bèi pòpò yánchí dēngjī, hángkōng gōngsī wèicǐ xiàng tāmen tígōngle miǎnfèi de cānyǐn hé zhùsù.
examples.english: Due to severe weather, many passengers were forced to delay boarding the plane, and the airline consequently provided them with complimentary meals and accommodation.

examples.chinese: 这支考察队成功地登陆了南极大陆，为科学研究带来了宝贵的第一手资料。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī kǎochá duì chénggōng de dēng lù le Nánjí dàlù, wèi kēxué yánjiū dàilái le báoguì de dì yī shǒu zīliào.
examples.english: This expedition team successfully landed on the Antarctic continent, bringing valuable firsthand data to scientific research.
