examples.chinese: 在这个竞争激烈的时代，端好自己的饭碗需要不断提升专业技能和适应能力。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège jìngjìng jīliè de shídài, duānhǎo zìjǐ de fànwǎn xūyào búduàn tíshēng zhuānyè jìnéng hé shìyìng néunglì.
examples.english: In this highly competitive era, maintaining one's livelihood requires constantly improving professional skills and adaptability.

examples.chinese: 由于气候变化，极端降雨事件频繁发生，导致洪水泛滥成灾，给农业生产造成了巨大损失。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú qìhòu biànhuà, jíduān jiàngyu shìjiàn pínfán fāshēng, dǎozhì hónghuǐ fànlàn chénɡzāi, ɡěi nónɡyè shēnɡchǎn zàozào le jùdà sǔnshī.
examples.english: Due to climate change, extreme rainfall events occur frequently, resulting in flooding disasters that have caused tremendous losses to agricultural production.

examples.chinese: 这个问题已经超出了传统哲学的范畴，涉及到了现代科学和伦理学的交叉领域。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí yǐjīng chāochūle chuántǒng zhéxué de fànchóu,涉及dàole xiàndài kēxué hé lúnlǐxué de jiāochā lǐngyù.
examples.english: This question has already gone beyond the scope of traditional philosophy, involving the intersection of modern science and ethics.

examples.chinese: 执法部门加大力度打击贩卖人口的犯罪集团，确保受害者能够得到及时救助。
examples.pinyin: Zhíhuò bùmén jiādà lìdu dǎjī fànmài rénkǒu de fànzuì jítuán, quèbǎo shòuhàizhě néng gòuhuò jíshí jiùzhù.
examples.english: Law enforcement agencies stepped up efforts to crack down on criminal gangs engaged in human trafficking to ensure victims receive timely assistance.

examples.chinese: 这个项目虽然投入了大量资金，但从方方面面来看，我们仍然需要进一步完善管理体系。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù suīrán tóuruìle dàliàng zījīn, dàn cóng fāngfāng-miànmiàn lái kàn, wǒmen仍然 xūyào jìnyībù wánshàn guǎnlǐ tǐxì.
examples.english: Although this project has invested a lot of capital, from all perspectives, we still need to further improve our management system.

examples.chinese: 他紧紧握住方向盘，试图在这场暴雨中保持对车辆的控制。
examples.pinyin: Tā jǐnjǐn wòzhù fāngxiàngpán, shìtú zài zhè chǎng bàoyǔ zhōng bǎochí duì chēliàng de kòngzhì.
examples.english: He gripped the steering wheel tightly, attempting to maintain control of the vehicle in this torrential downpour.

examples.chinese: 这部古籍详细记录了不同地区的方言特征，对现代语言学研究有着重要的参考价值。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù gǔjí xiáng细 jìlù le búntóng dìqū de fāngyán tèzh征, duì xiàndài yǔyánxué yánjiū yǒuzhe zhòngyào de cānkǎo jiàzhí.
examples.english: This ancient text records in detail the dialectal characteristics of different regions, which has significant reference value for modern linguistic research.

examples.chinese: 这个小区安装了先进的防盗系统，居民们的财产安全得到了有效保障。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiǎoqū ānzhuāngle xiāngjìn de fángdào xìtǒng, jūmínmen de cáichǎn ānquán dé到le yǒuxiào bǎozhàng.
examples.english: This residential community installed an advanced anti-theft system, which effectively ensured the property safety of the residents.

examples.chinese: 这栋老旧的公寓楼最近统一安装了新的防盗门，提高了整个建筑的安全系数。
examples.pinyin: Zhè栋 lǎojiù de gōngyù lóu zuìjìn tǒngyī ānzhuāngle xīn de fángdàomén, tígāole zh整个 jiànzhù de ānquán xìshù.
examples.english: This old apartment building recently had new entrance doors uniformly installed, which improved the overall security level of the entire structure.

examples.chinese: 在疫情期间，医护人员需要穿戴完整的防护装备来保护自己和患者。
examples.pinyin: Zài yìqíng qījiān, yīhùrényuán xūyào chuānduài wánzhěng de fánghù zhuāngbèi lái bǎohù zìjǐ hé huànzhě.
examples.english: During the pandemic, medical staff need to wear complete protective equipment to protect themselves and their patients.

examples.chinese: 公司的IT部门最近升级了防火墙系统，以便更有效地防御日益复杂的网络攻击。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de IT bùmén zuìjìn shēngjíle fánghuǒqiáng xìtǒng, yǐbiàn gèng yǒuxiào地 fángyù rìyì fùzá de wǎngluò gōngjī.
examples.english: The company's IT department recently upgraded the firewall system in order to more effectively defend against increasingly sophisticated cyber attacks.

examples.chinese: 在国际争端中，每个国家都有权利采取必要的防卫措施来保护自己的领土和人民。
examples.pinyin: Zài guójì zhēngduàn zhōng, měi ge guójiā dōu yǒu quánlì cǎiqǔ bìyào de fángwèi cuòshī lái bǎohù zìjǐ de lǐngtǔ hé rénmín.
examples.english: In international disputes, every country has the right to take necessary defensive measures to protect its territory and people.

examples.chinese: 政府采取了一系列严格的防疫措施，以防止病毒进一步传播。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ cǎiqǔle yī xìliè yánggé de fángyì cuòshī, yǐ fángzhǐ bìngdú jìnyībù chuánbō.
examples.english: The government implemented a series of strict disease prevention measures to prevent further spread of the virus.

examples.chinese: 这个国家投入了大量资金来加强其防御系统，以应对日益复杂的安全威胁。
examples.pinyin: Zhège guójiā tóurùle dàliàng zījīn lái jiāqiáng qī fángyù xìtǒng, yǐ yìngduì rìyì fùzá de ānquán wēixié.
examples.english: This country invested substantial funds to strengthen its defense system in response to increasingly complex security threats.

examples.chinese: 这些繁琐的行政程序妨碍了创新企业的发展，必须进行改革。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē fánsuǒ de xíngzhèng chéngxù fángài le chuàngxīn qǐyè de fāzhǎn, bìxū jìnxíng gǎigé.
examples.english: These cumbersome administrative procedures preclude the development of innovative enterprises, and reforms must be implemented.

examples.chinese: 这部房地产题材的电影成为了今年的大黑马，票房收入超过了所有人的预期。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù fángdìchǎn tícái de diànyǐng chéngwéi le jīnnián de dà hēimǎ, piàofáng shōuru chāoguò le suǒyǒu rén de yùqī.
examples.english: This real estate-themed film became this year's dark horse, with box office revenue exceeding everyone's expectations.

examples.chinese: 这项改革措施不会妨害企业的正常运营，反而会促进市场的健康发展。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gǎigé cuòshī búhuì fánghài qǐyè de zhèngcháng yùnyíng, fǎn'ér huì cùjìn shìchǎng de jiànkāng fāzhǎn.
examples.english: This reform measure will not impede the normal operations of enterprises; on the contrary, it will promote healthy market development.

examples.chinese: 他仿佛在梦游一样，机械地重复着同样的动作。
examples.pinyin: Tā fǎngfú zài mèngyóu yīyàng, jīxiè de chóngfù zhe tónyàng de dòngzuò.
examples.english: He seemed to be sleepwalking, mechanically repeating the same movements.

examples.chinese: 这家工厂因为仿制名牌产品被工商部门责令停业整顿。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng yīnwèi fǎngzhì míngpái chǎnpǐn bèi gōngshāng bùmén zérìng tíngyè zhěngdùn.
examples.english: The factory was ordered by the industrial and commercial administration to cease operations for rectification due to counterfeiting brand-name products.

examples.chinese: 这位著名导演在接受媒体访谈时坦诚地谈论了他对电影艺术的理解和追求。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zhùmíng dǎoyǎn zài jiēshòu méitǐ fǎngtán shí tǎnchéng de tánlùn le tā duì diànyǐng yìshù de lǐjiě hé zhuīqiú.
examples.english: During a media interview, this renowned director candidly discussed his understanding of and pursuit in the art of cinema.

examples.chinese: 随着工业4.0的推进，传统纺织企业面临着数字化转型的巨大挑战。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe gōngyè 4.0 de tuījìn, chuántǒng fǎngzhī qǐyè miànlín zhe shùzìhuà zhuǎnxíng de jùdà tiǎozhàn.
examples.english: With the advancement of Industry 4.0, traditional textile enterprises are facing enormous challenges in digital transformation.

examples.chinese: 他犯了这么严重的错误，我们不能就这样放过他，必须追究他的责任。
examples.pinyin: Tā fànle zhème yánzhòng de cuòwù, wǒmen búnéng jiùzhèyàng fàngguò tā, bìxū zhuījiū tā de zérèn.
examples.english: He made such a serious mistake that we cannot just let him off like this; we must hold him accountable for his responsibility.

examples.chinese: 农民们在灌溉季节需要精确计算何时放水，以确保庄稼能获得充足的水分。
examples.pinyin: Nóngmín men zài guàngài jìjié xūyào jīngquè jìsuàn héshí fàng shuǐ, yǐ quèbǎo zhuāngjia néng huòdé ch充足de shuǐfen.
examples.english: Farmers need to calculate precisely when to turn on the water during irrigation season to ensure their crops receive sufficient moisture.

examples.chinese: 那些富二代在酒吧里放肆地挥霍，完全不顾家族的名誉和责任。
examples.pinyin: Nàxiē fùèrdài zài jiǔbā lǐ fàngsì de huīhuò, wánquán búgù jiāzú de míngyù hé zérèn.
examples.english: Those second-generation rich kids wantonly squandered money at the bar, completely disregarding their family's reputation and responsibility.

examples.chinese: 这部纪录片将在国际电影节上放映，预计会引起广泛的社会讨论。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn jiāng zài guójì diànyǐng jié shang fàngyìng, yùjì huì yǐnqǐ guǎngfàn de shèhuì tǎolùn.
examples.english: This documentary will be shown at the international film festival, and is expected to spark widespread social discussion.

examples.chinese: 这些有毒物质不能随意放置在居民区附近，否则会对环境造成严重污染。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē yǒudú wùzhì búnéng suíyì fàngzhì zài jūmín qū fùjìn, fǒuzé huì duì huánjìng zàochéng yánzhòng wūrǎn.
examples.english: These toxic substances cannot be arbitrarily disposed of near residential areas, otherwise they will cause serious environmental pollution.

examples.chinese: 长期放纵自己的欲望最终会导致身心俱疲，这是很多人都要学会的人生教训。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī fàngzòng zìjǐ de yùwàng zuìzh終huì dǎozhì shēnxīn jù píng, zhè shì hěnduō rén dōu yào xuéhuì de rénshēng jiàoxùn.
examples.english: Indulging one's desires for a long time will ultimately lead to physical and mental exhaustion, which is a life lesson many people need to learn.

examples.chinese: 随着互联网技术的发展，电子商务行业飞速增长，改变了人们的消费方式。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe hùliánwǎng jìshù de fāzhǎn, diànzǐ shāngwù hángyè fēisù zēngzhǎng, gǎibiàn le rénmen de xiāofèi fāngshì.
examples.english: With the development of internet technology, the e-commerce industry has grown at flying speed, changing people's consumption habits.

examples.chinese: 这位商人每月都要飞往东南亚各国处理业务，已经成为他生活的常态。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi shāngrén měi yuè dōu yào fēi wǎng dōngnányà gè guó chǔlǐ yèwù, yǐjīng chéngwéi tā shēnghuó de chángtài.
examples.english: This businessman has to fly to various Southeast Asian countries every month to handle business, which has become a normal part of his life.

examples.chinese: 那只鹰在山谷上空自由地飞翔，仿佛在诠释着生命的意义。
examples.pinyin: Nà zhī yīng zài shānggǔ shàngkōng zìyóu de fēixiáng, fǎngfú zài quánshì zhe shēngmìng de yìyì.
examples.english: The eagle circles freely above the valley, as if interpreting the meaning of life.

examples.chinese: 经过多年的研究和投入，这家公司的技术终于实现了飞跃，成为了行业的领头羊。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò duō nián de yánjiū hé tóuruò, zhè jiā gōngsī de jìshù zh終yú shíxiàn le fēiyuè, chéngwéi le hángyè de lǐngtóu yáng.
examples.english: After years of research and investment, this company's technology finally achieved a leap forward, becoming the industry leader.

examples.chinese: 这个问题非同小可，我们必须认真对待。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí fēi tóng xiǎokě, wǒmen bìxū rènzhēn duìdài.
examples.english: This problem is not trivial; we must treat it seriously.

examples.chinese: 如果想在这个竞争激烈的行业里生存，你非得不断提升自己的专业能力才行。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng zài zhège jìngjìng jīliè de hángyè lǐ shēngcún, nǐ fēiděi búduàn tíshēng zìjǐ de zhuānyè néngли cái xíng.
examples.english: If you want to survive in this highly competitive industry, you absolutely must continuously improve your professional abilities.

examples.chinese: 这家公司因为非法获取用户数据而被政府部门严厉处罚。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī yīnwèi fēifǎ huòqǔ yònghù shùjù érbeǐ zhèngfǔ bùmén yánlì chǔfá.
examples.english: The company was severely penalized by government agencies for illegally obtaining user data.

examples.chinese: 农民们意识到使用有机肥料不仅能提高土壤质量，还能减少对环境的污染。
examples.pinyin: Nóngmín men yìshí dào shǐyòng yǒujī féiliào bújǐn néng tígāo tǔrǎng zhìliàng, háishi néng jiǎnshǎo duì huánjìng de wūr染.
examples.english: Farmers have realized that using organic fertilizer can not only improve soil quality but also reduce environmental pollution.

examples.chinese: 这位科学家在量子物理领域的贡献确实非凡，为整个学科的发展奠定了坚实的基础。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi kēxuéjiā zài liàngzǐ wùlǐ lǐngyù de gòngxiàn quèshí fēifán, wèi zhěnggè xuékē de fāzhǎn diàndìng le jiānshí de jīchǔ.
examples.english: This scientist's contributions in the field of quantum physics are truly extraordinary, laying a solid foundation for the development of the entire discipline.

examples.chinese: 长期的久坐生活方式和不良饮食习惯导致了现代社会中肥胖问题的日益严重。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī de jiǔzuò shēnghuó fāngshì hé búliáng yǐnshí xíguàn dǎozhìle xiàndài shèhuì zhōng féipàng wèntí de rìyì yánzhòng.
examples.english: Long-term sedentary lifestyle and poor dietary habits have led to the increasingly serious problem of obesity in modern society.

examples.chinese: 那位明星最近卷入了一桩绯闻风波，导致他的代言合同被紧急终止。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi míngxīng zuìjìn juǎnrù le yī zhuāng fēiwén fēngbō, dǎozhì tā de dàiyán héttóng bèi jǐnjí zhōngzhǐ.
examples.english: That celebrity was recently caught up in a sex scandal, which caused his endorsement contracts to be urgently terminated.

examples.chinese: 这片肥沃的土地经过几代农民的精心耕耘，如今成为了整个地区最重要的粮食产地。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piàn féiwò de tǔdì jīngguò jǐ dài nóngmín de jīngxīn gēngyún, rújīn chéngwéile zhěnggè dìqū zuì zhòngyào de liángshi chǎndì.
examples.english: This fertile land, cultivated carefully by generations of farmers, has now become the most important grain production area in the entire region.

examples.chinese: 这种天然肥皂虽然价格昂贵，但由于成分温和，对敏感肌肤的刺激最小。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng tiānrán féizào suīrán jiàgé ānggui, dàn yóuyú chéngfèn wēnhé, duì mǐngǎn jīfu de cìjī zuì xiǎo.
examples.english: Although this natural soap is expensive, it causes minimal irritation to sensitive skin due to its mild ingredients.

examples.chinese: 那些媒体肆无忌惮地诽谤政治对手，导致社会舆论越来越分裂。
examples.pinyin: Nàxiē méitǐ sìwújìdàn de fěibàng zhèngzhì duìshǒu, dǎozhì shèhuì yúlùn yuèláiyuè fēnliè.
examples.english: Those media outlets recklessly slandered their political opponents, causing public opinion to become increasingly divided.

examples.chinese: 这家工厂因为污染问题被迫关闭，大量的废料堆积在仓库里。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng yīnwèi wūrǎn wèntí bèi pò guānbì, dàliàng de fèiliào duījī zài cāngkù lǐ.
examples.english: The factory was forced to shut down due to pollution issues, with large amounts of waste materials piling up in the warehouse.

examples.chinese: 许多国家已经废除了过时的法律，以适应现代社会的发展需求。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō guójiā yǐjīng fèichúle guòshí de fǎlǜ, yǐ shìyìng xiàndài shèhuì de fāzhǎn xūqiú.
examples.english: Many countries have already abolished outdated laws to adapt to the development needs of modern society.

examples.chinese: 与其浪费时间听他讲那些废话，还不如去做点有意义的事情。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ qī làngfèi shíjiān tīng tā jiǎng nàxiē fèihuà, háibúrú qù zuò diǎn yǒu yìyì de shìqing.
examples.english: Rather than wasting time listening to his nonsense, it would be better to do something meaningful.

examples.chinese: 这批产品因为质量问题被列为废品，造成了公司巨大的经济损失。
examples.pinyin: Zhè pī chǎnpǐn yīnwèi zhìliàng wèntí bèi lièwéi fèipǐn, zàochéngle gōngsī jùdà de jīngjì sǔnshī.
examples.english: This batch of products was classified as production rejects due to quality issues, causing the company enormous financial losses.

english: to neglect sleep and forget about food (idiom)

examples.chinese: 这个项目从一开始就注定失败，投入的资金简直是废物。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù cóng yīkāishǐ jiù zhùdìng shībài, tóuruò de zījīn jiǎnzhí shì fèiwù.
examples.english: This project was doomed to fail from the start, and the invested capital was simply wasted.

examples.chinese: 这件丑闻在网络上沸沸扬扬地传播了好几个月，最后才逐渐平息。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn chǒuwen zài wǎngluò shang fèifèi-yángyáng de chuánbō le hǎo jǐ ge yuè, zuìhòu cái zhújiàn píngxī.
examples.english: This scandal spread in a bubbling, turbulent manner on the internet for several months before gradually dying down.

examples.chinese: 看着锅里的水沸腾起来，她知道该把面条放进去了。
examples.pinyin: Kànzhe guōlǐ de shuǐ fèiténg qǐlái, tā zhīdào gāi bǎ miàntiáo fàngjìnqu le.
examples.english: Watching the water in the pot start to boil, she knew it was time to put the noodles in.

examples.chinese: 在这个信息爆炸的时代，我们需要学会分辨真假新闻，避免被虚假信息所误导。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège xìnxī bàozhà de shídài, wǒmen xūyào xuéhuì fēnbiàn zhēnjiǎ xīnwén, bìmiǎn bèi xūjiǎ xìnxī suǒ wùdǎo.
examples.english: In this age of information explosion, we need to learn to distinguish between true and false news to avoid being misled by false information.

examples.chinese: 这个项目看似简单，但实际执行起来费劲得很，我们花了半年才勉强完成。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù kànsì jiǎndān, dàn shí际zhíxíng qǐlai fèi jìn de hěn, wǒmen huāle bàn nián cái miǎnqiǎng wánchéng.
examples.english: This project seemed simple on the surface, but it turned out to be quite demanding to execute; it took us half a year to barely complete it.

examples.chinese: 作为一个外交官，他在公开场合总是很注意分寸，从不说出不当的言论。
examples.pinyin: Zuòwéi yīgè wàijiāo guān, tā zài gōngkāi chǎnghé zǒngshì hěn zhùyì fēncun, cóngbù shuōchū búdàng de yánlùn.
examples.english: As a diplomat, he always paid attention to propriety in public settings and never made inappropriate remarks.

examples.chinese: 在这个项目中，我们需要分担责任，这样才能确保最终的成功。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège xiàngmù zhōng, wǒmen xūyào fēndān zérèn, zhèyàng cái néng quèbǎo zuìzh终de chénggōng.
examples.english: In this project, we need to share the responsibility so that we can ensure ultimate success.

examples.chinese: 这份合同的条款被不公平地分割，导致了双方之间的纠纷。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn héitóng de tiáokuǎn bèi búgōngpíng de fēngē, dǎozhìle shuāngfāng zhījiān de jiūn纷。
examples.english: The terms of this contract were divided unfairly, which led to disputes between the two parties.

examples.chinese: 这家公司今年的业绩不错，董事会决定向股东分红，预计每股可以获得5块钱的收益。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī jīnnián de yèjī búcuò, dǒngshìhuì juédìng xiàng gǔdōng fēnhóng, yùjì měi gǔ kěyǐ huòdé wǔ kuài qián de shōuyì.
examples.english: This company had good performance this year, so the board of directors decided to distribute dividends to shareholders, with each share expected to yield five yuan in returns.

examples.chinese: 压力过大会导致身体分泌过多的皮质醇，长期如此会影响免疫系统的功能。
examples.pinyin: Yālì guòdà huì dǎozhì shēntǐ fēnmì guòduō de pízhì醇, chángqī rúcǐ huì yǐngxiǎng miǎnyì xìtǒng de gōngnéng.
examples.english: Excessive stress causes the body to secrete too much cortisol, and prolonged exposure to this will impair the immune system's function.

examples.chinese: 他的态度分明是在故意为难我们，这让整个谈判变得异常僵持。
examples.pinyin: Tā de tàidù fēnmíng shì zài gùyì wéinán wǒmen, zhè ràng zhěnggè tánpàn biàn de yìcháng jiāngchí.
examples.english: His attitude is clearly intentionally making things difficult for us, which has made the entire negotiation extremely deadlocked.

examples.chinese: 两个团队在项目的发展方向上存在严重分歧，最终导致了合作的失败。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng ge tuánduì zài xiàngmù de fāzhǎn fāngxiàng shang cúnzài yánzhòng fēnqí, zuìzh终 dǎozhì le hézuò de shībài.
examples.english: The two teams had serious divergence of opinion on the project's development direction, which ultimately led to the failure of their collaboration.

examples.chinese: 那些贪污官员勾结黑社会分赃，最终都被检察机关依法逮捕了。
examples.pinyin: Nàxiē tānwū guānyuán gōujiē heishehuì fēnzāng, zuìzh終dōu bèi jiǎnchájī guān yīfǎ dàibǔ le.
examples.english: Those corrupt officials colluded with the triad to share the booty, and in the end were all arrested by the prosecutorial authorities according to law.

examples.chinese: 这家跨国公司在亚洲地区设立了多个分支机构，以便更好地服务当地市场。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā kuàguó gōngsī zài Yàzhōu dìqū shèlì le duō gè fēnzhī jīgòu, yǐbiàn gèng hǎo de fúwù dāngdì shìchǎng.
examples.english: This multinational company has established multiple branch offices in the Asian region in order to better serve the local market.

examples.chinese: 这款香水的芬芳气息在空气中久久萦绕，令人陶醉其中。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn xiānghuǐ de fēnfāng qìxī zài kōngqì zhōng jiǔjiǔ yínghuò, lìngrén táozuì qīzhōng.
examples.english: The fragrant aroma of this perfume lingers in the air for a long time, intoxicating people in it.

examples.chinese: 这场音乐会的氛围相当浓厚，观众们都被演奏家深情的表演所感染。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng yīnyuèhuì de fēnwéi xiāngdāng nóng厚, guānzhòngmen dōu bèi yǎnzòujiā shēnqíng de biǎoyǎn suǒ gǎnrǎn.
examples.english: The ambience of this concert was quite thick, and the audience was all moved by the performers' heartfelt performance.

examples.chinese: 经理吩咐我们在会议前准备好所有的文件资料。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ fēnfu wǒmen zài huìyì qián zhǔnbèi hǎo suǒyǒu de wénjiàn zīliào.
examples.english: The manager told us to prepare all the documents before the meeting.

examples.chinese: 这座古老的坟墓见证了几个世纪的沧桑变化，吸引了无数考古学家前来研究。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔlǎo de fénmù jiànzhèng le jǐ ge shìjì de cāngsāng biànhuà, xīyǐn le wúshù kǎogǔ xuéjiā qiánlái yánjiū.
examples.english: This ancient grave has witnessed the vicissitudes of several centuries and attracted numerous archaeologists to come and study it.

examples.chinese: 环保部门严格禁止焚烧秸秆，以防止空气污染进一步恶化。
examples.pinyin: Huánbǎo bùmén yánggé jìnzhǐ fénshāo jiējiǎn, yǐ fángzhǐ kōngqì wūrǎn jìnyībù èhuà.
examples.english: Environmental protection departments strictly prohibit burning straw to prevent further deterioration of air pollution.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅的米粉汤用传统工艺制作，每天都吸引了大批食客前来品尝。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de mǐfěn tāng yòng chuántǒng gōngyì zhìzuò, měi tiān dōu xīyǐnle dà pī shíkè qiánlái pǐncháng.
examples.english: This restaurant's rice noodle soup is made using traditional craftsmanship, attracting numerous diners to come taste it every day.

examples.chinese: 这次失败粉碎了他多年来的梦想，让他陷入了深深的绝望。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shībài fěnsuì le tā duō nián lái de梦想，ràng tā xiànrù le shēnshēn de juéwàng.
examples.english: This failure shattered the dream he had cherished for years, plunging him into deep despair.

examples.chinese: 在这个复杂的向量空间中，我们需要计算每个分量对最终结果的贡献度。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège fùzá de xiàngliàng kōngjiān zhōng, wǒmen xūyào jìsuàn měi ge fènliàng duì zuìzhōng jiéguǒ de gōngxiàn dù.
examples.english: In this complex vector space, we need to calculate the contribution of each component to the final result.

examples.chinese: 在这个竞争激烈的时代，拥有一份稳定的工作显得分外珍贵。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège jìngjìng jīliè de shídài, yōngyǒu yīfèn wěndìng de gōngzuò xiǎnde fènwài zhēnguì.
examples.english: In this fiercely competitive era, having a stable job appears exceptionally precious.

examples.chinese: 运动员们奋力冲向终点，尽管身体已经疲惫不堪。
examples.pinyin: Yùndòngyuánymen fènlì chōngxiàng zhōngdiǎn, jìnguǎn shēntǐ yǐjīng píbeì búkān.
examples.english: The athletes did everything they could to rush toward the finish line, despite their bodies being exhausted.

examples.chinese: 在敌人的炮火中，战士们奋勇向前，最终突破了防线。
examples.pinyin: Zài díren de pàohuǒ zhōng, zhànshì men fènyǒng xiàngqián, zuìzhōng突pò le fángxiàn.
examples.english: Under enemy artillery fire, the soldiers advanced dauntlessly and eventually broke through the defensive line.

examples.chinese: 农民们用牲畜的粪便作为肥料来改善土壤质量。
examples.pinyin: Nóngmín men yòng shēngchù de fènbiàn zuòwéi féiliào lái gǎishàn tǔrǎng zhìliàng.
examples.english: Farmers use livestock manure as fertilizer to improve soil quality.

examples.chinese: 这种寄生虫主要通过受污染的粪便传播，因此卫生防护至关重要。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng jìshēngchóng zhǔyào tōngguò shòu wūrǎn de fènbiàn chuánbō, yīncǐ wèishēng fánghuà zhìguānzhòngyào.
examples.english: This type of parasite is mainly transmitted through contaminated excrement, so hygiene protection is of utmost importance.

examples.chinese: 这家公司为新员工提供了丰厚的福利待遇，包括住房补贴和股票期权。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī wèi xīn yuángōng tígōngle fēnghòu de fúlì dàiyù, bāokuò zhùfáng bǔtiē hé gǔpiào qīquán.
examples.english: This company offers generous benefits and compensation to new employees, including housing subsidies and stock options.

english: Fengman district of Jilin city 吉林市

examples.chinese: 丰满区作为吉林市的重要工业基地，近年来在经济转型升级中取得了显著成就。
examples.pinyin: Fēngmǎn Qū zuòwéi Jílín Shì de zhòngyào gōngyè jīdì, jìnnián lái zài jīngjì zhuǎnxíng shēngjí zhōng qǔdéle xiǎnzhù chéngjì.
examples.english: As an important industrial base of Jilin City, Fengman District has achieved remarkable accomplishments in economic transformation and upgrading in recent years.

examples.chinese: 经过多年的科研投入，这个项目终于取得了丰硕的成果，为国家的发展做出了重要贡献。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò duō nián de kēyán tóuruò, zhège xiàngmù终yú qǔdé le fēngshuò de chéngguǒ, wèi guójiā de fāzhǎn zuòchū le zhòngyào gòngxiàn.
examples.english: After years of research investment, this project finally achieved plentiful results and made important contributions to the country's development.

examples.chinese: 这家公司因为财务丑闻引发了一场巨大的风波，导致股价暴跌，许多投资者纷纷撤资。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī yīnwèi cáiwù chǒuwen yǐnfāle yì chǎng jùdà de fēngbō, dǎozhì gǔjià bàodiē, xǔduō tóuzīzhě纷纷 chèzī.
examples.english: The company triggered a major crisis due to a financial scandal, causing the stock price to plummet and many investors to withdraw their investments.

examples.chinese: 那些考古学家在挖掘遗址期间风餐露宿了几个月，只为了找到那件失传的文物。
examples.pinyin: Nàxiē kǎogǔ xuéjiā zài wājué yízhǐ qījiān fēngcān-lùsù le jǐ ge yuè, zhǐwèile zhǎodào nà jiàn shīchuán de wénwù.
examples.english: Those archaeologists endured sleeping in the open air and eating rough meals for several months during the excavation of the site, all to find that lost artifact.

examples.chinese: 那个周末风和日丽，我们一家人决定去郊外散步，享受难得的好天气。
examples.pinyin: Nàge zhōumò fēnghé-rìlì, wǒmen yījiārén juédìng qù jiāowài sǎnbù, xiǎngshòu nándé de hǎo tiānqì.
examples.english: That weekend, with moderate wind and beautiful sunshine, our family decided to go for a walk in the countryside and enjoy the rare good weather.

examples.chinese: 经历了这么多年风风雨雨的磨练，他终于成为了一位杰出的企业家。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglìle zhème duō nián fēngfēng-yǔyǔ de móliàn, tā终于 chéngle yī wèi jiéchū de qǐyèjiā.
examples.english: After years of trials and tribulations, he finally became an outstanding entrepreneur.

examples.chinese: 经历了这么多商业风浪，他终于明白了什么是真正的成功。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglìle zhème duō shāngyè fēnglàng, tā终于 míngbaile le什么 shì zhēnzhèng de chénggōng.
examples.english: After weathering so many storms in business, he finally understood what true success really meant.

examples.chinese: 随着气候变化，沿海地区的风力资源越来越被重视，许多国家都在加大风力发电的投资。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe qìhòu biànhuà, yánhǎi dìqū de fēnglì zīyuán yuèláiyuè bèi zhòngshì, xǔduō guójiā dōu zài jiādà fēnglì fādiàn de tóuzī.
examples.english: As climate change progresses, wind energy resources in coastal regions are receiving increasing attention, and many countries are stepping up their investments in wind power generation.

examples.chinese: 作为一位资深的外交官，他在国际谈判中展现出了杰出的职业风范，赢得了各方的尊重。
examples.pinyin: Zuòwéi yī wèi zīshēn de wàijiāo guān, tā zài guójì tánpàn zhōng zhǎnxiàn chūle jiéchū de zhíyè fēngfàn, yíngdéle gèfāng de zūnzhòng.
examples.english: As a seasoned diplomat, he demonstrated outstanding professional demeanor in international negotiations, earning the respect of all parties.

examples.chinese: 这位风流的学者在学术界享有盛誉，他的研究成果对现代科学产生了深远的影响。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi fēngliú de xuézhě zài xuéshùjiè xiǎngyǒu shèngyù, tā de yánjiū chéngguǒ duì xiàndài kēxué chǎnshēngle shēnyuǎn de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: This distinguished and accomplished scholar enjoys great prestige in the academic community, and his research achievements have had a profound impact on modern science.

examples.chinese: 这座城市近年来的建筑风貌发生了翻天覆地的变化，既保留了传统特色，又融入了现代元素。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì jìnnián lái de jiànzhù fēngmào fāshēng le fāntiānfùdì de biànhuà, jì bǎoliú le chuántǒng tèsè, yòu róngrù le xiàndài yuánsù.
examples.english: In recent years, the architectural landscape of this city has undergone tremendous changes, both preserving traditional characteristics and incorporating modern elements.

examples.chinese: 这家公司虽然规模不大，但却形成了一种鼓励创新的良好风气，吸引了许多优秀的人才加入。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī suīrán guīmó búdà, dàn què xíngchéngle yī zhǒng gǔ励 chuàngxīn de liánghǎo fēngqì, xīyǐnle xǔduō yōuxiù de réncái jiāruì.
examples.english: Although this company is not large in scale, it has nevertheless fostered a positive atmosphere that encourages innovation, attracting many excellent talents to join.

examples.chinese: 这座古城保留了许多明清时期的建筑，漫步其中能感受到浓厚的历史风情。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔchéng bǎoliúle xǔduō míngqīng shíqī de jiànzhú, mànbù qīzhōng néng gǎnshòudào nónghouò de lìshǐ fēngqíng.
examples.english: This ancient city has preserved many buildings from the Ming and Qing dynasties, and walking through it allows one to experience the rich historical demeanour.

examples.chinese: 在社交媒体的影响下，简约风尚逐渐成为了年轻人的主流审美。
examples.pinyin: Zài shèjiāo méitǐ de yǐngxiǎng xià, jiǎnyuē fēngshàng zhújiàn chéngwéi le niánqīngrén de zhǔliú shěnměi.
examples.english: Under the influence of social media, the minimalist aesthetic has gradually become the mainstream taste among young people.

examples.chinese: 他虽然年纪不小，但说话风趣幽默，总能让周围的人笑得前仰后合。
examples.pinyin: Tā suīrán niánjì búxiǎo, dàn shuōhuà fēngqù yōumò, zǒngnéng ràng zhōuwéi de rén xiào de qiányǎnghòuhé.
examples.english: Although he is getting on in years, he speaks with charm and humor, always making the people around him burst into laughter.

examples.chinese: 沙漠地区的风沙问题日益严重，已经成为影响当地生态环境和居民生活质量的主要因素。
examples.pinyin: Shāmò dìqū de fēngshā wèntí rìyì yánzhòng, yǐjīng chéngwéi yǐngxiǎng dāngdì shēngtài huanjìng hé jūmín shēnghuó zhìliàng de zhǔyào yīnsù.
examples.english: The problem of wind-blown sand in desert areas has become increasingly serious and is now a major factor affecting the local ecological environment and residents' quality of life.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅汇集了来自全国各地不同风味的菜肴，每一道都精心烹饪，令人印象深刻。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng huìjíle láizì quánguó gèdì búyuàng fēngwèi de càiyao, měi yī dào dōu jīngxīn pēnghuǒ, lìngrén yìnxiàng shēnkè.
examples.english: This restaurant brings together dishes of different flavors from all over the country, each one carefully prepared and leaves a deep impression.

examples.chinese: 经历了多年的风雨洗礼，他终于明白了人生的真谛。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglìle duō nián de fēngyǔ xǐlǐ, tā zh终于 míngbai le rénshēng de zhēnzhì.
examples.english: After years of trials and tribulations, he finally understood the true meaning of life.

examples.chinese: 这位政治家在风云变幻的时代中始终坚守自己的原则。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zhèngzhìjiā zài fēngyún biànhuàn de shídài zhōng shǐzhōng jiānshǒu zìjǐ de yuánzé.
examples.english: This politician always adhered to his principles amid the turbulent changes of the era.

examples.chinese: 他童年最美好的回忆就是在田野里放风筝，那些五颜六色的风筝在蓝天中翩翩起舞。
examples.pinyin: Tā tóngnián zuì měihǎo de huíyì jiùshì zài tiányě lǐ fàng fēngzheng, nàxiē wǔ yánsè liù de fēngzheng zài lántiān zhōng piānpiān qǐwǔ.
examples.english: His most beautiful childhood memory was flying kites in the fields, with those colorful kites dancing gracefully in the blue sky.

english: to put a roof (on a building)

examples.chinese: 这个商业综合体的主体工程已经完成，预计下个月就能封顶，明年年中可以开业。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shāngyè zōnghétǐ de zhǔtǐ gōngchéng yǐjīng wánchéng, yùjì xiàge yuè jiù néng fēng dǐng, míngnián niánzhōng kěyǐ kāiyè.
examples.english: The main structure of this commercial complex has been completed, and it is expected to have its roof topped off next month, with a grand opening possible by mid-next year.

examples.chinese: 这本书的封面设计得非常精美，充分体现了作者对细节的执着追求。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū de fēngmiàn shèjì de fēicháng jīngměi, chōngfèn tǐxiàn le zuòzhě duì细节 de zhízhù zhuīqiú.
examples.english: The cover design of this book is exquisitely done, fully reflecting the author's persistent pursuit of detail.

examples.chinese: 中国古代的封建制度在秦朝以后逐渐被中央集权制度所取代。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó gǔdài de fēngjiàn zhìdù zài Qínzhāo yǐhòu逐渐 bèi zhōngyāng jíquán zhìdù suǒ qǔdài.
examples.english: China's ancient feudal system was gradually replaced by a centralized autocratic system after the Qin Dynasty.

examples.chinese: 经济制裁和贸易封锁迫使该国政府重新评估其外交政策。
examples.pinyin: Jīngjì zhìc裁 hé màoyì fēngsuǒ pòshǐ gāi guó zhèngfǔ chóngxīn píngguā qí wàijiāo zhèngcè.
examples.english: Economic sanctions and trade blockades forced the country's government to reassess its foreign policy.

english: the mountain road twists around each new peak (idiom)

examples.chinese: 在这部悬疑小说中，情节峰回路转，读者始终无法猜测真凶是谁。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè bù xuányí xiǎoshuō zhōng, qíngjié fēnghuí-lùzhuǎn, dúzhě shǐzh终 wúfǎ cāicè zhēn凶 shì shéi.
examples.english: In this mystery novel, the plot twists and turns at every turn, and readers can never guess who the real culprit is.

examples.chinese: 他那些激进的想法曾经让很多人把他当成疯子，但最后他的理论改变了整个行业。
examples.pinyin: Tā nàxiē jījìn de xiǎngfǎ céngjīng ràng hěnduō rén bǎ tā dāngchéng fēngzi, dàn zuìhòu tā de lǐlùn gǎibiàn le zhěngge hángyè.
examples.english: His radical ideas once made many people regard him as a madman, but ultimately his theories transformed the entire industry.

examples.chinese: 这种野生蜂蜜因为产量稀少，价格往往比普通蜂蜜高出好几倍。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yěshēng fēngmì yīnwèi chǎnyliàng xīshǎo, jiàgé wǎngwǎng bǐ pǔtōng fēngmì gāo chū hǎo jǐ bèi.
examples.english: This kind of wild honey is often several times more expensive than ordinary honey because of its scarce production.

examples.chinese: 每逢春节，他都会回到故乡与家人团聚，这个传统已经延续了几十年。
examples.pinyin: Měi féng chūnjié, tā dōu huì huídào gùxiāng yǔ jiārén tuánjù, zhège chuántǒng yǐjīng yánxù le jǐ shí nián.
examples.english: Whenever Chinese New Year comes around, he always returns to his hometown to reunite with his family, a tradition that has continued for decades.

examples.chinese: 这件旧衣服的袖口已经破了，我得找时间把它缝上，否则会越来越大。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn jiù yīfu de xiùukǒu yǐjīng pò le, wǒ děi zhǎo shíjiān bǎ tā féng shang, fǒuze huì yuèláiyuè dà.
examples.english: The sleeve of this old garment has torn, so I need to find time to sew it up, otherwise the tear will keep getting bigger.

examples.chinese: 医生用精细的手术线缝合了患者的伤口，确保愈合后不会留下明显疤痕。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng yòng jīngxì de shǒushù xiàn fénghé le huànzhě de shāngkǒu, quèbǎo yùhé hòu búhuì liúxià míngxiǎn báhenba.
examples.english: The doctor used fine surgical thread to sew together the patient's wound, ensuring that no obvious scar would remain after healing.

examples.chinese: 这部纪录片通过黑色幽默讽刺了当代社会中人们对物质的盲目追求。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn tōngguò hēisè yōumò讽刺le当代shèhuìzhōng人们duì物质de盲目zhuīqiú.
examples.english: This documentary satirizes people's blind pursuit of material wealth in contemporary society through dark humor.

english: Fenghuang county in Xiangxi Tujia and Miao autonomous prefecture 湘西土家族苗族自治州[Xiang1 xi1 Tu3 jia1 zu2 Miao2 zu2 zi4 zhi4 zhou1]

examples.chinese: 凤凰县的苗族文化保留了许多古老的传统工艺，吸引了越来越多的游客前来探访。
examples.pinyin: Fènghuáng xiàn de Miáozú wénhuà bǎoliúle xǔduō gǔlǎo de chuántǒng gōngyìpǐn, xīyǐnle yuèláiyuè duō de yóukè qiánlái tànfǎng.
examples.english: The Miao ethnic culture in Fenghuang County has preserved many ancient traditional crafts, attracting increasingly more tourists to visit and explore.

examples.chinese: 这家初创公司在孵化器的扶持下，成功孵化了多个具有市场竞争力的产品。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā chūchuàng gōngsī zài fūhuàhuà qì de fúchí xià, chénggōng fūhuà le duō ge jùyǒu shìchǎng jìngjìng lìng de chǎnpǐn.
examples.english: Under the support of the incubator, this startup successfully incubated several products with strong market competitiveness.

examples.chinese: 这项提案虽然得到了大多数委员的支持，但最终还是被董事会否决了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng t提àn suīrán dé到le dàduōshù wěiyuán de zhīchí, dàn zuìzhōng háishi bèi dǒngshìhuì fǒujuéle.
examples.english: Although this proposal received support from most committee members, it was ultimately vetoed by the board of directors.

examples.chinese: 政府应该扶持那些有潜力的初创企业，而不是让它们在竞争中自生自灭。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ yīnggāi fúchí nàxiē yǒu qiánlì de chūchuàng qǐyè, érbúshì ràng tāmen zài jìngjìng zhōng zìshēng zìmiè.
examples.english: The government should support promising startups rather than let them sink or swim in competition.

examples.chinese: 医生在伤口上敷了一层厚厚的药膏，以防止感染。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng zài shāngkǒu shàng fū le yī céng hòuhòu de yàogāo, yǐ fángzhǐ gǎnrǎn.
examples.english: The doctor applied a thick layer of ointment to the wound to prevent infection.

examples.chinese: 公司的数据中心需要升级服务器，以应对日益增长的业务需求。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de shùjù zhōngxīn xūyào shēngjí fúwùqì, yǐ yìngduì rìyì zēngzhǎng de yèwù xūqiú.
examples.english: The company's data center needs to upgrade its servers to handle the growing business demands.

examples.chinese: 患者需要按照医生的嘱咐定期服用这种抗生素，以便有效控制感染。
examples.pinyin: Huànzhě xūyào ànzhào yīshēng de zhǔfù dìngqī fúyòng zhè zhǒng kàngjìshùsù, yǐbiàn yǒuxiào kòngzhì gǎnrǎn.
examples.english: The patient needs to take this antibiotic regularly according to the doctor's instructions in order to effectively control the infection.

examples.chinese: 这次军事行动中，我们的特种部队成功俘获了敌方的几名高级军官和大量机密文件。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì jūnshì xíngdòng zhōng, wǒmen de tèzhǒng bùduì chénggōng fúhuòle敌方de jǐ míng gāojí jūnguān hé dàliàng jīmì wénjiàn.
examples.english: During this military operation, our special forces successfully captured several high-ranking enemy officers and a large amount of classified documents.

examples.chinese: 在那场激烈的战役中，敌军的将领最终沦为我们的俘虏，这标志着战争的转折点。
examples.pinyin: Zài nà chǎng jīliè de zhànyì zhōng, díjūn de jiànglǐng zuìzhōng lúnwéi wǒmen de fúlǔ, zhè biāozhì zhe zhànzh争 de zhuǎnzhédiǎn.
examples.english: In that fierce battle, the enemy commander ultimately became our captive, which marked the turning point of the war.

examples.chinese: 船舶的设计必须充分考虑水的浮力，以确保其在各种海况下都能安全航行。
examples.pinyin: Chuánbó de shèjì bìxū chōngfèn kǎolǜ shuǐ de fúlì, yǐ quèbǎo qī zài gèzhǒng hǎikuàng xià dōu néng ānquán hánghíng.
examples.english: Ship design must fully consider water's buoyancy to ensure safe navigation in various sea conditions.

examples.chinese: 当他看到那张老照片时，童年的回忆在脑海中浮现出来，让他不禁流下眼泪。
examples.pinyin: Dāng tā kàndào nà zhāng lǎo zhàopiàn shí, tóngnián de huíyì zài nǎohǎi zhōng fúxiàn chūlái, ràng tā bújìn liúxià yǎnlèi.
examples.english: When he saw that old photograph, memories of his childhood appeared before his eyes, causing him to shed tears involuntarily.

examples.chinese: 现在很多年轻人因为浮躁的心态，往往无法专注于一项事业，导致虎头蛇尾。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài hěnduō niánqīngrén yīnwèi fúzào de xīntài, wǎngwǎng wúfǎ zhuānzhù yú yī xiàng shìyè, dǎozhì hǔtóu shéwěi.
examples.english: Nowadays, many young people, due to their fickle and impatient mindset, often cannot focus on a single career, resulting in starting strong but ending weakly.

examples.chinese: 这座城市的经济辐射力不断增强，周边地区也随之得到了发展。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì de jīngjì fúshè lì búduàn zēngqiáng, zhōubiān dìqū yě suízhī dé到le fāzhǎn.
examples.english: The economic radiating power of this city continues to strengthen, and the surrounding regions have consequently developed as well.

examples.chinese: 他虽然出身贫寒，但凭借自己的努力和一份福气，最终还是成为了行业的翘楚。
examples.pinyin: Tā suīrán chūshēn pínghan, dàn píngjiè zìjǐ de nǔlì hé yī fèn fúqi, zuìzh終háishi chéngwéile hángyè de qiàochu.
examples.english: Although he came from humble beginnings, through his own hard work and a stroke of good fortune, he ultimately became a leader in his industry.

examples.chinese: 母亲轻轻地抚摸着孩子的头发，用温暖的手掌消解他内心的恐惧。
examples.pinyin: Mǔqīn qīngqīng de fǔmō zhe háizi de tóufa, yòng wēnnuǎn de shǒuzhǎng xiāojiě tā nèixīn de恐惧。
examples.english: The mother gently caressed the child's hair with her warm palm, dissolving the fear in his heart.

english: (of an organization that has a duty of care) to give financial support to relatives of sb who has died or suffered serious injury

examples.chinese: 公司对在工作中不幸丧生的员工家属进行了妥善的抚恤，确保他们的生活不会陷入困境。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī duì zài gōngzuò zhōng búxìng sàngshēng de yuángōng jiāshǔ进行了 tuǒshàn de fǔxù, quèbǎo tāmen de shēnghuó búhuì xiànrù kùnjìng.
examples.english: The company provided appropriate financial support to the families of employees who unfortunately died in workplace accidents, ensuring that their lives would not fall into hardship.

examples.chinese: 这位老人独自抚养了三个孙子，直到他们都考上了大学。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎorén dúzì fǔyǎngle sān ge sunzi, zhídào tāmen dōu kǎoshàngle dàxué.
examples.english: This elderly person single-handedly raised three grandchildren until they all got into university.

examples.chinese: 离婚后，父亲每月需要支付抚养费来确保孩子的教育和生活开支得到妥善解决。
examples.pinyin: Líhūn hòu, fùqin měi yuè xūyào zhīfù fǔyǎngfèi lái quèbǎo háizi de jiàoyù hé shēnghuó kāichī dédào tuǒshàn jiějué.
examples.english: After the divorce, the father needs to pay child support every month to ensure that the child's education and living expenses are properly covered.

examples.chinese: 那位老工匠用一把古老的斧子，巧妙地将木料劈成了完美的建筑构件。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎo gōngjiàng yòng yī bǎ gǔlǎo de fǔzi, qiǎomiào de jiāng mùliào píchéngle wánměi de jiànzhú gòujiànyuáns.
examples.english: That old craftsman skillfully split the lumber into perfect architectural components using an ancient axe.

examples.chinese: 在强大的压力面前，他最终俯首认输，放弃了继续抵抗的念头。
examples.pinyin: Zài qiángdà de yālì miànqián, tā zuìzh終终 fǔshǒu rènshū, fàngqì le jìxù dǐkàng de niàntou.
examples.english: Faced with overwhelming pressure, he finally bowed his head in surrender and abandoned the idea of continued resistance.

examples.chinese: 这位资深教授主要从事研究生的学位论文辅导工作，他的学生在国际学术期刊上发表了不少论文。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zīshēn jiàoshòu zhǔyào cóngshì yánjiūshēng de xuéwèi lùnwén fǔdǎo gōngzuò, tā de xuésheng zài guójì xuéshù qīkān shang fābiǎole búshǎo lùnwén.
examples.english: This experienced professor is mainly engaged in guiding graduate students' dissertation work, and his students have published numerous papers in international academic journals.

examples.chinese: 这个地区的官员腐败成风，导致了许多公共工程的质量严重下降。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū de guānyuán fǔbài chénfēng, dǎozhìle xǔduō gōngòng gōngchéng de zhìliàng yánzhòng xiàjiàng.
examples.english: Corruption has become rampant among officials in this region, resulting in a serious decline in the quality of many public projects.

examples.chinese: 长期的权力滥用导致了整个官僚系统的腐化，最终引发了严重的社会危机。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī de quánlì lànyòng dǎozhìle zhěnggè guānliào xìtǒng de fǔhuà, zuìzhōng yǐnfāle yánzhòng de shèhuì wēijī.
examples.english: The long-term abuse of power led to the corruption of the entire bureaucratic system, ultimately triggering a serious social crisis.

examples.chinese: 如果不及时处理这些厨余垃圾，它们很快就会腐烂，散发出难闻的气味。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ bújíshí chǔlǐ zhèixiē chúyú lèsè, tāmen hěnkuài jiù huì fǔlàn, sānfāchū nánwén de qìwèi.
examples.english: If we don't dispose of these food waste promptly, they will quickly rot and emit an unpleasant odor.

examples.chinese: 长期暴露在海洋环境中的金属结构会遭受严重的腐蚀，这是许多沿海工程面临的主要挑战。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī bàolù zài hǎiyáng huánjìng zhōng de jīnshǔ jiégòu huì zāoshòu yánzhòng de fǔshí, zhè shì xǔduō yánhǎi gōngchéng miànlín de zhǔyào tiǎozhàn.
examples.english: Metal structures exposed to the marine environment for extended periods will suffer severe corrosion, which is a major challenge facing many coastal engineering projects.

examples.chinese: 这个古老的帝国因为制度腐朽而最终走向了灭亡。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gǔlǎo de dìguó yīnwèi zhìdù fǔxiǔ ér zuìzh终 zǒuxiàng le mièwáng.
examples.english: This ancient empire ultimately collapsed because its system had become rotten and decadent.

examples.chinese: 许多流媒体平台采取了分级付费模式，以满足不同消费者的需求。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō liúméitǐ píng tái cǎiqǔle fēnjí fù fèi móshì, yǐ mǎnz足 búttóng xiāofèi zhě de xū qiú.
examples.english: Many streaming platforms have adopted a tiered fee model to meet the needs of different consumers.

examples.chinese: 这个丑闻对公司的负面影响可能需要数年才能恢复。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chǒuwén duì gōngsī de fùmiàn yǐngxiǎng kěnéng xūyào shù nián cái néng huīfù.
examples.english: The negative impact of this scandal on the company may take years to recover from.

examples.chinese: 由于合同条款的变更，我们需要重新协商付款时间表，以确保双方的利益都能得到保护。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú héttóng tiáokuǎn de biànggēng, wǒmen xūyào chóngxīn xiéshāng fùkuǎn shíjiān biǎo, yǐ quèbǎo shuāngfāng de lìyì dōu néng dédào bǎohù.
examples.english: Due to changes in the contract terms, we need to renegotiate the payment schedule to ensure that the interests of both parties are protected.

examples.chinese: 作为公司的管理层，我们负有确保员工安全和福利的责任。
examples.pinyin: Zuòwéi gōngsī de guǎnlǐ céng, wǒmen fùyǒu quèbǎo yuángōng ānquán hé fúlì de zérèn.
examples.english: As managers of the company, we are responsible for ensuring the safety and welfare of our employees.

examples.chinese: 这份合同附有详细的条款说明，双方都必须严格附从。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn hétóng fùyǒu xiáng细 de tiáokuǎn shuōmíng, shuāngfāng dōu bìxū yánggé fùcóng.
examples.english: This contract includes detailed terms and conditions that both parties must strictly comply with.

examples.chinese: 这份合同的附带条款规定了双方在违约情况下的赔偿责任。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn héTóng de fùdài tiáokuàn guīdìngle shuāngfāng zài wéiyuē qíngkuàng xià de péicháng zérèn.
examples.english: The supplementary clauses in this contract stipulate the compensation liability of both parties in case of breach.

examples.chinese: 他的观点虽然有些极端，但很多人还是盲目地附和他。
examples.pinyin: Tā de guāndiǎn suīrán yǒuxiē jíduān, dàn hěnduō rén háishi mánglì de fùhè tā.
examples.english: Although his viewpoint is somewhat extreme, many people still blindly agree with him.

examples.chinese: 这份合同附加了很多条款，我们需要仔细阅读每一条才能签字。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn hétonɡ fùjiāle hěnduō tiáokuǎn, wǒmen xūyào zǐxì yuèdú měi yī tiáo cáinénɡ qiānzì.
examples.english: This contract has many additional clauses attached to it, and we need to carefully read each one before we can sign.

examples.chinese: 这所大学附属医院在心脏手术领域享有很高的声誉。
examples.pinyin: Zhè suǒ dàxué fùshǔ yīyuàn zài xīnzàng shǒushù lǐngyù xiǎngyǒu hěn gāo de shēngyù.
examples.english: This university-affiliated hospital has a high reputation in the field of cardiac surgery.

examples.chinese: 医生建议我三个月后复查一次血液检验，以确保治疗效果。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì wǒ sān ge yuè hòu fùchá yī cì xiěyè jiǎnyàn, yǐ quèbǎo zhìliáo xiàoguǒ.
examples.english: The doctor recommended that I recheck my blood work in three months to ensure the treatment is effective.

examples.chinese: 听到家乡发生了洪灾，他立刻赴往当地参加救援工作。
examples.pinyin: Tīngdào jiāxiāng fāshēngle hóngzāi, tā lìkè fùwǎng dāngdì cānjiā jiùyuán gōngzuò.
examples.english: Upon hearing that his hometown was hit by floods, he immediately went there to participate in the rescue work.

examples.chinese: 患者术后三年内复发的风险相对较高，因此需要定期进行复查和监测。
examples.pinyin: Huànzhě shùhòu sān nián nèi fùfā de fēngxiǎn xiāngduì jiào gāo, yīncǐ xūyào dìngqī jìnxíng fùchá hé jiān测。
examples.english: The risk of recurrence within three years after surgery is relatively high for this patient, so regular follow-up examinations and monitoring are necessary.

examples.chinese: 这个复合材料的性能远远超过了传统的单一材料，在航空航天领域得到了广泛应用。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fùhé cáiliào de xìngnéng yuǎnyuǎn chāoguòle chuántǒng de dānyī cáiliào, zài hángkōng航天 lǐngyù dé到le guǎngfàn yìngyòng.
examples.english: The performance of this composite material far exceeds that of traditional single materials and has been widely applied in the aerospace field.

examples.chinese: 这部纪录片通过大量的历史档案，让那段被遗忘的文明得以复活在观众的眼前。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùk片 tōngguò dàliàng de lìshǐ dàng'àn, ràng nà duàn bèi yíwàng de wénmíng déyǐ fùhuó zài guānzhòng de yǎnqián.
examples.english: Through a large number of historical archives, this documentary brought the forgotten civilization back to life before the audience's eyes.

english: Fuxing district of Handan city 邯鄲市|邯郸市[Han2 dan1 shi4]

examples.chinese: 他在复兴区投资了一个大型钢铁厂，为当地经济的复兴做出了重要贡献。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài Fùxīng qū tóuzī le yī gè dàxíng gāngtiě chǎng, wèi dāngdì jīngjì de fùxīng zuòchūle zhòngyào gòngxiàn.
examples.english: He invested in a large steel mill in Fuxing District, making a significant contribution to the revival of the local economy.

examples.chinese: 这位文物修复专家花了三年时间才将这件古代瓷器完全复原到原来的样子。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi wénwù xiūfù zhuānjiā huāle sān nián shíjiān cái jiāng zhè jiàn gǔdài cíqì wánquán fùyuán dào yuánlái de yàngzi.
examples.english: It took this cultural relics restoration expert three years to fully restore this ancient porcelain piece to its original condition.

examples.chinese: 这种新药虽然疗效显著，但是长期使用可能会产生一些不可预测的副作用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xīn yào suīrán liáoxiào xiǎnzhù, dànshì cháng期 shǐyòng kěnéng huì chǎnshēng yīxiē búkě yùcè de fùzuòyòng.
examples.english: Although this new drug has significant therapeutic effects, long-term use may produce some unpredictable side effects.

examples.chinese: 这种深海鱼富含欧米伽-3脂肪酸，对心血管健康有重要的保护作用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shēnhǎi yú fùhán ōuměiyǎ-3 zhīfángsuān, duì xīnxiěguǎn jiànkāng yǒu zhòngyào de bǎohù zuòyòng.
examples.english: This type of deep-sea fish is rich in omega-3 fatty acids, which play an important protective role for cardiovascular health.

examples.chinese: 这部宪法赋予了公民广泛的权利和自由。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù xiànfǎ fùyǔ le gōngmín guǎngfàn de quánlì hé zìyóu.
examples.english: This constitution endows citizens with extensive rights and freedoms.

examples.chinese: 那位房地产富豪因为偷税漏税被司法机关调查，最终被判处有期徒刑。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi fángdìchǎn fùháo yīnwèi tōushuì lòushuì bèi sīfǎ jīguān diàochá, zuìzhōng bèi pànchǔ yǒuqī túxíng.
examples.english: That real estate tycoon was investigated by judicial authorities for tax evasion and was ultimately sentenced to a fixed-term imprisonment.

examples.chinese: 一个国家要实现民族复兴，必须坚持走富强之路，不断深化改革开放。
examples.pinyin: Yī ge guójiā yào shíxiàn mínzú fùxīng, bìxū jiānchí zǒu fùqiáng zhī lù, búduàn shēnhuà gǎigé kāifàng.
examples.english: For a nation to achieve national rejuvenation, it must persist in taking the path toward prosperity and strength, and continuously deepen reform and opening-up.

examples.chinese: 那位房地产富翁通过慈善事业试图改善自己在公众中的形象。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi fángdìchǎn fùwēng tōngguò císhàn shìyè shìtú gǎishàn zìjǐ zài gōngzhòng zhōng de xíngxiàng.
examples.english: That real estate tycoon tried to improve his public image through charitable activities.

examples.chinese: 经过几十年的改革开放，这个地区从贫困逐渐发展成为富裕的工业中心。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò jǐ shí nián de gǎigé kāifàng, zhège dìqū cóng pinkùn zhújiàn fāzhǎn chéngwéi fùyù de gōngyè zhōngxīn.
examples.english: After decades of reform and opening-up, this region gradually developed from poverty into a prosperous industrial center.

examples.chinese: 长期的压力和焦虑往往会导致腹部脂肪堆积，这已经成为现代人面临的一个普遍问题。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī de yālì hé jiāolǜ wǎngwǎng huì dǎozhì fùbù zhīf肪 duījī, zhè yǐjīng chéngwéi xiàndàirén miànlín de yī ge pǔbiàn wèntí.
examples.english: Prolonged stress and anxiety often lead to fat accumulation in the abdomen, which has become a common problem faced by modern people.

examples.chinese: 由于饮食不洁，他在出差期间突然腹泻，不得不提前返回了公司。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú yǐnshí bújiè, tā zài chūchāi qījiān túrán fùxiè, búděbuéy tíqián fǎnhuī le gōngsī.
examples.english: Due to unclean food, he suddenly developed diarrhea during his business trip and had to return to the company early.

examples.chinese: 经历了多年的奋斗，他终于实现了物质富足和精神充实的生活理想。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglìle duō nián de fènduò, tā终于 shíxiànle wùzhì fùzú hé jīngshén chōngshí de shēnghuó lǐxiǎng.
examples.english: After years of struggle, he finally realized his life ideal of material richness and spiritual fulfillment.

examples.chinese: 这项新政策的实施范围覆盖了全国大部分地区，但仍有一些偏远山区没有被纳入其中。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng xīn zhèngcè de shíshī fànwéi fùgàile quánguó dàbù fèn dìqū, dàn réngyǒu yīxiē piānyuǎn shānqū méiyǒu bèi納入 qízhōng.
examples.english: The implementation scope of this new policy covers most regions across the country, but some remote mountainous areas are still not included.

examples.chinese: 该公司的财务报表显示，去年的利润增长了百分之三十。
examples.pinyin: Gāi gōngsī de cáiwù bàobiǎo xiǎnshì, qùnián de lìrùn zēngzhǎngle bǎifēnzhī sānshí.
examples.english: The company's financial statement shows that last year's profit increased by thirty percent.

examples.chinese: 这款应用程序在改版之后，用户界面变得更加直观，但也引发了一些老用户的不满。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn yìngyòng chéngxù zài gǎibǎn zhīhòu, yònghù jiàomiàn biàn de gèngjiā zhíguān, dàn yě yǐnfāle yīxiē lǎo yònghù de búmǎn.
examples.english: After this application was revised, the user interface became more intuitive, but it also triggered dissatisfaction among some long-time users.

examples.chinese: 这部小说被多次改编成电影和电视剧，每个版本都有其独特的艺术风格。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù xiǎoshuō bèi duō cì gǎibiān chéng diànyǐng hé diànshìjù, měi ge bǎnběn dōu yǒu qī dúté de yìshù fēnggé.
examples.english: This novel has been adapted into films and TV series multiple times, and each version has its own unique artistic style.

english: to reform and open to the outside world

examples.chinese: 这份合同的条款不能随意改动，必须经过双方律师的同意。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn héyuē de tiáokuǎn búnéng suíyì gǎidòng, bìxū jīngguò shuāngfāng lǜshī de tóngyì.
examples.english: The terms of this contract cannot be altered arbitrarily; it must be approved by both parties' lawyers.

examples.chinese: 这位知名演员为了开启新的事业阶段，决定改名，希望能够摆脱过去的包袱。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zhīmíng yǎnyuán wèile kāiqǐ xīn de shìyè jiēduàn, juédìng gǎimíng, xīwàng néng gòu báituō guòqù de bāobao.
examples.english: This well-known actor decided to change his name to start a new phase of his career, hoping to shake off the baggage of his past.

examples.chinese: 这个项目太复杂了，我们改日再详细讨论，现在先把框架搭建好。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù tài fùzá le, wǒmen gǎirì zài xiáng细 tǎolùn, xiànzài xiān bǎ kuàngjià搭jiàn hǎo.
examples.english: This project is too complex. Let's discuss the details another day, and for now let's just get the framework set up.

examples.chinese: 公司决定将原来的营销策略改为更加注重社交媒体的方式。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng jiāng yuánlái de yíngxiāo cèlüè gǎiwéi gèngjiā zhùzhòng shèjiāo méitǐ de fāngshi.
examples.english: The company decided to change its original marketing strategy into an approach that focuses more on social media.

examples.chinese: 长期缺钙会导致骨质疏松，尤其是中老年女性需要特别注意钙的摄入。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī quēgài huì dǎozhì gǔzhì shūsōng, yóuqī shì zhōng lǎoniánniǚ xìng xūyào tèbié zhùyì gài de摄入。
examples.english: Long-term calcium deficiency can lead to osteoporosis, especially for middle-aged and elderly women who need to pay special attention to calcium intake.

examples.chinese: 这个古董瓷罐的盖子已经丢失了，但从纹饰来看，它应该是清朝时期的珍品。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gǔdòng cíguàn de gàizi yǐjīng diūshī le, dàn cóng wénshì lái kàn, tā yīnggāi shì Qīngcháo shíqī de zhēnpǐn.
examples.english: The lid of this antique ceramic jar has been lost, but judging from its decorative patterns, it should be a precious item from the Qing Dynasty.

examples.chinese: 这份报告详细介绍了该地区经济发展的概况，为投资者提供了重要的参考。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào xiáng细 jièshào le gāi dìqū jīngjì fāzhǎn de gàikuàng, wèi tóuzī zhě tígōngle zhòngyào de cānkǎo.
examples.english: This report provides a detailed overview of the economic development situation in the region, offering important reference for investors.

examples.chinese: 虽然我们无法预测未来，但通过大数据分析，我们可以计算出某些事件发生的概率。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen wúfǎ yùcè wèilái, dàn tōngguò dà shùjù fēnxī, wǒmen kěyǐ jìsuàn chūmǒu xiē shìjiàn fāshēng de gàilǜ.
examples.english: Although we cannot predict the future, through big data analysis, we can calculate the probability of certain events occurring.

examples.chinese: 这门课程的概论部分涵盖了从古代到现代的主要历史事件。
examples.pinyin: Zhè mén kèchéng de gàilùn bùfen hánhài le cóng gǔdài dào xiàndài de zhǔyào lìshǐ shìjiàn.
examples.english: The outline section of this course covers the major historical events from ancient to modern times.

examples.chinese: 历史上许多伟大的文明都毁于无休止的干戈之中，这给我们留下了深刻的教训。
examples.pinyin: Lìshǐ shang xǔduō wěidà de wénmíng dōu huǐ yú wúxiūzhǐ de gānggē zhīzhōng, zhè gěi wǒmen liúxià le shēnkè de jiàoxùn.
examples.english: Throughout history, many great civilizations have been destroyed amid endless warfare, leaving us profound lessons.

examples.chinese: 由于气候变化导致的长期干旱，许多农民被迫放弃传统农业，转向其他行业谋生。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú qìhòu biànhuà dǎozhì de chángqī gānhàn, xǔduō nóngmín bèi pòbò fàngqì chuántǒng nóngyè, zhuǎnxiàng qítā hángyè móushēng.
examples.english: Due to prolonged drought caused by climate change, many farmers were forced to abandon traditional agriculture and seek livelihoods in other industries.

examples.chinese: 长期生活在干燥的环境中容易导致皮肤问题，因此保湿护理显得尤为重要。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī shēnghuó zài gānzào de huánjìng zhōng róngyì dǎozhì pífu wèntí, yīncǐ bǎoshī hùlǐ xiǎnde yóuwéi zhòngyào.
examples.english: Living in a dry environment for a long time can easily lead to skin problems, so moisturizing skincare becomes particularly important.

examples.chinese: 他虽然失去了很多机会，但他甘心为了家人的幸福而做出这样的牺牲。
examples.pinyin: Tā suīrán shīqù le hěnduō jīhuì, dàn tā gānxīn wèile jiārén de xìngfú érhuò zuòchū zhèyàng de xīshēng.
examples.english: Although he lost many opportunities, he was reconciled to making such sacrifices for his family's happiness.

examples.chinese: 他在众人面前说错了话，现在感到十分尴尬，恨不得找个地缝钻进去。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài zhòngrén miànqián shuōcuò le huà, xiànzài gǎndào shífēn gāngà, hènbudé zhǎo ge dìfèng zuàn jinqu.
examples.english: He misspoke in front of everyone, and now feels extremely awkward, wishing he could find a crack in the ground to disappear into.

examples.chinese: 长期饮酒会对肝脏造成严重的损害，这是医学上公认的事实。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī yǐnjiǔ huì duì gānzàng zàochéng yánzhòu de sǔnhài, zhè shì yīxuéshang gōngrènde shìshí.
examples.english: Prolonged alcohol consumption causes serious damage to the liver, which is an established medical fact.

examples.chinese: 听说家里出了急事，他立刻放下手中的工作，赶赴回家。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō jiālǐ chūle jíshì, tā lìkè fàngxià shǒuzhōng de gōngzuò, gǎnfù huíjiā.
examples.english: Upon hearing that an urgent matter had occurred at home, he immediately set down his work and hurried back home.

examples.chinese: 听到紧急警报后，医疗队立即赶往灾区救援。
examples.pinyin: Tīngdào jǐnjí jǐngbào hòu, yīliáo duì lìjí gǎnwǎng zāi qū jiùyuán.
examples.english: After hearing the emergency alert, the medical team immediately rushed to the disaster area to provide relief.

examples.chinese: 敢情你早就知道这个秘密，却一直没有告诉我。
examples.pinyin: Gǎnqing nǐ zǎojiù zhīdào zhège mìmì,却 yīzhí méiyǒu gàosu wǒ.
examples.english: So you've known about this secret all along, but never told me.

examples.chinese: 他对这个项目的前景感到担忧，但仍然坚持了下去。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì zhège xiàngmù de qiánjǐng gǎndào dānnyōu, dàn仍rán jiānchí le xiàyuè.
examples.english: He felt worried about the prospects of this project, but persisted nonetheless.

examples.chinese: 经过这次失败的项目，我对团队合作有了深刻的感触。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò zhè cì shībài de xiàngmù, wǒ duì tuánduì hézuò yǒule shēnkè de gǎnchù.
examples.english: After this failed project, I had a deep feeling about teamwork.

examples.chinese: 我们应该感恩那些在困难时期为我们伸出援手的人，因为他们的善举改变了我们的人生轨迹。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi gǎnēn nàxiē zài kùnnan shíqī wèi wǒmen shēnchū yuánshǒu de rén, yīnwèi tāmen de shànjǔ gǎibiàn le wǒmen de rénshēng guǐjī.
examples.english: We should be grateful to those who extended a helping hand to us during difficult times, because their kindness changed the trajectory of our lives.

examples.chinese: 我对导师多年来的耐心指导感激不尽，这些宝贵的经验将伴随我整个学术生涯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ duì dǎoshī duō nián lái de nàixīn zhǐdǎo gǎnjī bújìn, zhèxiē báoguì de jīngyàn jiāng bànsuí wǒ zhěngge xuéshù shēngyá.
examples.english: I am deeply grateful for my mentor's patient guidance over the years, and these valuable experiences will accompany me throughout my academic career.

examples.chinese: 看着这座城市的巨大变化,他不禁感慨时间流逝得有多快。
examples.pinyin: Kànzhe zhè zuò chéngshì de jùdà biànhuà, tā búnjìn gǎnkǎi shíjiān liúshī de yǒuduō kuài.
examples.english: Watching the enormous changes in this city, he couldn't help but sigh with emotion at how quickly time passes.

examples.chinese: 这种病毒的传播速度之快令人担忧，已经感染了数百万人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng bìngdú de chuánbō sùdù zhī kuài lìng rén dānxīn, yǐjīng gǎnrǎn le shù bǎi wàn rén.
examples.english: The rapid spread of this virus is concerning, as it has already infected millions of people.

examples.chinese: 这位领导人物以其坚定的信念和感染力，激励了整个团队为共同目标而奋斗。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǐngdǎo rénwù yǐ qī jiāndìng de xìnniàn hé gǎnrǎnlì, jīlì le zhěngge tuánduì wèi gòngtóng mùbiāo ér fèndòu.
examples.english: This leader, with their firm convictions and inspiring influence, motivated the entire team to strive toward a common goal.

examples.chinese: 看着曾经繁华的老街区如今已经面目全非，他不禁感叹时光流逝的无情。
examples.pinyin: Kànzhe céngjīng繁华 de lǎojiē qū rújīn yǐjīng miànmù quánfēi, tā bújìn gǎntàn shíguāng liúshì de wúqíng.
examples.english: Looking at the once-prosperous old neighborhood that has now become completely unrecognizable, he couldn't help but sigh at the ruthlessness of the passage of time.

examples.chinese: 艺术家的感性认识往往比理性分析更能触动观众的心灵。
examples.pinyin: Yìshùjiā de gǎnxìng rènshi wǎngwǎng bǐ lǐxìng fēnxī gèng néng chùdòng guānzhòng de xīnlíng.
examples.english: An artist's sensitive perception often touches the audience's heart more than rational analysis does.

examples.chinese: 这位年轻的基层干部凭借扎实的工作作风赢得了群众的信任。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi niánqīng de jīcéng gànbù píngjiè zhāshí de gōngzuò zuòfēng yíngdéle qúnzhòng de xìnrèn.
examples.english: This young grassroots organizer earned the trust of the masses through their solid work style.

examples.chinese: 这位学生会干事在组织校园活动时表现出了卓越的领导能力和高度的责任感。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi xuéshenghuì gànshi zài zǔzhī xiàoyuán huódòng shí biǎoxiànchūle zhuóyuè de lǐngdǎo néngLì hé gāodù de zérènGǎn.
examples.english: This student council administrator demonstrated outstanding leadership ability and a high sense of responsibility when organizing campus activities.

examples.chinese: 这份政策文件明确阐述了未来十年的发展纲领，为各部门的工作指明了方向。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn zhèngcè wénjiàn míngquè chǎnshù le wèilái shí nián de fāzhǎn gānglǐng, wèi gè bùmén de gōngzuò zhǐmíng le fāngxiàng.
examples.english: This policy document clearly outlines the development agenda for the next decade, providing direction for the work of all departments.

examples.chinese: 他那刚毅的性格在逆境中得到了充分的展现，最终带领团队度过了难关。
examples.pinyin: Tā nàge gāngyì de xìnggé zài nìjìng zhōng dé到le充分de zhǎnxiàn, zuìzh終dàilǐng tuánduì dùguò le nánguān.
examples.english: His resolute character was fully demonstrated in adversity, and he ultimately led the team through the crisis.

examples.chinese: 这份改革纲要详细阐述了未来十年的发展战略和具体措施。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn gǎigé gāngyào xiáng细 chǎnshù le wèilái shí nián de fāzhǎn zhànlüè hé jùtǐ cuòshī.
examples.english: This reform outline elaborates in detail the development strategy and specific measures for the next decade.

examples.chinese: 这座桥的钢铁结构经历了半个世纪的风雨，依然屹立不倒。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò qiáo de gāngtie jiégòu jīng历le bàn ge shìjì de fēngyǔ, yīránán yìlì búdào.
examples.english: The steel structure of this bridge has withstood half a century of wind and rain and still stands firm.

examples.chinese: 这个古董陶缸是从景德镇传承下来的，已经有三百多年的历史了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gǔdǒng táocí gāng shì cóng Jǐngdézhèn chuánchéng xiàlai de, yǐjīng yǒu sānbǎi duō nián de lìshǐ le.
examples.english: This antique ceramic jar was passed down from Jingdezhen and has a history of over three hundred years.

examples.chinese: 他每天早上都会在健身房里举杠铃，这已经成为了他生活中不可或缺的一部分。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān zǎoshang dōu huì zài jiànshēnfáng lǐ jǔ gànglíng, zhè yǐjīng chéngwéi le tā shēnghuó zhōng búkě huòquē de yībùfen.
examples.english: He lifts barbells at the gym every morning, which has become an indispensable part of his life.

examples.chinese: 随着粤港澳大湾区的深度融合，这座城市的经济地位变得愈加举足轻重。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe Yuè-Gǎng-Ào dà w湾qū de shēndù rónghé, zhè zuò chéngshì de jīngjì dìwèi biàn de yùjiā jǔzúqīngzhòng.
examples.english: With the deep integration of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macau Greater Bay Area, this city's economic position has become increasingly important.

examples.chinese: 尽管面临困境，他仍然昂首挺胸，斗志高昂地继续前行。
examples.pinyin: Jìnguǎn miànlín kùnjìng, tā仍然 ángshǒu tǐngxiōng, dòuzhì gāoáng de jìxù qiánxíng.
examples.english: Despite facing difficulties, he still held his head high and moved forward with undiminished fighting spirit.

examples.chinese: 他那种高傲的态度让团队的其他成员都感到很不舒服。
examples.pinyin: Tā nà zhǒng gāoào de tàidù ràng tuánduì de qítā chéngyuán dōu gǎndào hěn búshūfu.
examples.english: His arrogant attitude made all the other team members feel very uncomfortable.

examples.chinese: 这位建筑师的设计理念高超，他能够将传统文化与现代美学完美融合。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi jiànzhúshī de shèjì lǐniàn gāochāo, tā nénggoù jiāng chuántǒng wénhuà yǔ xiàndài měixué wánměi rónghé.
examples.english: This architect's design philosophy is excellent; he can perfectly blend traditional culture with modern aesthetics.

examples.chinese: 这栋建筑的高低设计很独特,既能充分利用空间,又不会显得单调。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng jiànzhù de gāodī shèjì hěn dúté, jì néng chōngfèn lìyòng kōngjiān, yòu búhuì xiǎnde dāndiào.
examples.english: The height variation design of this building is quite unique, which fully utilizes space while avoiding monotony.

examples.chinese: 这位政治家经常发表高调言论，但实际行动往往与其承诺相悖。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zhèngzhìjiā jīngcháng fābiǎo gāodiào yányùn, dàn shíjì xíngdòng wǎngwǎng yǔ qī chéngnuò xiāngbó.
examples.english: This politician frequently makes high-sounding statements, but his actual actions often contradict his promises.

examples.chinese: 这个项目需要高额的投资，但预期回报也相当可观。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù xūyào gāoé de tóuzī, dàn yùqī huíbào yě xiāngdāng kěguān.
examples.english: This project requires a high quota of investment, but the expected returns are also quite substantial.

examples.chinese: 他在高尔夫球场上挥洒了整个下午，只为了追求那一杆进洞的完美瞬间。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài gāoěrfūqiú chǎng shang huīsǎ le zhěngge xiàwǔ, zhǐwèile zhuīqiú nà yī gǎn jìnhuà de wánměi shùnjiān.
examples.english: He spent the entire afternoon on the golf course, all for the sake of pursuing that perfect moment of sinking a hole in one.

examples.chinese: 她那高贵的气质和优雅的谈吐让在场的所有人都为之折服。
examples.pinyin: Tā nà gāoguì de qìzhì hé yōuyǎ de tántǔ ràng zàichǎng de suǒyǒu rén dōu wèi zhī zhéfú.
examples.english: Her noble bearing and elegant manner of speech won the admiration of everyone present.

examples.chinese: 飞行员在高空中遇到了严重的气流，不得不立即下降高度。
examples.pinyin: Fēixíng yuán zài gāokōng zhōng遇到le yánzhòng de qìliú, búdébuzhǔ lìjí xiàjiàng gāodù.
examples.english: The pilot encountered severe turbulence at high altitude and had to descend immediately.

examples.chinese: 随着社会老龄化的加剧，高龄老人的养老问题日益成为政府关注的焦点。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe shèhuì lǎolínghuà de jiājù, gāolíng lǎorén de yǎnglǎo wèntí rìyì chéngwéi zhèngfǔ guānzhù de jiāodiǎn.
examples.english: As social aging intensifies, the pension issues of elderly people have increasingly become a focus of government attention.

examples.chinese: 这位建筑师的设计思想非常高明，巧妙地解决了城市空间紧张的难题。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi jiànzhúshī de shèjì sīxiǎng fēicháng gāomíng, qiǎomiào de jiějuéle chéngshì kōngjiān jǐnzhāng de nántí.
examples.english: This architect's design philosophy is brilliant, skillfully solving the problem of urban space constraints.

examples.chinese: 这条古老的商路穿过高山峻岭，见证了丝绸之路上几千年的文明交融。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo gǔlǎo de shānglù chuānguò gāoshān jùnlǐng, jiànzhèng le sīchóu zhī lù shàng jǐ qiānnián de wénmíng jiāorónglùn.
examples.english: This ancient trade route passed through high mountains and steep ridges, witnessing thousands of years of civilizational exchange along the Silk Road.

examples.chinese: 这个团队采用了新的项目管理系统，大大提高了工作的高效性，使得交付时间缩短了三个月。
examples.pinyin: Zhège tuánduì cǎiyòngle xīnde xiàngmù guǎnlǐ xìtǒng, dàdà tíigāole gōngzuò de gāoxiàoxìng, shǐde jiāofùshíjiān suōduǎnle sānge yuè.
examples.english: This team adopted a new project management system, which greatly improved work efficiency, reducing delivery time by three months.

examples.chinese: 随着高新技术的不断发展，人工智能已经渗透到我们日常生活的方方面面。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe gāoxīn jìshù de búduàn fāzhǎn, réngōng zhìnéng yǐjīng shèntoù dào wǒmen rìcháng shēnghuó de fāngfāngmiànmiàn.
examples.english: With the continuous development of high-tech, artificial intelligence has already penetrated into every aspect of our daily lives.

examples.chinese: 长期的工作压力和不规律的生活方式导致了他年仅四十多岁就患上了高血压。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī de gōngzuò yālì hé búguīlǜ de shēnghuó fāngshì dǎozhìle tā niánjiǔ sìshí duō suì jiù huànshàngle gāoxuèyā.
examples.english: Prolonged work stress and irregular lifestyle habits led to him developing high blood pressure in his early forties.

examples.chinese: 长期处于高压环境下工作，许多员工都出现了心理健康问题。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī chǔyú gāoyā huanjìng xià gōngzuò, xǔduō yuángōng dōu chūxiànle xīnlǐ jiànkāng wèntí.
examples.english: Working under high-pressure conditions for long periods, many employees have developed mental health issues.

examples.chinese: 这位艺术家的作品风格高雅，深受国际美术界的推崇。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi yìshùjiā de zuòpǐn fēnggé gāoyǎ, shēnshòu guójì měishù jiè de tuīchóng.
examples.english: This artist's work style is refined and elegant, highly esteemed by the international art community.

examples.chinese: 随着新产品的成功推出，消费者对这个品牌的热情高涨，销售额也随之大幅增长。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe xīn chǎnpǐn de chénggōng tuīchū, xiāofèizhě duì zhège pǐnpái de règing gāozhàng, xiāoshòuée yě suízhī dàfú zēngzhǎng.
examples.english: As the new product was successfully launched, consumers' enthusiasm for this brand surged, and sales increased significantly accordingly.

examples.chinese: 这个项目的进展缓慢，我怀疑背后肯定有人在搞鬼，想要破坏我们的计划。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de jìnzhǎn huǎnman, wǒ huáiy疑 bèihouǐ kěndìng yǒurén zài gǎo guǐ, xiǎngyào pòhuài wǒmen de jìhuà.
examples.english: The progress of this project has been slow, and I suspect someone must be sabotaging it behind the scenes, trying to undermine our plan.

examples.chinese: 他那套荒诞的理论虽然搞笑，但背后却隐含着对社会现实的深刻讽刺。
examples.pinyin: Tā nà tào huāngdàn de lǐlùn suīrán gǎoxiào, dàn bèihòu却 yǐnhányǒu zhe duì shèhuì xiànshí de shēnkè fěngcì.
examples.english: Although his absurd theory is funny, it actually contains a profound satire of social reality.

examples.chinese: 他向法院告发了前公司的财务造假行为。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiàng fǎyuàn gàofā le qián gōngsī de cáiwù zàojiǎ xíngwéi.
examples.english: He reported his former company's financial fraud to the court.

examples.chinese: 由于时间有限，我必须向各位告辞了，希望下次能有更多的机会深入探讨这个问题。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú shíjiān yǒuxiàn, wǒ bìxū xiàng gèwèi gàocí le, xīwàng xiàcì néng yǒu gèngduō de jīhuì shēnrù tàntǎo zhège wèntí.
examples.english: Due to limited time, I must say goodbye to you all, hoping there will be more opportunities to discuss this issue in depth next time.

examples.chinese: 领导在会议上严肃地告诫我们，不能因为一时的成功就放松警惕，否则很容易重蹈覆辙。
examples.pinyin: Lǐngdǎo zài huìyì shang yánsuò de gàojiè wǒmen, búnéng yīnwèi yīshí de chénggōng jiù fàngsōng jǐngtì, fǒuzé hěn róngyì zhòngdào fùzhè.
examples.english: The leader solemnly warned us at the meeting that we cannot let our guard down just because of temporary success, otherwise we will easily repeat the same mistakes.

examples.chinese: 政府在官方网站上发布了新的税收改革告示，要求所有企业在月底前完成相关申报。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zài guāngfāng wǎngzhàn shàng fābùle xīnde shuìshōu gǎigé gàoshi, yāoqiú suǒyǒu qǐyè zài yuèdǐ qián wánchéng xiāngguān shēnbào.
examples.english: The government published an announcement regarding the new tax reform on its official website, requiring all enterprises to complete the relevant declarations before the end of the month.

examples.chinese: 我们需要尽快告知所有利益相关者这个重要决定的原因和后果。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào jìnkuài gàozhī suǒyǒu lìyì xiāngguān zhě zhège zhòngyào juédìng de yuányīn hé hòuguǒ.
examples.english: We need to promptly inform all stakeholders about the reasons and consequences of this important decision.

examples.chinese: 他因为嫉妒我升职，就跑到老板面前告状，说我工作中有很多问题。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi jídù wǒ shēngzhí, jiù pǎodào lǎobǎn miànqián gàozhuàng, shuō wǒ gōngzuò zhōng yǒu hěnduō wèntí.
examples.english: Out of jealousy over my promotion, he ran to the boss and told on me, claiming there were many problems with my work.

examples.chinese: 这支考古队在戈壁深处发现了一座保存完好的古城遗迹。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī kǎogǔ duì zài gēbì shēnchù fāxiàn le yī zuò bǎocún wánhǎo de gǔchéng yíjī.
examples.english: The archaeological team discovered a well-preserved ancient city ruin deep in the Gobi Desert.

examples.chinese: 他紧紧地挽住了她的胳膊，生怕在人群中失散。
examples.pinyin: Tā jǐnjǐn de wǎnzhù le tā de gēbo, shēngpà zài rénqún zhōng shīsǎn.
examples.english: He held her arm tightly, afraid of losing her in the crowd.

examples.chinese: 这座城市广场上的鸽子已经成为了城市文化的象征，尽管有人认为它们制造了环境污染。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì guǎngchǎng shang de gēzi yǐjīng chéngwéile chéngshì wénhuà de xiàngzh征, jìnguǎn yǒurén rènwéi tāmen zhìzàole huanjìng wūrǎn.
examples.english: The pigeons in this city's square have become a symbol of urban culture, although some people believe they create environmental pollution.

examples.chinese: 这个项目因为资金问题被搁置了半年，直到最近才重新启动。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù yīnwèi zījīn wèntí bèi gēzhì le bànnián, zhídào zuìjìn cái chóngxīn qǐdòng.
examples.english: This project was shelved for half a year due to funding issues, and only recently was it restarted.

examples.chinese: 由于双方存在重大分歧，这个项目被暂时搁置了，等待进一步的协商。
examples.pinyin: yóuyú shuāngfāng cúnzài zhòngdà fēnqī, zhège xiàngmù bèi zànshíxing gēzhì le, děngdài jìnyībù de xiéshāng.
examples.english: Due to major disagreements between the two parties, this project has been temporarily shelved, pending further negotiations.

examples.chinese: 那艘货轮在浅滩上搁浅了，救援队花了好几天才把它重新浮起来。
examples.pinyin: Nà sōu huòlún zài qiǎntān shang gē qiǎn le, jiùyuán duì huā le hǎo jǐ tiān cái bǎ tā chóngxīn fúqǐlái.
examples.english: The cargo ship ran aground on a sandbank, and it took the rescue team several days to refloat it.

examples.chinese: 这次谈判中，双方都不愿意割舍自己的核心利益。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì tánpàn zhōng, shuāngfāng dōu búyuànyì gēshě zìjǐ de héxin lìyì.
examples.english: In this negotiation, both sides were unwilling to sacrifice their core interests.

examples.chinese: 这部歌剧融合了传统戏曲和现代舞蹈元素，在国际舞台上赢得了广泛的赞誉。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù gējù rónghéle chuántǒng xìqū hé xiàndài wǔdǎo yuánsù, zài guójì wǔtái shang yíngdéle guǎngfàn de zānyù.
examples.english: This revue integrated traditional opera and modern dance elements, winning widespread acclaim on the international stage.

examples.chinese: 许多文艺作品都在歌颂那些为国家做出巨大牺牲的英雄人物。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō wényì zuòpǐn dōu zài gēsòng nàxiē wèi guójiā zuòchū jùdà xīshēng de yīngxióng rénwù.
examples.english: Many literary and artistic works sing the praises of heroic figures who made great sacrifices for the nation.

examples.chinese: 这部舞剧融合了传统民族歌舞元素，在国际舞台上获得了广泛的认可。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù wǔjù rónghéle chuántǒng mínzú gēwǔ yuánsù, zài guójì wǔtái shang huòdéle guǎngfàn de rènkě.
examples.english: This dance drama incorporated traditional ethnic singing and dancing elements and gained widespread recognition on the international stage.

examples.chinese: 这部交响乐用宏大的音乐语言歌咏了人民在困难中的坚强意志。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù jiāoxiǎnglè yòng hóngdà de yīnyuè yǔyán gēyǒngle rénmín zài kùnnan zhōng de jiānqiáng yìzhì.
examples.english: This symphony uses grand musical language to sing praises of the people's strong will in the face of hardship.

examples.chinese: 这场文化革命深刻改变了整个社会的面貌，其影响至今仍然存在。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng wénhuà gémìng shēnkè gǎibiàn le zhěngge shèhuì de miànmào, qī yǐngxiǎng zhìjīn réngán cúnzài.
examples.english: This cultural revolution profoundly transformed the face of the entire society, and its impact still exists to this day.

examples.chinese: 这栋老建筑的窗户格子虽然已经褪色，但仍然保留着民国时期的建筑风格。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng lǎo jiànzhú de chuānghu gézǐ suīrán yǐjīng tuìsè, dàn仍然 bǎoliúzhe Mínguó shíqī de jiànzhú fēnggé.
examples.english: Although the window lattices of this old building have faded, they still retain the architectural style of the Republic of China era.

examples.chinese: 这家公司虽然规模不大，但老板的格局很高，总是在思考如何适应未来的市场变化。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī suīrán guīmó búdà, dàn lǎobǎn de géjú hěn gāo, zǒngshì zài sīkǎo rúhé shìyìng wèilái de shìchǎng biànhuà.
examples.english: Although this company is not large in scale, the boss has a broad vision and is always thinking about how to adapt to future market changes.

examples.chinese: 这份报告的格式不符合公司的要求，你需要按照新的模板重新整理。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào de géshi búfúhé gōngsī de yāoqiú, nǐ xūyào ànzhào xīn de móbǎn chóngxīn zhěnglǐ.
examples.english: The format of this report doesn't meet the company's requirements; you need to reorganize it according to the new template.

examples.chinese: 多年的误会和隔阂终于在一次坦诚的对话中化解了。
examples.pinyin: Duō nián de wùhuì hé géhé终于 zài yī cì tǎnchéng de duìhuà zhōng huàjiě le.
examples.english: The misunderstandings and estrangement accumulated over many years were finally resolved in one candid conversation.

examples.chinese: 为了防止疫情扩散，政府决定将确诊患者隔离在专门的医疗机构中。
examples.pinyin: Wèile fángzhǐ yìqíng kuòsàn, zhèngfǔ juéding jiāng quèzhěn huànzhě gélí zài zhuānmén de yīliáo jīgòu zhōng.
examples.english: In order to prevent the spread of the epidemic, the government decided to isolate confirmed patients in specialized medical facilities.

examples.chinese: 这个运动员的个头儿虽然不是最高的，但他的速度和力量在整个联赛里都是数一数二的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yùndòng yuán de gètóur虽然búshì zuì gāo de, dànshi tā de sùdù hé lìliàng zài zhěngge liánsài lǐ dōu shì shù yī shù èr de.
examples.english: Although this athlete's size is not the tallest, his speed and strength are among the best in the entire league.

examples.chinese: 这个案件虽然看起来是个案，但实际上反映了整个行业存在的深层问题。
examples.pinyin: Zhège ànjiàn suīrán kàn qǐlái shì gèàn, dàn shíjì shang fǎnyìngle zhěngge hángyè cúnzài de shēncéng wèntí.
examples.english: Although this case appears to be an isolated incident, it actually reflects deep-seated problems that exist throughout the entire industry.

examples.chinese: 大学毕业后，我们几个好友虽然舍不得分离，但最终还是各奔前程，各自追求自己的梦想。
examples.pinyin: Dàxué bìyè hòu, wǒmen jǐ ge hǎoyou suīrán shěbude fēnlí, dàn zuìzhōng háishi gèbèn-qiánchéng, gèzì zhuīqiú zìjǐ de mengxǐang.
examples.english: After graduating from university, although we close friends were reluctant to part, we ultimately went our separate ways to pursue our own dreams.

examples.chinese: 这家百货公司汇集了世界各地的各式各样的商品，从奢侈品到日用品应有尽有。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā bǎihuò gōngsī huìjíle shìjiè gè dì de gèshì-gèyàng de shāngpǐn, cóng shēchǐ pǐn dào rìyòng pǐn yīngyǒujìnyǒu.
examples.english: This department store has gathered various kinds of goods from all over the world, with everything from luxury items to daily necessities.

examples.chinese: 这个地区的贫困问题根深蒂固，不是一两年的政策就能解决的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū de pínkùn wèntí gēnshēn-dìgù, búshì yī liǎng nián de zhèngcè jiù néng jiějué de.
examples.english: The poverty problem in this region is deeply rooted; it cannot be solved by just one or two years of policy implementation.

examples.chinese: 这个社会问题的根源在于教育资源分配不均，而不是简单的道德缺失。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shèhuì wèntí de gēnyuán zàiyú jiàoyù zīyuán fēnpèi búyún, érbúshì jiǎndān de dàodé quēshī.
examples.english: The root cause of this social problem lies in the unequal distribution of educational resources, rather than simple moral deficiency.

examples.chinese: 企业的成功离不开扎实的根基，只有建立健全的管理体系，才能在激烈的市场竞争中立于不败之地。
examples.pinyin: Qǐyè de chénggōng líbukāi zhāshí de gēnjī, zhǐyǒu jiànlì jiànzquán de guǎnlǐ tǐxì, cáinéng zài jīliè de shìchǎng jìngjìng zhōng lìyú búbài zhī dì.
examples.english: A company's success cannot do without a solid foundation; only by establishing a sound management system can it remain undefeated in fierce market competition.

examples.chinese: 要想根治这个社会问题，必须从根本上改革制度，而不是采取临时措施。
examples.pinyin: Yào xiǎng gēnzhì zhège shèhuì wèntí, bìxū cóng gēnběn shang gǎigé zhìdù, érbuShì cǎiqǔ línshí cuòshī.
examples.english: To permanently solve this social problem, we must fundamentally reform the system rather than adopt temporary measures.

examples.chinese: 随着科技的快速发展，许多传统企业如果不能及时创新，就很难跟上时代的步伐。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe kējì de kuàisù fāzhǎn, xǔduō chuántǒng qǐyè rúguǒ búnéng jíshí chuàngxīn, jiù hěn nán gēnshàng shídài de búfa.
examples.english: With the rapid development of technology, many traditional enterprises will find it difficult to keep up with the times if they cannot innovate in time.

examples.chinese: 警察一直在跟踪那个嫌疑人的活动，希望能找到更多证据。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá yīzhí zài gēnzōng nàge xiányírén de huódòng, xīwàng néng zhǎodào gèngduō zhèngjù.
examples.english: The police have been tracking the suspect's activities all along, hoping to find more evidence.

english: not able to keep up with

examples.chinese: 随着科技的飞速发展，许多传统企业已经跟不上市场的步伐，面临被淘汰的风险。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe kējì de fēisù fāzhǎn, xǔduō chuántǒng qǐyè yǐjīng gēnbushàng shìchǎng de búfá, miànlín bèi táotài de fēngxiǎn.
examples.english: As technology develops at a rapid pace, many traditional enterprises can no longer keep up with market trends and face the risk of being eliminated.

examples.chinese: 运动员们在更衣室里讨论了比赛策略，为接下来的挑战做好了充分准备。
examples.pinyin: Yùndòngyuáns men zài gēngyīshì lǐ tǎolùnle bǐsài cèlüè, wèi jiēxiàlái de tiǎozhàn zuòhǎole充分 zhǔnbèi.
examples.english: The athletes discussed the match strategy in the change room and made thorough preparations for the challenge ahead.

examples.chinese: 公司决定更改了原来的发展战略，以适应市场的变化。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng gēnggǎile yuánlái de fāzhǎn zhànlüè, yǐ shìyìng shìchǎng de biànhuà.
examples.english: The company decided to change its original development strategy in order to adapt to market changes.

examples.chinese: 随着城市化进程的加速，大量耕地被征用，这对国家的粮食安全构成了严峻的挑战。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe chéngshìhuà jìnchéng de jiāsù, dàliàng gēngdì bèi zhēngyòng, zhè duì guójiā de liángshi ānquán gòuchéngle yánnjùn de tiǎozhàn.
examples.english: As urbanization accelerates, vast tracts of arable land are being requisitioned, which poses a serious challenge to the nation's food security.

examples.chinese: 他那种耿直的性格在职场上既是优点也是缺点，经常因为直言不讳而得罪人。
